# VOLYUME — FULL PRODUCT + SYSTEM MAP

**Document type:** discovery/documentation only. Nothing in the product was
changed to produce it.
**Repository commit inspected:** `9cdc5fc5` (branch `claude/codebase-audit-docs-pv6mjd`,
identical content merged to `main` at `e001a89e`), 2026-08-09.
**Method:** eight parallel read-only repository audits (navigation/screens;
training + adaptive engine; nutrition + food; settings/profile/tier/auth;
data model + sync; notifications/platform/social; progress/check-ins/education;
docs/boundaries/legacy), each producing an evidence-dense lane chapter, then a
lead-written synthesis for every cross-cutting part, then a fresh-eyes
adversarial review whose factual findings were actioned. Tests were treated as
first-class evidence throughout.
**Evidence standard used everywhere:**
- **LIVE** — implemented and reachable today.
- **LIVE-CONDITIONAL** — implemented, appears only under a named condition
  (state, tier, platform, flag, data).
- **INTERNAL** — supporting infrastructure, not directly user-facing.
- **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE** — code exists, reachability disproven or unproven.
- **PLANNED-DOCUMENTED-ONLY** — in docs/taskboards, not implemented.
- **UNCERTAIN** — evidence conflicts; recorded, never guessed away.

# PART 1 — EXECUTIVE PRODUCT MODEL

## What VOLYUME is

VOLYUME is an offline-first hypertrophy training and nutrition coach for
Android (live on Google Play) and iOS (TestFlight). It is a single-user app
built around one idea: a deterministic coaching engine that prescribes weekly
training volume and calorie/macro targets from research-backed defaults, then
personalises both from the user's own logged evidence, block after block,
with hard safety rails that no personalisation is allowed to cross.

There is **no AI/LLM anywhere in the product**. Every prescription, adjustment
and explanation is produced by pure deterministic functions (same inputs, same
outputs, for every user, every time) - a recorded, inviolable product decision
(CLAUDE.md §2; CHAPTER D2 Part A). The only machine learning is on-device and
never makes a coaching decision: the progress-scan segmentation/estimation
models (optional Pro body-composition read from a photo; no network, no cloud
inference; CHAPTER D1 Part B) and the ML Kit text/barcode recognisers used by
the food label and barcode scanners (CHAPTER B1 Part D).

## Who it is for

People doing structured resistance training for muscle growth ("hypertrophy")
who want a coach's decisions without a human coach: what to train, how many
sets per muscle per week, when to push, when to back off, what to eat, and an
honest reading of whether it is working. The free tier serves self-directed
lifters (plan library, builder, logging, PRs, progress stats); the Pro tier
adds everything coaching and nutrition (targets, food diary, weekly coach,
adaptive blocks, check-ins, progress scan, partner support). Onboarding
requires biological sex and other profile facts before proceeding because the
safety maths (calorie floors, landmarks) depends on them.

## The core problem it solves

Training volume is the main growth lever, but the right dose is personal and
changes over time. Most apps either log passively or prescribe a static
template. VOLYUME closes the loop: it prescribes a volume ramp, watches what
actually happened (performance, recovery, adherence), judges each muscle's
response at block end, and writes the next block from that judgement - while
refusing to let the loop push a user past recorded safety limits (ED-safety
floors, rate-of-loss gates, volume ceilings, suppression under calm mode or an
open ED flag).

## The main product loop (as implemented)

```
ONBOARD (auth → Article 9 consent → profile; sex gate blocks progression)
  → PLAN (library template or builder; research landmarks seed volume)
  → TRAIN + LOG (sessions, sets, reps, load; PRs and e1RM derived)
  → RECOVER (post-session feedback; soreness/joint/pump/exertion)
  → CHECK IN (weekly: energy, soreness, performance, sleep, stress, weigh-ins)
  → WEEKLY COACH (deterministic review: volume nudge, calorie nudge,
     deload proposal - user applies or ignores)
  → BLOCK END (completed_awaiting_decision; nothing auto-transitions)
  → BLOCK LEDGER (per-muscle classification: RESPONSIVE / OVERREACHED /
     STALE / STRAINED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
  → DECIDE (repeat unchanged, or continue with adjustments)
  → NEXT BLOCK (seeded per muscle: manual → ledger → learned band →
     profile-adjusted research → raw research)
  → LEARNED RANGE (block history replayed into per-muscle floor/ceiling)
  → repeat
```

## Product pillars

1. **Training** - plans, builder, exercise library (seeded + custom), session
   logger with rest timer, on-demand warm-up ramps, supersets and giant sets,
   substitutions, unilateral logging, PR detection, e1RM trends. (CHAPTERS A1,
   A2. The plate calculator is NOT part of this list: the module survives but
   `calculatePlates` has no caller and the feature was dropped by founder
   ruling D57 - LEGACY-UNREACHABLE.)
2. **Adaptive coaching** - the weekly coach (volume, deload, calories) and the
   inter-block adaptive mesocycle engine (Block Ledger, learned ranges,
   seeded next blocks, strain-scaled recovery weeks). All deterministic,
   all explained in plain English on the surfaces that show them. (CHAPTER A2)
3. **Nutrition** (Pro) - BMR/TDEE targets with hard floors, adaptive-TDEE
   correction from weigh-in trends, food diary (search, barcode, label OCR),
   meal plans and suggestions, macro cycling/refeeds/diet breaks as proposals.
   (CHAPTER B1)
4. **Progress** - weight trend, body metrics, strength standards, muscle
   volume vs landmarks, streaks, milestones, weekly story, block reflection,
   photos and the on-device progress scan. (CHAPTER D1)
5. **Recovery & safety** - readiness summaries, muscle recovery display,
   ED-pattern detection with fail-closed suppression, calm mode, Beat UK
   signposting, calorie floors, rate-of-loss gates. (Spine Part 19)
6. **Partner support** - training partners (one on free, up to three on Pro;
   `maxPartnersForTier`): weekly signals, shared streak, milestones, cheers.
   Accountability, not a social network. (CHAPTER C2 Part E)

## What makes it more than a workout logger

The engine chain from logged sets to next-block prescription is real and
closed: `blockLedgerGather` (evidence extraction) → `blockMetrics` (Theil-Sen
e1RM slope, PR density) → `interBlock.classifyMuscleBlock` (five verdicts) →
persisted `block_ledger` (synced) → `blockSeed.resolveSeedRange` (five-step
fallback) → written per-muscle weekly ramps → `learnedRange` (long-term
memory). Every step is versioned, provenance-stamped, pinned by tests, and
narrated to the user from the WRITTEN plan rather than intent (so the UI can
never claim an adjustment the plan does not contain).

## What is personalised over time vs user-controlled vs research-driven

- **Personalised automatically:** per-muscle next-block volume (ledger +
  learned range), recovery-week dose (strain-scaled share of achieved peak),
  calorie targets (adaptive TDEE from weigh-in trend), weekly volume nudges,
  readiness interpretation (week-in-block context).
- **User-controlled always:** exercise choice, loads, reps, actual session
  content, whether any coach proposal is applied, block transitions (never
  automatic), manual volume landmark overrides (beat everything), goal/phase,
  every setting in CHAPTER B2's table.
- **Research/default-driven until evidence exists:** volume landmarks
  (`VOLUME_LANDMARKS` per muscle, adjusted by experience/recovery/age/phase),
  rep ranges, RIR targets, rest suggestions, calorie/macro splits, all
  thresholds in CHAPTER A2 Part F and CHAPTER B1 Part H.
- **Never personalised (by design):** safety floors and gates (tier-blind,
  suppression-proof), consent requirements, the deterministic guarantee.

# PART 11 — PERSONALISATION MAP

## USER-ENTERED (explicit)
| Variable | Downstream effects |
|---|---|
| Biological sex | Calorie floor (1,500 M / 1,200 F), BMR formula inputs, female nutrition awareness, cycle question eligibility |
| Age | Landmark age multipliers (MRV down from 40+), masters thresholds in block advisor |
| Experience | Landmark EXP multipliers, schedule template (5 vs 6 weeks), progression posture |
| Recovery rating | Landmark REC multipliers |
| Training phase / goal | NUT multipliers on landmarks, weekly-coach PHASE_CONFIG (goal rates, on-target bands), protein rules, refeed/macro-cycle eligibility |
| Bodyweight + height | BMR/TDEE, FFM floor, strength standards, max-safe-loss gate |
| Manual landmark edits | Outrank EVERYTHING in seeding (only genuine diffs from research count); excluded from learning |
| Goal lock (competition) | Raises ED-detection threshold, unlocks day cycling |
| Diet preference + allergen excludes | Meal suggestions/plans filtering |
| Every setting in CHAPTER B2 §A.1 | As tabulated there |

## OBSERVED (logged behaviour)
| Variable | Downstream effects |
|---|---|
| Sets (weight, reps, actual_reps) | e1RM, PRs, volume attribution, block performance, achieved peaks |
| Session completion vs plan | Adherence ratio (INSUFFICIENT_DATA gate at <0.6), coach confidence |
| Post-session feedback (soreness, joints, pump, exertion) | Muscle recovery aggregates, strain weight, session adjustments |
| Weekly check-in answers | Readiness, recovery grades, deload triggers, coach tone |
| Morning weigh-ins | EWMA display trend, robust decision trend, adaptive TDEE, loss-rate gates |
| Food logging | Calorie adherence (mapCalsAdherence), data-confidence gate |
| Rest-timer + reminder interactions | Notification budget/telemetry only |

## DERIVED (computed, not stored as user input)
e1RM per set → per-exercise trend (Theil-Sen, clamped ±25%) → per-muscle
weighted slope; PR density over eligible exposures with rebound/new-lift
discounts; readiness slope; sleep-flagged weeks; recovery cost weight (0-6);
achieved weekly peak (allocator credit, deload weeks excluded); adherence
ratios; EWMA + robust weight trends; adaptive TDEE delta; strain score.

## LEARNED (persisted memory)
| Store | What it learns | What it can never learn |
|---|---|---|
| Block Ledger (`mesocycles.block_ledger`, synced) | Per-muscle classification, observed start/peak, proposal, suppression marker, seed outcome | Anything from a manual-override block (deferredToManual skipped); nothing under INSUFFICIENT_DATA |
| Learned range (replayed from ledgers, not stored) | Ceiling = highest handled peak (running max, strain pulls down); floor = monotone-down toward lowest progressing start | Ceiling never raised by a suppressed block; floor never moves up; never below research MEV anchor |
| Coach ledger receipts | What was proposed/applied/held and why | - |
| Habit-derived training-reminder weekdays (trainingHabitSchedule, 6-week trailing window of completed workouts), notification budget history | Scheduling niceties (the check-in HOUR is a plain user setting, not learned) | - |

## CONTEXTUAL
Week-in-block (fatigue expectation, peak-week softening), block state
(awaiting decision suppresses live-week claims), days since block end
(≥4 weeks = stale evidence, no upward carry), rebound windows after gaps,
quiet hours, timezone.

## SAFETY (overrides all of the above)
Calm mode (user-set) and open ED-pattern flags (detector-set) OR together
into `suppressed`: no upward carry anywhere (live proposals, ledger holds,
learned ceiling, seeded deload), progress-photo/scan withholding, share-card
withholding, weight/food notification suppression. All reads fail CLOSED
(a failed flag read behaves as flagged). Tier never reaches any safety or
engine module (pure modules are tier-blind by test).

## Dependency sketch

```
PROFILE (sex, age, experience, recovery, phase, weight)
 ├─ VOLUME_LANDMARKS × EXP/REC/NUT/AGE multipliers → per-muscle mev/mav/mrv
 │    ├─ plan generation ramps (template blocks)
 │    ├─ profileAdjustedPrior (seed fallback step 4)
 │    └─ learned-range prior
 ├─ nutritionEngine (BMR → TDEE → targets, floors)
 └─ weeklyCoach PHASE_CONFIG (rates, bands)

TRAINING HISTORY (sets, sessions, feedback)
 ├─ e1RM/PR engine → progress surfaces, strength standards
 ├─ blockMetrics slope + PR density ─┐
 ├─ recovery aggregates ─────────────┼→ classifyMuscleBlock → BLOCK LEDGER
 ├─ adherence ───────────────────────┘        │
 │                                            ├→ resolveSeedRange → next block rows
 │                                            └→ learnedRange (replay) ─┘
 └─ achieved weekly peaks → strain-scaled deload

WEIGH-INS → EWMA/robust trends → adaptive TDEE → calorie targets → diary
CHECK-INS → readiness/recovery grades → weekly coach + block advisor signals
SAFETY FLAGS → suppression across every arrow above that points upward
```

# PART 13 — USER JOURNEYS

Each journey: USER ACTION → SYSTEM STATE → ENGINE DECISION → UI RESPONSE →
DATA WRITTEN → NEXT STATE. Chapter references carry the detail.

**1. Brand-new user.** Installs, opens app → boot splash, no session →
Welcome stack → signs up (Apple/Google/email) → Article 9 consent gate
(cannot skip; declining blocks; transient failure fails CLOSED) → first-run
routing by tier → local DB created (SQLCipher key in secure store), profile
row seeded, exercises seeded → lands on Today tab. (B2 §B-D, C1 §A)

**2. Onboarding (Pro path).** Six-step wizard → biological sex REQUIRED
(no default, progression blocked until chosen; pinned by test) → profile
saved with per-field stamps → landmarks and calorie targets computed from
research + profile → draft persists across kills. (B2 §B.5-B.6)

**3. First programme creation.** Plan library template or builder →
auto-generation fills exercise pools by available equipment/days →
activatePlanWithBlock creates mesocycle (6 planned weeks incl. recovery
week), mesocycle_weeks, planned_muscle_volume rows source `template` from
landmark ramps → Today shows block chip week 1. (A2 §A1, §C)

**4. First workout.** Opens session from Today/Train → logs sets (weight ×
reps; actual_reps recorded); a warm-up ramp is available ON DEMAND from the
exercise overflow sheet (pull, never push — pinned by gymBasics.guard — and
only for weight-based non-cluster exercises) → rest timer (sound + optional
notification; Android chronometer) → finish → summary with tonnage/PRs →
post-session feedback chips → workout + sets written, streak updated,
widgets refreshed, push-on-save sync queued. (A2 §A4-A5, C2 §B)

**5. First completed week.** Sessions accumulate → week 1 rows complete →
Home block chip advances; weekly story builds; adherence recorded →
no coach yet (needs check-in + data confidence). (D1 §A)

**6. First weekly check-in.** Check-in gate opens (cadence + minimum data)
→ 4-step wizard: energy, soreness, training performance (mandatory trio),
sleep/stress/motivation optional → derivations written (readiness,
recovery grade) → weekly coach runs → CoachOutput with cards →
user taps Apply on any proposal or ignores. (D1 §C-D)

**7. First PR.** A set beats the exercise's best e1RM/rep-at-weight →
PR recorded, celebration surface, PR share card available, streak/milestone
checks → feeds PR density in the block metric. (A2 §B2)

**8. Poor recovery week.** Check-in reports low energy + soreness + short
sleep → recovery grade drops; two persistent triggers → weekly coach
proposes deload ("Ease your sets right back this week...") as PROPOSAL →
if applied: next week's rows cut to strain-scaled share of each muscle's
achieved peak (min deloadFloor), RIR 4, source `coach` → coach ledger
receipt written. (A2 §C5, B1 §B)

**9. Missed workout.** Planned session day passes with no log → adherence
ratio falls; streak logic per its rules; training reminder fires next
scheduled slot (unless quiet hours/budget) → no punitive copy (voice rules).
(C2 §A, D2 voice)

**10. Manually edited workout.** User swaps an exercise (swap engine
respects muscle/equipment), edits sets/loads → rows update; e1RM
continuity handles the swap via discontinuity detection (new-lift discount
in block metric) → no penalty, evidence discounted not punished. (A2 §A6, §B6)

**11. Early deload.** Block advisor detects sustained fatigue mid-block
(enough history + high signals) → early_deload card ("Got it, ease off
this week") → applied deload rewrites the coming week light; deload-flag
recorded → that week excluded from peaks; rebound window after it
discounts PR spikes; ledger later counts the flag (+2 strain weight).
(A2 §C4-C5, §D2)

**12. Completed mesocycle.** Final (recovery) week passes → block becomes
completed_awaiting_decision → NOTHING auto-transitions; targets hold at
recovery volume; Home chip says "Block finished. Targets hold..." →
advisor post_recovery card with recommendation. (A2 §C3-C4)

**13. Continue with adjustments.** User taps the adjust CTA → ledger
computed once (idempotent, versioned) → per-muscle seeds resolved
(full proposals) → new block written with per-muscle ramps + strain-scaled
deloadSets → seed outcome recorded on the old block's ledger → block-start
lines on Home sheet narrate the WRITTEN plan ("Chest: 11 sets in week 1,
building to 17 by week 4..."). (A2 §D7-D9)

**14. Repeat programme.** User taps repeat ("Continue this programme") →
TRUE repeat: observed start/planned peak, no deloadSets carry, no proposal
applied → card shows no unapplied-adjustment claims (rationale rows render
only above the adjust button). (A2 §D7)

**15. Second personalised mesocycle.** Block 2 runs from ledger-seeded
ramps → per-muscle divergence is real (a RESPONSIVE +1 muscle climbs, a
retained muscle holds, a STRAINED muscle starts lower) → pinned by the
permanent repeat-vs-adjust regression. (A2 §D)

**16. Several blocks of history.** Learned ranges activate (isLearned
after ≥1 qualifying block): ceiling tracks highest handled peak, floor
eases down to lowest progressing start → seeds prefer valid ledger, fall
back to learned band when a block cannot judge. (A2 §D6)

**17. Insufficient-data block.** Sparse logging (<60% adherence or <4
exposures or <4 recovery points or unsettled measurement) → muscle
classified INSUFFICIENT_DATA with honest copy ("trained too rarely to
judge") → NEVER seeds as ledger; learned band speaks next, else profile →
never teaches the learned range. (A2 §D3, §D7)

**18. Stale muscle.** Flat performance, fine recovery → STALE: volume
holds; second consecutive flat block (or trusted decline) proposes a
stimulus change (variant swap primary, rep-range alternative) rather than
more sets. (A2 §D3)

**19. Strained muscle.** Lost ground + poor recovery → STRAINED: start
cut by 2 (capped at MAV), peak to MAV/plan; recovery week gets the 40-45%
share; rationale states it plainly ("lost ground while recovery ran
poor, so the next block starts 2 sets lower"). (A2 §D3)

**20. Responsive muscle.** Slope ≥ +1.5% with clean recovery → retention
by default; +1 start ONLY with the late-block dose-response pair at
composite confidence ≥ 0.6, never under suppression/stale evidence. (A2 §D3)

**21. Calm mode.** User enables wellbeing calm mode → weight/food-adjacent
notifications suppress; progress photos/scan/before-after card withheld;
coach copy calms; no upward carry anywhere (proposals, seeds, learned
ceiling, seeded deload all hold or degrade; reductions still pass). (Part 19)

**22. ED-safety flag.** Detector opens a flag from logged patterns →
same suppression set as calm mode (OR'd), plus Beat UK signposting;
fail-closed reads mean a broken read behaves as flagged; tier never
consulted. (Part 19, B1 §F)

**23. Nutrition goal change.** User changes phase/goal → PHASE_CONFIG
switches (rates, bands); targets recompute through every floor; landmarks'
NUT multiplier changes next computation; goal-lock prompt if competition
goal. (B1 §A-B, B2)

**24. Rapid or slow weight change.** Robust trend outside phase band →
calorie ladder proposes a step (sized by adherence + confidence). Rapid
loss protection is two-sided and does NOT force maintenance: target
computation caps the prescribed deficit so estimated loss cannot exceed
1.5% BW/week (target stays below maintenance at that cap), and the
observed-rate coach path adds +125 to +300 kcal on a sliding scale — and
only when ALL of: phase is a cut, no cycle override, observed rate
≤ −1.5%/week, AND check-in energy ≤ 2. Caution copy accompanies; floors
re-clamp every output. (B1 §A.7, §B.5, §H)

**25. Returning after time away.** Overdue finished block: evidence ≥4
weeks old = stale → upward proposals suppress, reductions stand; rebound
window discounts comeback PRs; targets held; advisor still waits for the
user's decision (no auto-restart). (A2 §C3, §D2-D3)

**26. Reinstall / new device.** Sign-in restores cloud-owned data (plans,
workouts, sets, mesocycles incl. block_ledger, check-ins, weights, coach
outputs, food, partner) → local-only losses: progress photos/scans,
planned_muscle_volume detail rows (restore gap: pull lands in a mirror
table with no product reader; block-start narration lines simply do not
render), AsyncStorage keys that are genuinely excluded → learned ranges
re-derive from synced ledgers. (C1 §G, A2 §J)

**27. Offline use.** Everything trains/logs/reads offline (local truth);
sync queues; barcode/OCR label lookup needs network only for remote
sources; coach runs locally → on reconnect, push-first then pull with
watermarks. (C1 §E)

**28. Sync conflict.** Same row edited on two devices → last-write-wins
by updated_at (per-table), users_profile merges per-column via
column_updates_at; conflict resolutions emit telemetry; block ledger:
cloud-null never wipes local; stale device cannot regenerate/reopen a
decided block (version idempotency + awaitingDecision precondition).
(C1 §F)

**29. Partner journey.** Pro user sends invite (deep link) → partner
accepts (consent both sides, safety consent) → weekly signals exchange,
shared streak, intentions, milestone moments, cheers (push) → either side
can unpair; free partner hits tier gate with paywall rescue of the
pending invite. (C2 §E)

**30. Subscription change.** Trial start (cardless 14 days) → full Pro →
lapse: cascade downgrades tier; Pro routes gate; Diary/BodyMetrics/
ProgressPhotos become read-only (view yes, log no); data retained; winback
sheet + notification episodes; purchase via Play Billing restores
instantly (optimistic unlock reconciled by RTDN webhook); restore
purchases re-checks entitlement. (B2 §E, §H)

# PART 14 — STATE MACHINES (index + summaries)

Full detail: CHAPTER A2 Part I (block, workout, planned-row source),
CHAPTER B2 Part G (auth, onboarding, subscription/trial, consent),
CHAPTER C1 (sync/queue states), CHAPTER C2 (notification permission states).

**Block (mesocycle):**
```
ACTIVE (week 1..N-1 accumulation)
  → [advisor early_deload applied → coming week rewritten light, still ACTIVE]
  → RECOVERY WEEK (final planned week, is_deload, RIR 4)
  → COMPLETED_AWAITING_DECISION   (terminal until user acts; never auto-
      transitions, never wraps to week 1; targets hold at recovery volume)
  → user taps REPEAT → new block from observed numbers (true repeat)
  → user taps CONTINUE WITH ADJUSTMENTS → new block from ledger seeds
  → user builds a new programme → template block
```
**Workout session:** planned → in progress (resumable after kill) →
finished (summary + feedback) | abandoned (partial sets kept, no completion
events). **Auth:** signed out → signing in (OAuth/email) → signed in
(session restored) → signing out (push-first guard) → signed out.
**Consent:** unset → granted | declined (blocks app) | withdrawn (returns
to gate); transient read failure = NOT consented (fail closed).
**Subscription:** free → trial (14-day cardless) → pro | lapse → free
(read-only guards on Diary/BodyMetrics/ProgressPhotos; winback episodes)
→ paid pro (Play Billing; optimistic unlock reconciled by RTDN).
**Sync queue:** idle → pushing (per-table isolation) → retry backoff on
error → benign-skip taxonomy for known-absent cloud objects.

# PART 19 — SAFETY SYSTEM (synthesis; detail in B1 §A/§F, A2 §E, C2 §A, D1 §B)

## HARD SAFETY RULES (engine-enforced, cannot be personalised away, tier-blind)
| Rule | Enforcement | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Calorie floors 1,500 kcal (male) / 1,200 kcal (female) | Every target computation re-clamps; coachApply re-enforces on apply | nutritionEngine, coachApply |
| FFM energy floor (30 kcal/kg fat-free mass) | Target clamp + weekly-coach second evaluation | nutritionEngine |
| Rapid-loss protection, two-sided: target computation CAPS the deficit so estimated loss cannot exceed 1.5% BW/week (does NOT force maintenance); the observed-rate coach path adds +125 to +300 kcal, gated on the four-part condition (cut phase AND no cycle override AND observed rate ≤ −1.5%/week AND energy score ≤ 2), then the ±5% step cap | nutritionEngine :889-899; weeklyCoach :931-936, :1044-1053 | B1 §A.7, §B.5, §H |
| Max-safe-loss sizing (0.8% BW/week cap) | Deficit sizing clamp | nutritionEngine |
| Suppression = calm mode OR open ED flag OR (per consumer) SCOFF score ≥ 2, all reads fail CLOSED | Caller ORs; 'read_failed' sentinel is truthy; streak surfaces and the coach auto-apply hold include the SCOFF input | blockLedgerRunner, CoachOutputScreen, useWeeklyStreak :112-120, weeklyCoach :1496-1506 |
| Streak/run surfaces withheld entirely under suppression (incl. SCOFF ≥ 2) | StreakWeeksSection returns null | useWeeklyStreak, StreakWeeksSection :67 |
| Calorie bank disabled when the target was floored, during macro-cycle/refeed days, or under an open ED flag (fail-closed read) | bankingAvailable gate | DiaryScreen :422-423, B1 §C |
| Per-day calorie offsets hard-clamped to the sex floor and FFM floor | perDayTargets clamp | food/perDayTargets :11-14 |
| ed_pattern_lockout and ffm_floor_hold are in-app-only categories: they can NEVER push (locked) | channel matrix pins [CHANNEL.IN_APP] only | notifications/categories :109-110, C2 §A.1 |
| Onboarding height gate: progression blocked until a valid height (targets must never compute on an unconfirmed height) | pinned by proOnboarding.heightGate test | B2 §B |
| No upward carry-over under suppression: live proposals hold at previous start / research MEV; ledger holds recorded (upwardCarryPrevented); learned ceiling never raised by a suppressed block; seeded deloadSets withheld (flat MEV week) | interBlock finish() hold; learnedRange skip; blockSeed gates | A2 §D3, §D6, §D7 |
| Stale evidence (≥4 weeks) treated as suppression for upward carry | interBlock | A2 §D3 |
| Weight/food-adjacent notifications suppress under an open ED flag / calm mode | notification scheduler gates | C2 §A |
| Progress photos / scan / before-after share card withheld under calm/ED | isPhotoSuppressed at the render/tier contract point | D1 §B |
| Share cards never carry name/bodyweight/measurements/private notes; single exception: Pro before/after card may show bodyweight, itself withheld under calm/ED | shareCard builders | C2 §F |
| ABSOLUTE_WEEKLY_SET_CEILING = 30 sets/muscle/week backstop on every seed/clamp | coachApply, blockSeed | A2 §E |
| Research MEV floor anchor outranks every cap in seeding/learning; deload is the ONE place MEV is not a floor (founder ruling: deloadFloor = MEV/2, min 1) | blockSeed, learnedRange, coachApply | A2 §D6-D7 |
| Recovery monotonicity: greater strain can only make recovery easier or longer, never harder or shorter | deloadSharePct construction + pinned test | A2 §C5 |
| Unreadable strain fails CLOSED to the smallest recovery dose | clampStrainPoints | A2 §C5 |
| Deload apply can only reduce a row; upward volume apply never targets a recovery week | computeDeloadVolume, upward-apply guard | A2 §C5, D1 §D |
| Data-confidence gate: coach holds calorie moves without enough weigh-in/intake data | assessDataConfidence | B1 §B.2 |
| Article 9 consent fails CLOSED for new users | RootNavigator gate | B2 §D |
| Onboarding sex gate: no default, progression blocked | pinned by test | B2 §B |
| Tier-blindness: no pure engine/safety module reads tier | source-level pins | A2 §E |
| Guardrails never consult tier (free users get every protection) | proGate mandate + pins | B2 §E |

## SOFT COACHING RULES
Deload proposed (never imposed) on ≥2 persistent triggers; 10-day recovery
proposed only with STRAINED + ≥2 systemic signals, always "Your call";
peak-week softening only for observed grade-3, final accumulation week,
no persistence; retention default (RESPONSIVE is never an auto-add);
stimulus change proposed from the second flat block; masters (age-adjusted)
thresholds in the advisor; diet break suggested after sustained deficit.

## UX WARNINGS
Energy-availability caution copy; rapid-loss caution; low-data "building
baseline" states; plateau surfacing framed as information.

## INFORMATIONAL COPY
Beat UK signposting (never removed or gated); calm-mode explanations;
recovery-week purpose copy; block-finished holding copy.

## Escalation / de-escalation
ED flags open from detector patterns and close per detector rules
(goal lock raises the detection threshold for competition preppers);
calm mode is user-controlled; suppression follows flag state instantly;
notification suppression and photo withholding release when flags close.

# PART 21 — USER CONTROL VS AUTOMATION (master matrix)

| Decision | USER CONTROLS | APP PROPOSES | APP AUTO-CHANGES | APP LEARNS | APP CANNOT OVERRIDE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Exercise choice | ✔ (library, swaps) | swap suggestions | – | – | – |
| Sets logged / load / reps | ✔ | warm-up ramp (on demand only, pull never push), progression hints | – | feeds e1RM/PRs | – |
| RIR | – (engine-set targets; deload RIR 4) | – | ✔ per week type | – | – |
| Weekly working volume (in block) | ✔ (edit rows) | weekly coach ±sets | only on user Apply | – | never above rowMrv/30-set backstop |
| Deload (mid-block) | ✔ accept/ignore | ✔ (2+ triggers) | – | strain informs share | can only reduce rows |
| Recovery week (block end) | – (structural) | 10-day extension proposal | week exists by design | strain scales dose | RIR 4; monotonicity |
| Block transition | ✔ ONLY (repeat/adjust/new) | advisor recommends | NEVER | – | cannot auto-transition |
| Next-block per-muscle volume | manual landmark override wins | ledger rationale shown | seeds written on user's tap | ledger + learned range | research-MEV anchor, 30-set ceiling, suppression holds |
| Calorie target | ✔ (goal, manual expectations) | weekly ± ladder, diet break, refeed, macro cycle | adaptive TDEE only via applied targets | TDEE correction from trend | floors, loss gates ALWAYS |
| Goal / phase | ✔ | goal-lock prompt | – | – | – |
| Programme schedule | ✔ | auto-generation | – | – | – |
| Notifications | ✔ per category | – | budget/quiet-hours trimming | habit-derived training-reminder weekdays | ED-flag suppression not user-disableable |
| Progress photos/scan | ✔ capture | retake guidance | – | calibration | withheld under calm/ED |
| Partner interactions | ✔ | – | weekly signals automated once linked | – | consent required both sides |
| Data sync | sign-in implies | – | ✔ continuous | – | sign-out guard pushes first |

Philosophy visible in the matrix: the app AUTOMATES measurement and
interpretation, PROPOSES every change that costs the user effort or risk,
APPLIES only on an explicit tap (except safety clamps, which are absolute),
and LEARNS only from unsuppressed, non-manual, sufficient evidence.

# PART 23 — FEATURE DISCOVERABILITY

**Obvious entry points:** the five tabs, session logger, diary, check-in
card, plan library, settings.

**Contextual-only (state-gated) surfaces:** block decision card (only
post_recovery), early-deload card (only on sustained signals), ledger
rationale rows (only above the adjust CTA), 10-day recovery line (only
STRAINED + systemic corroboration), win-back sheet (lapse state), goal-lock
prompt (competition goals), cycle question (opt-in + female + cadence),
recomp reframe, plateau surfacing, paywall rescue of a pending partner
invite.

**Hard-to-find but behaviour-changing (from B2 §A.3, 14 items):** notable
examples - goal lock lives on the Coach tab, not Settings; manual landmark
editor sits behind the Volume heatmap; per-day calorie offsets behind
targets; quiet hours + push budget interact invisibly; kJ display; cycle
opt-in; diet preference filtering meal suggestions; travel-mode generator
has NO entry point at all (unreachable); rest-timer in-app beeps have no
mute setting (only the OS-notification toggle).

**Hidden gestures/long-press/swipe:** documented per-screen in CHAPTER A1
§5 (e.g. long-press reorder in builders, swipe actions in diary lists,
chip long-press tooltips).

**Screens users may never discover:** BlockReflection (through the old
block's summary), CoachHeldHistory, NutritionEducation, Snapshots (a row
inside Settings > Data), strength-standards detail, glossary entries
reachable only via info icons; six glossary entries are orphaned entirely
(D1 §E). Also on the Consistency screen: the manual weekly session goal
(six chips; the streak target becomes min(plan target, manual goal)) and
the streak pause sheet (1/2/4/8 weeks) — two behaviour-changing controls
that live on a Progress sub-screen, not in Settings.

# PART 24 — EMPTY / ERROR / EDGE STATES (index)

Per-screen empty/loading/error/terminal states: CHAPTER A1 §5 documents all
83 screens. Engine-level edge handling: CHAPTER A2 (INSUFFICIENT_DATA gates,
landmarks-fail-closed, discontinuity), CHAPTER B1 (data-confidence holds,
missing-answer derivations), CHAPTER C1 §C.6/§J (sync failure isolation,
benign-skip taxonomy, snapshot recovery). Highlights the founder asked for:

- **No programme:** Today/Train render empty states with create CTAs; coach
  explains volume changes have nowhere to land.
- **No weight data:** nutrition ladder HOLDS (data-confidence gate) with
  "building baseline" copy rather than guessing.
- **No recovery data:** block classification returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA with
  honest copy; never punishes.
- **Incomplete week / abandoned workout:** partial sets kept; adherence
  reflects reality; no shaming copy (voice contract).
- **Completed block awaiting action:** every surface (Home chip, workout
  banner, plan cards, coach card, Progress headers) states "Block finished"
  rather than a wrapped or live week; pinned by tests.
- **Sync failure:** per-table isolation; user-facing status label; queue
  retries with backoff; sign-out blocked until push succeeds.
- **Offline:** full logging/coaching continues; sync resumes silently.
- **Stale device:** cannot overwrite a decided block or regenerate a ledger
  (version + precondition guards).
- **Missing ledger (pre-campaign blocks):** seeding falls through to
  learned/profile/research; reflection section simply hidden.
- **Corrupted derived data:** unparseable ledger JSON = no evidence (never
  poisons a batch); unreadable strain = most protective dose.
- **Migration mismatch:** additive-only local migrations + dbSnapshot backup
  before each; cloud push of unknown columns caught per-table.
- **Subscription loss:** read-only guards keep data visible (Diary,
  BodyMetrics, ProgressPhotos); everything else Pro gates with upgrade CTA.
- **Deleted exercise:** custom-exercise soft delete syncs; history retained.
- **Notification permission denied:** in-app surfaces carry the load;
  permission re-request flow per platform (C2 §A.7).

# PART 29 — PRODUCT TRUTH TABLE

| Claim | Verdict | Why / limitation | References |
|---|---|---|---|
| "The app adapts training based on your previous block." | TRUE | Block Ledger classifies every muscle at block end and the adjust path writes the next block from it; repeat is a true repeat. Limitation: only when the user taps the adjust CTA; nothing auto-applies. | A2 §D; adaptiveBlock.e2e tests |
| "The app learns muscle-specific volume ranges." | TRUE | learnedRange replays stored ledgers per muscle: running-max ceiling, monotone-down floor, MEV anchor. Limitation: needs ≥1 qualifying (confident, non-manual, unsuppressed) block; range is re-derived, not itself stored. | A2 §D6 |
| "The app adjusts nutrition from weight trends." | TRUE | Robust trend + adherence + confidence drive a deterministic calorie ladder; adaptive TDEE corrects maintenance. Limitation: proposals require the user's Apply; floors clamp everything. | B1 §A-B |
| "The app works offline." | TRUE | Local SQLite is source of truth for every core loop (train, log, coach, diary); sync is additive. Limitation: auth, sync, remote food lookups, push need network. | C1 §E |
| "Coaching is deterministic; no AI decides anything." | TRUE | Pure engines, pinned by tests; recorded product law. The only ML is on-device and non-deciding: the progress-scan vision model (weight+intake outrank it) and the ML Kit text/barcode recognisers in the food scanners. | D2 §A; D1 §B; B1 §D |
| "Every coaching change is explained." | PARTIALLY TRUE | Applied changes carry receipts, rationales and plain-English notes; but D1 Part E lists 20 decisions made without explanation (e.g. display-trend vs decision-trend divergence is undisclosed). | D1 §E |
| "The app protects vulnerable users." | TRUE (as designed) | Calorie floors, loss gates, ED detection, calm mode, fail-closed reads, suppression of upward carry and weight-adjacent surfaces, tier-blind. Limitation: detector coverage is pattern-based, not clinical. | Part 19 |
| "Your data syncs across devices." | PARTIALLY TRUE | 22 registry + ~19 legacy tables sync; but planned_muscle_volume detail (sources/landmark bounds) does not restore into the primary table on a new device, and photos/scans are local-only. | C1 §C, §G |
| "The recovery week is personalised to how hard the block ran." | TRUE | Strain-scaled 60→40% of achieved peak, per muscle, floored at half-MEV, clamped to the block's lightest week and 30 sets; monotonicity pinned. Limitation: withheld (flat MEV) under calm/ED and for true repeats. | A2 §C5, §D7 |
| "Free users get full training logging; Pro adds coaching + nutrition." | TRUE | 24 guarded routes match the recorded tier scope; guardrails are tier-blind; lapse keeps data readable (3 read-only guards). | B2 §E, §H |
| "The app never moves you to a new block by itself." | TRUE | completed_awaiting_decision is terminal until a user tap; pinned across surfaces. | A2 §C3 |
| "Partner features keep you accountable." | TRUE (scoped) | One partner on free, up to three on Pro (maxPartnersForTier, pinned by usePartners.redeemCap test); signals/streaks/cheers; no feed, no followers, no comparison of prescriptions. | C2 §E |
| "Your privacy is protected." | TRUE (with one open finding) | EU-Dublin residency, PII-scrubbed telemetry, share-card PII ban, Article 9 gate. Open finding: the analytics opt-out preference itself appears to ride the bulk pref sync contrary to its module contract (Part 33 F-3). | B2 §D; C2 §H |
| "iOS has feature parity with Android." | FALSE today | iOS ships via TestFlight without home widgets or Live Activity (parked), no FGS rest chronometer; several Android-channel behaviours differ. | C2 §B-D |
| "Cardio is part of the product." | FALSE today (UI) | The logging/history screens exist but the only entry navigates to an unregistered route (dead tap); the engine and sync remain live underneath. | A1 §8 R-1 |

# PART 31 — FIRST 30 / 90 / 180 DAYS

**Day 1.** Everything prescriptive is research + profile: landmarks ×
experience/recovery/age/phase multipliers seed the plan ramp; calories are
formula + activity with floors; copy explains the defaults. Nothing is
learned; the coach holds (data-confidence gate) rather than guessing.

**After the first week.** Personal evidence exists: e1RM baselines, first
PRs, adherence, first check-in → weekly coach begins proposing (volume
nudges sized by signals; calorie ladder only once weigh-in/intake
confidence exists). Streaks/widgets live. Nothing inter-block yet.

**After the first block (~5-6 weeks).** The first Block Ledger exists:
each muscle classified, next block seedable from real response; recovery
week already strain-scaled; learned ranges begin (qualifying muscles);
block-start narration switches from template talk to "set by how your
last block went".

**After 2-3 blocks.** Learned ranges become meaningful: ceilings reflect
the highest handled peaks, floors ease toward proven starts;
INSUFFICIENT_DATA muscles fall back to learned bands instead of research;
stale muscles accumulate priorFlatBlocks toward stimulus-change proposals;
adaptive TDEE has enough trend history to correct maintenance
meaningfully.

**After ~6 months.** The whole prescription stack is personal for
consistently-logged muscles (ledger chain + learned memory + adaptive
TDEE), while safety anchors are unchanged. Evidence ageing applies:
a block left ≥4 weeks undecided goes stale (no upward carry); long
layoffs beyond that have NO decay model yet - the recorded future
training-epoch task (D91-25) covers learned-ceiling freshness after
detraining; nothing is built.

**What never personalises:** safety floors/gates, consent, determinism,
research-MEV anchor, the 30-set backstop, tier-blindness, voice rules.

## Status vocabulary used below

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **LIVE** | Registered in a mounted navigator and reachable from at least one working in-app affordance. |
| **LIVE-CONDITIONAL** | Reachable, but only under a named condition (tier, state, flag, platform, data). |
| **INTERNAL** | Reachable only by developer/diagnostic gesture. |
| **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE** | Registered but with no working entry point today (proved by exhaustive reverse index). |
| **PLANNED-DOCUMENTED-ONLY** | Described in docs/comments, no live code path. |
| **UNCERTAIN** | Could not be resolved from code; recorded in the UNCERTAINTIES section. |

# 1. ENTRY POINTS AND BOOT SEQUENCE

## 1.1 Process entry

- `index.js` — `registerRootComponent(App)`. On Android only, it registers the home-screen widget
  task handler (`react-native-android-widget` → `src/widgets/widgetTaskHandler.js`) inside a
  try/catch, so builds without the widget plugin degrade to a no-op (`index.js:6-19`).
- `App.js` — module scope, before any React work:
  - `SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync()` + `setOptions({ fade: true, duration: 400 })` (`App.js:39-43`).
  - `installGlobalHandlers()` from `src/lib/errorLog` (`App.js:51`).
  - `initSentry({})` (`App.js:59-65`).
  - `tryWireRealProvider()` from `src/lib/payments/playBilling` (`App.js:73-77`).
  - Two `TaskManager.defineTask` registrations: `VOLYUME_REST_TIMER_KEEPALIVE` (iOS JS-thread keepalive
    during rest) and `VOLYUME_DAILY_SYNC` (~12h background `syncAll`, consent-gated, `App.js:86-137`).
  - `Notifications.setNotificationHandler` — foreground banners suppressed except `channelId === 'rest-done'`
    (`App.js:141-155`).

## 1.2 App root render tree (`App.js:1061-1112`)

```
ErrorBoundary                        (App.js top-level crash screen)
└─ GestureHandlerRootView
   └─ KeyboardProvider               (react-native-keyboard-controller)
      └─ BottomSheetModalProvider    (@gorhom/bottom-sheet portal host for every BottomSheet.js)
         └─ SafeAreaProvider (initialMetrics)
            ├─ StatusBar             (live theme via useTheme)
            └─ ToastProvider
               └─ FeedbackProvider
                  ├─ RootNavigator            <-- all navigation lives here
                  ├─ PRCelebration            (overlay, keyed on prCelebration._seq, subdued under calm/reduceMotion)
                  ├─ CrashRecoveryToast       (priorCrash banner)
                  ├─ AppAlertHost             (app-wide alert host)
                  └─ PostLapseSheetHost       (post-churn win-back sheet; navigates ProfileTab→Subscription)
```

`RootNavigator` and `PRCelebration` are lazily `require`d only after `applyAccessibility` has mutated
the theme tokens, so every screen `StyleSheet.create` sees post-accessibility values
(`App.js:144-151`, `App.js:1046-1050`).

## 1.3 Deep-link intake outside React Navigation

`App.js:213-215` + `App.js:610-611`: `Linking.getInitialURL()` and a `Linking` `url` listener call
`handleIncomingDeepLink`, which runs `parseInviteCode(url)` (`src/lib/partners/link.js:40`) and
`rememberPendingPartnerCode(code)`. Partner invite links (`volyume://partner/<CODE>`,
`https://volyume.app/partner/<CODE>`, `src/lib/partners/link.js:7-19`) are therefore captured as
*pending state*, not as a navigation action — the code is redeemed later inside `PartnerScreen`
(`route.params.code` / `pendingInvite`).

---

# 2. ROOT NAVIGATOR — BRANCHING LOGIC

`src/navigation/RootNavigator.js`. Every screen is registered through `lazyScreen()`
(`RootNavigator.js:66-76`) so a screen module is evaluated on first render, never at boot.
`Tab = withScreenBoundaries(createBottomTabNavigator())` and
`Stack = withScreenBoundaries(createStackNavigator())` (`RootNavigator.js:169-170`) wrap **every**
registered screen in a per-route `ScreenBoundary`.

## 2.1 Boot gate

`RootNavigator.js:1536-1538`:

```
if (!splashReady || !firstRunChecked || !tierChecked || !initialAuthResolved) -> <SplashScreen />
```

- `splashReady`: `SPLASH_MIN_MS = 1600` timer (`RootNavigator.js:820`, `:879-882`), released early for
  a returning already-onboarded user (`:890-894`).
- `initialAuthResolved`: one-shot latch set at the first auth resolution; stops a signed-in cold launch
  flashing `WelcomeStack` (`:858-870`).
- The native splash hides exactly when this gate lifts (`:1512-1519`).

## 2.2 Routing priority (`renderNavigator`, `RootNavigator.js:1565-1615`)

```
1. !user                                                        -> <WelcomeStack/>
2. user && !user.isLocal && !firstRunComplete && !healthConsentChecked
                                                                -> <SplashScreen/>   (blocking resolver, ONB-001/002)
3. user && !user.isLocal && healthConsentChecked
      && (healthConsent === false || (healthConsent == null && !firstRunComplete))
                                                                -> <Article9ConsentStack/>   (Article 9 gate, fails closed)
4. !firstRunComplete && tier === 'pro'                          -> <ProOnboardingStack/>
5. !firstRunComplete && tier !== 'pro'                          -> <FirstRunStack/>
6. otherwise                                                    -> <LockedMainTabs/>
```

`LockedMainTabs` (`RootNavigator.js:656-671`) mounts `MainTabs` and overlays
`BiometricLockScreen` while `useAppLockGate()` reports `locked`; it holds `<SplashScreen/>` until the
pref read resolves. MainTabs stays mounted underneath, so an active workout is never unmounted by a
background/foreground cycle.

## 2.3 Container-level wiring

- `NavigationContainer` gets `ref={navigationRef}`, `linking={linking}`, `theme={navTheme}`, and on
  `onReady` calls `instrumentNavigation(navigationRef)` for Sentry screen breadcrumbs
  (`RootNavigator.js:1622-1640`).
- The whole container is wrapped in `SheetIsolationBoundary` (`src/lib/sheetA11yIsolation.js`) which
  hides the screen tree from TalkBack/VoiceOver while any shared BottomSheet is open
  (`RootNavigator.js:1621`).
- Motion: `useStackMotionOverride()` disables push animations when `accessibility.reduceMotion` is on
  (`RootNavigator.js:356-359`). Hero-zoom transitions (`heroZoomTransition`,
  `heroZoomOptions`) apply to ActiveWorkout, WorkoutSummary, PlanDetail, RoutineDetail and
  (origin-aware, via `route.params.__heroOrigin`) ExerciseDetail (`RootNavigator.js:274-351`).

## 3.6 Cross-tab navigation contract

`src/navigation/navigateCrossTab.js` is the ONLY sanctioned way to jump between tab stacks. It pops the
destination tab's stack to root, then `parent.navigate(tab, { screen, params, initial: false })`.
A source guard (`navigationTargets.guard.test.js`) bans hand-rolled `getParent()?.navigate` elsewhere.
A plain `navigate('X')` for a route not registered in the current stack is **silently dropped** — the
"F4 dead-tap bug class" named in `RootNavigator.js:429-432`. Two live instances are recorded in the
Route Audit (R-1, R-2).

## 4.1 Deep links (`RootNavigator.js:759-818`, `app.json`)

Scheme `volyume` plus `https://volyume.app`; Android intent filters for both, `autoVerify: true`
(`app.json` `expo.android.intentFilters`). iOS declares the scheme; **no `associatedDomains` entry**,
so the https universal-link half is Android-only today (see UNCERTAINTIES U-2).

| URL | Resolves to | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `volyume://workout/start` | `HomeTab` → `BuildWorkout` | |
| `volyume://diary` / `volyume://diary/:date?` | `DiaryTab` → `Diary` | `:date` optional local day-key; Pro-gated screen |
| `volyume://routine/:planId` | `PlansTab` → `PlanDetail` | param MUST be `planId` |
| `volyume://progress` | `ProgressTab` → `Analytics` | |
| `volyume://coach` | `ProfileTab` → `CoachOutput` | defaults to current week |
| `volyume://checkin` | `ProfileTab` → `WeeklyCheckIn` | |
| `volyume://partner/<CODE>` | **no route** — captured by `App.js` as a pending invite code | `src/lib/partners/link.js:18` |

Auth gating is implicit: none of these routes exist while `WelcomeStack` / consent / onboarding stacks
are mounted, so the link is a no-op rather than a bypass. Pro gates still apply at render.

## 4.2 Notification-tap destinations (`src/lib/notifications/notificationRoute.js`)

Routed by `RootNavigator.js:900-941` `onTap` → `navigationRef.navigate(tab, { screen, initial: false, params })`
with a 20 × 150 ms readiness retry.

| `data.type` | Destination | Params |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `weekly_checkin` | ProfileTab → WeeklyCheckIn | |
| `year_of_lifts_unlock` | ProgressTab → YearOfLifts | |
| `monthly_recap` | ProgressTab → Analytics | |
| `cascade_gate` | ProfileTab → CascadeGate | `{ variant: 'day14' }` |
| `weekly_coach_ready` | ProfileTab → CoachOutput | |
| `winback` | ProfileTab → Subscription | `{ fromWinback: true }` |
| `partner_cheer` | ProgressTab → Consistency | |
| `checkin_missed` | ProfileTab → WeeklyCheckIn, or ProgressTab → Analytics when `data.slot === 'followup'` | |
| `planned_meal_confirm` | DiaryTab → Diary | |
| `diary_day` | DiaryTab → Diary | `{ date }` when day-key valid. **No scheduler call site sets this type yet** (PLANNED, mapping exists so it cannot dead-end) |
| `trial_day3` | ProfileTab → WeeklyCheckIn, or `HomeTab` root when `data.variant === 'S3'` | |
| anything else | `null` — no navigation | |

Android rest-timer FGS action buttons ("+15s" / "Skip rest") arrive through
`installRestActionBridge()` (`RootNavigator.js:936`), not through navigation.

## 4.3 Widget destinations (`src/widgets/`, `src/lib/widgets/`)

Two Android home-screen widgets declared in `app.json` under the `react-native-android-widget` plugin:

| Widget name | Label | Renderer | Content |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NextSession` | "Next session" | `src/widgets/widgets.js` `NextSessionWidget` | next session name, day label, week label; falls back to "No plan scheduled. Build one in Plans." |
| `WeeklyConsistency` | "Weekly consistency" | `WeeklyConsistencyWidget` | "N of M" sessions, streak weeks; falls back to `NextSessionWidget` when no consistency data |

Data comes from an AsyncStorage snapshot written by `src/lib/widgets/writer.js`
(`writeWidgetSnapshot`, called from `ActiveWorkoutScreen.js:2241` and `WorkoutHistoryScreen`),
read by `src/widgets/widgetTaskHandler.js`. **No `clickAction` is set on either widget** — a grep over
`src/widgets` and `src/lib/widgets` returns no `clickAction` / `WIDGET_CLICK` handler, so tapping opens
the app at its normal launch destination. The task handler's docblock claims "Tapping a widget opens
the app via the volyume:// deep link"; that is documentation-only today (see UNCERTAINTIES U-3).

# 5. SCREEN INVENTORY — ALL 83 SCREEN MODULES

`src/screens` contains 85 entries: 83 screen modules, one `__tests__` directory, and
`paywallExcerpts.js` (a content module, not a screen — consumer `ProUpgradeScreen`; it ships an empty
`EXCERPTS` array, so the paywall review block is dark today, `src/screens/paywallExcerpts.js:11-13`).

Entries are alphabetical by file name.

## ActiveWorkoutScreen
- **Route/key + navigator:** `ActiveWorkout` in `HomeStack`, `FirstRunStack`, `ProOnboardingStack` (hero-zoom transition).
- **Status:** LIVE (HomeStack). The `FirstRunStack` / `ProOnboardingStack` registrations are defensive with no in-stack source (R-3).
- **Entry points:** `HomeScreen.js` (4 call sites — session hero / continue / start), `PlanDetailScreen.js:169` (`HomeTab` → ActiveWorkout), `PlansScreen.js:366`, `RoutineDetailScreen` "Start this workout" (2 × `navigate('HomeTab')`), `BuildWorkoutScreen.js` `navigation.replace('ActiveWorkout')` (2 sites), `WorkoutHistoryScreen.js` "Repeat" (`navigateCrossTab` → HomeTab), `ActiveSessionMiniBar.js:119`.
- **Purpose:** The set-by-set workout logger — the app's largest surface (4,601 lines).
- **Primary content:** `WorkoutHeader`, `StatusStrip`, `ExerciseNav`, `NowCard`, per-exercise `LoggedSetRow` list in a `FlashList`, `RestTimer`, `WorkoutBottomBar`.
- **Primary actions:** log/edit/delete a set, advance exercise, start/extend/skip rest, finish session (`navigation.replace('WorkoutSummary')`).
- **Secondary actions:** add exercise (`ExercisePickerModal`), reorder blocks (`DragReorderList` + `swapAdjacentBlocks`), swap exercise (`rankSwaps` from `swapEngine`), cluster sets (`clusterSet`), warm-up ramp (on demand from the overflow sheet; pull never push, pinned by gymBasics.guard), notes for next time, time-crunch adjustment (`applyTimeCrunch`), readiness tweak (`sessionAdjustments`). (Review correction: plate maths removed from this list — `calculatePlates` has no caller, dropped by D57.)
- **Conditional content:** `starterSession` / `starterRoutineName` params drive the first-session copy (`getStarterSessionMessage`); readiness prompts; cluster/warm-up blocks by exercise type; keep-awake; Android FGS notification (`notifications/activeWorkout`); iOS Live Activity module.
- **Empty state:** `EmptyExerciseView` per exercise with no sets yet (`components/workout/EmptyExerciseView`).
- **Loading state:** no skeleton — the screen is entered with the session already in the store.
- **Error state:** `appAlert` on save/delete failure; `logError` throughout; wrapped by `ScreenBoundary`.
- **Terminal state:** finishing replaces to `WorkoutSummary`; abandoning calls `deleteIncompleteWorkout`.
- **Relevant settings:** default rest timer, auto-start rest, exact rest alerts, rest-finished alert (`SettingsWorkout`); reduce motion; body-weight unit.
- **Engine/data deps:** `lib/database`, `lib/algorithms`, `lib/swapEngine`, `lib/clusterSet`, `lib/mesocycle`, `lib/sessionAdjustments`, `lib/plateMath`, `lib/warmupRamp`, `lib/restSuggest`, `lib/formTips`, `lib/coachGlossary`, `lib/whyThisTemplates`, `lib/workoutRecordLine`, `lib/syncQueue`, `lib/engineTelemetry`, `lib/widgets/writer`, `lib/partners/weekSignalWriter`.
- **Where next:** WorkoutSummary (replace), back to Home.
- **Implementation refs:** `src/screens/ActiveWorkoutScreen.js`; registrations `RootNavigator.js:452, :700, :727`.

- **Where next:** ShareCard, RecapStory, Partner, ExerciseDetail, LiftProgress, CoachOutput, ProgressPhotos, tab root.
- **Implementation refs:** `src/screens/WorkoutSummaryScreen.js`; registrations `RootNavigator.js:453, :509`.

## YearOfLiftsScreen
- **Route/key + navigator:** registered **twice** in `ProgressStack` — as `YearOfLifts` (`RootNavigator.js:518`) and as `RecapStory` (`:519`), same component.
- **Status:** LIVE-CONDITIONAL (needs enough logged history for the story to build).
- **Entry points:** `year_of_lifts_unlock` notification (→ `YearOfLifts`); `AnalyticsScreen.js:851` (`navigate('YearOfLifts')`), `:604` and `:836` (`navigate('RecapStory', recentMonthRecapParams(...))`); `WorkoutSummaryScreen.js:1398,1441` and `BlockReflectionScreen.js:171` (`navigate('RecapStory', { variant: 'block', mesocycleId, blockName })`).
- **Purpose:** The swipeable recap story — one stat per full-screen card, Spotify-Wrapped style.
- **Primary content:** `GradientCard` story cards with a hero number, icon and one line of context; progress pips; cards that do not apply are filtered out at build time.
- **Primary actions:** tap right / swipe to advance, tap left to go back; "Create share image" → `navigate('ShareCard', { milestoneData })` (`YearOfLiftsScreen.js:635`).
- **Secondary actions:** "Done" → `goBack` (4 exits).
- **Conditional content:** `variant` param (`block` vs the year/month recap) and `mesocycleId` / `blockName`; 4 `edFlag` and 3 `wellbeing` reads, 3 `isCalm` — weight-adjacent cards are withheld under calm mode.
- **Empty state:** `EmptyState` (4 usages) when nothing qualifies.
- **Loading state:** the story builds before the first card renders.
- **Error state:** "Couldn't load this" + "Retry" / "Done".
- **Terminal state:** the last card offers Done and the share card.
- **Relevant settings:** calm mode, reduce motion.
- **Engine/data deps:** `lib/database` `getYearOfLiftsData`, `lib/shareCard/recapPayload`, `lib/wellbeing`, `lib/safeFormat`, `lib/engineTelemetry`.
- **Where next:** ShareCard, back.
- **Implementation refs:** `src/screens/YearOfLiftsScreen.js`; registrations `RootNavigator.js:518-519`.

# 7. DESTINATION LISTS

## 7.1 Deep-link destinations (6 routable + 1 non-routing)

1. `volyume://workout/start` → HomeTab / BuildWorkout
2. `volyume://diary` and `volyume://diary/:date` → DiaryTab / Diary
3. `volyume://routine/:planId` → PlansTab / PlanDetail
4. `volyume://progress` → ProgressTab / Analytics
5. `volyume://coach` → ProfileTab / CoachOutput
6. `volyume://checkin` → ProfileTab / WeeklyCheckIn
7. `volyume://partner/<CODE>` and `https://volyume.app/partner/<CODE>` — **not** a navigation
   target; captured by `App.js` as a pending invite code and redeemed inside PartnerScreen.

All six routable paths are also reachable over `https://volyume.app/...` on Android
(`app.json` intent filter, `autoVerify: true`).

## 7.2 Notification destinations (11 mapped types)

WeeklyCheckIn (`weekly_checkin`, `checkin_missed` default, `trial_day3` S1/S2), YearOfLifts
(`year_of_lifts_unlock`), Analytics (`monthly_recap`, `checkin_missed` followup), CascadeGate
(`cascade_gate`), CoachOutput (`weekly_coach_ready`), Subscription (`winback`), Consistency
(`partner_cheer`), Diary (`planned_meal_confirm`, `diary_day`), HomeTab root (`trial_day3` S3).
`diary_day` has no scheduler call site yet (PLANNED-DOCUMENTED-ONLY as a *trigger*; the mapping
itself is live).

## 7.3 Widget destinations (2 widgets, 0 explicit navigation targets)

`NextSession` and `WeeklyConsistency` (`app.json` plugin config; renderers in `src/widgets/widgets.js`).
Neither sets a `clickAction`, so neither navigates to a specific route — tapping opens the app at its
normal launch destination.

# 8. ROUTE AUDIT

## 8.1 Counts

- **116 `<Stack.Screen>` / `<Tab.Screen>` registrations** in `src/navigation/RootNavigator.js`.
- **89 unique route names**, of which **5 are tab route ids** (`HomeTab`, `PlansTab`, `DiaryTab`,
  `ProgressTab`, `ProfileTab`) and **84 are screen routes**.
- **83 screen modules** in `src/screens`. 84 = 83 + 1, because `YearOfLiftsScreen` is registered under
  two names (`YearOfLifts` and `RecapStory`).
- **Every one of the 83 screen modules is registered at least once** — there are no orphaned screen
  files, and every registered route name is documented in §5 above. **No misses.**

Routes registered more than once: `ProUpgrade` ×5; `ActiveWorkout`, `FreeStarter`, `PlanDetail`,
`PlanLibrary`, `ShareCard` ×3; `BodyMetrics`, `CardioHistory`, `CoachReview`, `ExerciseDetail`,
`LogCardio`, `Methodology`, `NutritionEducation`, `PrivacyPolicy`, `ProgressPhotos`, `VolumeHeatmap`,
`WorkoutHistory`, `WorkoutSummary` ×2.

## 8.2 Findings — broken navigation (dead taps, the F4 class)

These are `navigate('X')` calls issued from a screen whose stack does **not** register `X`.
React Navigation drops them silently; the rule is stated in `RootNavigator.js:429-432` and the
sanctioned fix is `navigateCrossTab` (`src/navigation/navigateCrossTab.js`).

**R-1 — The entire cardio surface is unreachable. (Highest severity.)**
`YouScreen.js:493` calls `navigation.navigate('LogCardio')` from `ProfileStack`, where `LogCardio`
is **not** registered (it is registered in `DiaryStack`, `HomeStack` and `ProgressStack`). A repo-wide
grep for `'LogCardio'` returns exactly three call sites: `YouScreen.js:493`,
`CardioHistoryScreen.js:227`, and the stale comment at `RootNavigator.js:458` ("Cardio is launched
from the Today tab's CardioCard" — no CardioCard exists in `HomeScreen.js`). `AnalyticsScreen` was
deliberately stripped of its cardio entry by founder ruling 2026-08-06, pinned by
`src/screens/__tests__/progressAndBrief.founderRulings.guard.test.js:33`, and the You-tab row was added
as the replacement (`YouScreen.js:484-495`) — but the route registration was not moved with it.
Consequence: `LogCardioScreen` and, transitively, `CardioHistoryScreen` (whose only entry is
`LogCardioScreen.js:175`) are both unreachable in the shipped app. Cardio data can still arrive from
the health store, but the user has no way to log it by hand.

**R-2 — `ProSetupComplete` → `NotificationSettings` is a dead tap.**
`ProSetupCompleteScreen.js:268` calls `navigation.navigate('NotificationSettings')` from
`ProOnboardingStack`, which registers only `ProOnboarding`, `PlanLibrary`, `PlanDetail`,
`ActiveWorkout`, `ProSetupComplete`, `NutritionEducation`, `Methodology`. The row fires only when
notification permission was **not** granted, so it is the exact case where the user most needs it.

**R-4 — `MesocycleBuilder` → `BlockReflection` is a dead tap.**
`MesocycleBuilderScreen.js` calls `navigate('BlockReflection')` and "Start a new block" in
`BlockReflectionScreen.js` calls `navigate('MesocycleBuilder')`. `MesocycleBuilder` is registered only
in `PlansStack`; `BlockReflection` is registered only in `ProfileStack`. Both directions cross a stack
boundary with a bare `navigate`. `BlockReflectionScreen` therefore has no working entry point today,
and its own "Start a new block" would also fail from within `ProfileStack`.

**R-6 — `ProUpgrade` → `SubscriptionPolicy` works in only one of five stacks.**
`ProUpgradeScreen.js:617` calls `navigate('SubscriptionPolicy')`. `ProUpgrade` is registered in all
five tab stacks; `SubscriptionPolicy` is registered only in `ProfileStack`
(`RootNavigator.js:579`). Opening the paywall from Home, Train, Nutrition or Progress therefore leaves
the policy link dead. (Same shape, lower severity: `SubscriptionScreen.js:131` → `CascadeGate` and
`:135` → `ProUpgrade` are both safe, since Subscription is only registered in `ProfileStack` where both
targets exist.)

## 8.3 Findings — registered but with no navigation source

**R-3 — Onboarding-stack duplicates.** `FirstRunStack` and `ProOnboardingStack` each register
`PlanLibrary`, `PlanDetail` and `ActiveWorkout` (6 registrations). No screen inside either stack
navigates to them: `FirstRunScreen` only reaches `FreeStarter`; `FreeStarterScreen`'s browse action is
rendered only when `!fromFirstRun` (`FreeStarterScreen.js:242`) and in any case targets `PlansTab`,
which does not exist during onboarding; `ProOnboardingScreen` only replaces to `ProSetupComplete`.
These six registrations are dead weight today (defensive, or left from an earlier onboarding shape).

**R-5 — Cross-stack duplicate registrations with no in-stack source.**
- `ExerciseDetail` in `PlansStack` (`:484`) — every real entry is a cross-tab jump into `ProgressTab`,
  or an in-stack push from `LiftProgress` (ProgressStack).
- `CoachReview` in `ProgressStack` (`:511`) — the only caller is `HomeScreen.js:1604`.
- `VolumeHeatmap` in `HomeStack` (`:455`) — the only caller is `AnalyticsScreen.js:743`.
- `LogCardio` in `HomeStack` (`:460`) and `ProgressStack` (`:523`) — see R-1.
- `CardioHistory` in `ProgressStack` (`:524`) — see R-1.

**R-7 — `MealNames` is unreachable by explicit founder order.** `SettingsScreen.js:68-71` records the
2026-07-13 removal verbatim and states the route stays registered deliberately. Documented, intentional,
not a defect.

**R-8 — `QuizTraining` and `PlanPreview` are dark behind a flag.**
`ONBOARDING_QUIZ_FIRST = false` (`src/lib/onboarding/quizFlow.js:25`, founder decision 2026-06-26).
Registered always, "harmless" per `RootNavigator.js:677-678`. Reversible by one constant.

## 8.4 Other route-level observations

- `RecapStory` and `YearOfLifts` are the same component under two names; `RecapStory` carries a
  `variant` param (`block` / month recap). Any future divergence must keep both registrations.
- `ProUpgrade` is registered in the Diary stack specifically because every Diary route is Pro-gated and
  `ProGate` navigates to it (`RootNavigator.js:429-433`) — a deliberate defence against exactly the
  F4 class described above.
- The `linking` config names only routes inside `MainTabs`, which is what makes deep links
  auth-safe (`RootNavigator.js:746-755`).

# 10. UNCERTAINTIES

**U-1 — Whether the dead taps in §8.2 are truly dead at runtime.**
The classification rests on React Navigation v6 bubbling: an unmatched `navigate` bubbles to the
parent navigator, which for `MainTabs` only knows the five tab route ids, and then to the root, which
has none. The codebase asserts this behaviour itself (`RootNavigator.js:429-432`, "React Navigation
silently DROPS a navigate to a route the stack has not registered (the F4 bug class)", and
`navigateCrossTab.js`'s header, "a plain `navigation.navigate('Screen')` silently no-ops when the
target lives in a different stack ... already bitten once in production"). I have not executed the app,
so R-1, R-2, R-4 and R-6 are derived from that documented rule plus the registration lists, not from a
device observation. Each should be confirmed on a green build before remediation is scoped.

**U-2 — iOS universal links.** `app.json` sets `expo.scheme = "volyume"` and Android intent filters for
both `volyume://` and `https://volyume.app`, but there is no `expo.ios.associatedDomains` entry. Whether
the `https://volyume.app` half of `linking.prefixes` resolves on iOS therefore could not be established
from the repo; on the evidence present it does not.

**U-3 — Widget tap behaviour.** `src/widgets/widgetTaskHandler.js`'s docblock says "Tapping a widget
opens the app via the `volyume://` deep link", but neither `src/widgets/widgets.js` nor
`src/lib/widgets/*` sets a `clickAction`. Either the library's default launch behaviour is being relied
on, or the intended per-widget deep link was never wired. Cannot be resolved without running the
Android build.

**U-4 — `ScanLabel` direct entry.** The screen's docblock describes "Two entry contexts", the second
being a direct "snap a label" entry with no `prefillBarcode`. No affordance in `src` produces that
entry today — the only caller is `ScanBarcodeScreen.js:181` on a miss. Unclear whether the direct entry
was removed or never shipped.

**U-5 — `SubscriptionPolicy` entry from Settings.** Its docblock says "Linked from Settings > Account
and ProUpgradeScreen", but `SettingsAccountScreen.js` (84 lines, read in full) has no such row. Only the
`ProUpgrade` link exists.

**U-6 — `HomeStack`'s `LogCardio` registration rationale.** `RootNavigator.js:458-459` says cardio "is
launched from the Today tab's CardioCard". No `CardioCard` component exists and `HomeScreen.js` contains
no cardio navigation. The comment is stale; whether the card was removed deliberately or lost is not
recorded in the file.

**U-7 — Per-screen empty/loading/error copy completeness.** For the largest screens
(ActiveWorkout 4,601 lines, CoachOutput 3,522, ProgressPhotos 2,643, Diary 2,523) the states listed in
§5 were derived from component usage counts (`EmptyState`, `Skeleton`, `SkeletonCard`,
`ActivityIndicator`, `appAlert`, `useToast`) plus extracted title/`actionLabel` strings, not from an
exhaustive read of every conditional branch. The states named are proven present; the lists may not be
exhaustive for those four screens.

**U-8 — `withProGuard` on non-route components.** `SettingsHealthScreen`, `WeeklyStoryScreen`,
`WorkoutSummaryScreen` and `CoachOutputScreen` each reference `withProGuard` in their own source as
well as being wrapped at registration. Whether those in-file references gate sub-sections or are
comments could not be settled without a full read of each; they do not affect route-level reachability.

**U-9 — `PostLapseSheetHost` trigger conditions.** It is mounted at the app root and navigates to
`ProfileTab` / `Subscription`, gated by `shouldShowPostLapseSheet()` (`lib/payments/winbackState.js:104`).
The exact eligibility window was not traced; it is a navigation *source*, and that is what is recorded
here.

# 11. SUMMARY FOR THE PRODUCT MAP

- **83 screen modules**, **84 screen route names**, **89 route names including the 5 tab ids**,
  **116 registrations** across **9 navigators** (5 tab stacks + Welcome, Article 9, FirstRun,
  ProOnboarding), inside one root `NavigationContainer`.
- **5 tabs:** Today / Train / Nutrition / Progress / Coach (internal ids `HomeTab`, `PlansTab`,
  `DiaryTab`, `ProgressTab`, `ProfileTab` — kept stable for deep links and push routing).
- **4 gates before the tabs:** boot splash → auth → Article 9 health consent (un-skippable, fails
  closed) → first run (free or Pro branch). Plus an optional biometric app lock over MainTabs.
- **Pro gating (both bases, review correction):** 21 distinct `withProGuard` components across 24 registrations; 3 distinct `withReadOnlyProGuard` components across 5 registrations (Diary,  BodyMetrics,
  ProgressPhotos — "view yes, log no" for lapsed users). `ProUpgrade` is registered in all five stacks
  so no gate can dead-end.
- **~45 component-level sheets and modals** wired from screens, all presenting through the single
  root `BottomSheetModalProvider` and isolated from TalkBack by `SheetIsolationBoundary`.
- **Reachability defects found:** 4 dead-tap sites (R-1, R-2, R-4, R-6), of which R-1 makes the whole
  cardio-logging surface unreachable; 11 registrations with no navigation source (R-3, R-5);
  1 intentionally unreachable route (R-7); 2 flag-dark routes (R-8).

# CHAPTER A2 — TRAINING SYSTEM + ADAPTIVE MESOCYCLE ENGINE (covers PARTS 4, 5; training half of 12; block/workout machines of 14)

# A2 — TRAINING SYSTEM AND ADAPTIVE MESOCYCLE ENGINE

Full product + system map, lane A2. Built read-only from the repository at
`/home/user/ADPhysique` on 2026-08-09. Every claim carries a repo-relative
path + symbol. Nothing here was inferred from documentation alone: where a
doc and the code disagree, the code is recorded and the disagreement is
listed under UNCERTAINTIES.

## Evidence key

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **LIVE** | Reachable in production from a user action, on the current main tree. |
| **LIVE-CONDITIONAL** | Reachable only when a named condition holds (tier, block state, data volume, flag). The condition is always named. |
| **INTERNAL** | Exported and exercised only by other lib modules or tests; no screen consumes it directly. |
| **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE** | Exported, tested, but with zero production callers. Dead in the shipped app. |
| **PLANNED-DOCUMENTED-ONLY** | A parameter/seam exists in code but nothing supplies it; the behaviour is documented, not delivered. |
| **UNCERTAIN** | Recorded in UNCERTAINTIES; not asserted here. |

## Decision-rule classification key

| Class | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **INFORMATIONAL** | Displays a read; changes no stored state. |
| **AUTOMATIC** | The app writes without asking. |
| **PROPOSAL** | Computed and shown; a separate explicit user tap writes it. |
| **REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION** | A modal/alert stands between the tap and the write. |
| **MANUAL-ONLY** | Only a user edit produces it; the engine never writes it. |

## Standing architectural facts for this lane

- Every judgement module in the adaptive chain is **pure**: no `Date.now`, no
  `Math.random`, no `AsyncStorage`/`supabase`/store, and no reference to
  `tier`. Mechanically pinned in
  `src/lib/__tests__/adaptiveBlock.e2e.test.js` → `describe('purity of the
  whole chain')`, which greps `interBlock.js`, `blockSeed.js`,
  `learnedRange.js`, `blockLedgerGather.js`, `blockExplain.js`.
- Exactly two impure layers exist: `src/lib/blockLedgerRunner.js` (fetch +
  orchestrate) and `src/lib/database.js` (persist).
- **No AI anywhere in this lane.** Confirmed by reading every module listed.
- Local SQLite is device truth; `planned_muscle_volume` is the plan-of-record
  the whole explanation layer reads back from.

| Hardcoded fallback pool | `src/lib/planEngine.js` → `POOL` (line 466) | **LIVE-CONDITIONAL** — used when the library load fails or a muscle is thin (`MIN_GENERATED_PER_MUSCLE = 3`, `planEngine.js:643`) |
