# CHAPTER B1 — NUTRITION + FOOD SYSTEM (covers PART 6; nutrition half of 12)

# B1 — NUTRITION + FOOD SYSTEM MAP (engine-first)

Repository: `/home/user/ADPhysique` (VOLYUME). Read-only archaeology, code as at 2026-08-09.
All references are repo-relative `path:line` or `path` + symbol. British English. No em dashes.

**Evidence legend**
- **LIVE** — reachable in production on a normal user path.
- **LIVE-COND(x)** — reachable only under the named condition (tier / state / data / platform / preference).
- **INTERNAL** — used only by other engine code, never surfaced directly.
- **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE** — exported and tested but no production caller.
- **PLANNED-DOC-ONLY** — described in code comments/docs, not built.
- **UNCERTAIN** — see the UNCERTAINTIES section.

**Tier headline.** Everything nutrition/food sits behind Pro. `src/navigation/RootNavigator.js:232-252`
gates the whole Diary domain plus every food sub-screen with `withProGuard`; the Diary root itself uses
`withReadOnlyProGuard` (`src/components/ProGate.js:326-357`) so a free user who already has food history keeps
read-only access, and a user with none gets `ProLocked` (with the `TodaysPlateTeaser` show-then-sell for
feature keys `'Food diary'` / `'Nutrition'`, `src/components/ProGate.js` `showPlateTeaser`).
Tier resolves in `src/lib/proGate.js` (`PRO_BETA_ACTIVE = false`, `_resolveTier`, `isPaidTier`).
**Every ED-safety guardrail below is tier-blind** — none of `nutritionEngine.js`, `edPatternDetector.js`,
`coachApply.js` floors, or `weeklyCoach.js` hold logic reads tier (`proGate.js:22-23` states the mandate;
verified by grep: no `tier` reference in any of those modules).

---

# A. THE NUTRITION ENGINE — `src/lib/nutritionEngine.js` (1,189 lines, pure, zero imports)

Module contract (`:1-6`): "Pure-function nutrition target calculator … No side effects, no DB calls, no
imports, just math." This is the deterministic-engine guarantee of CLAUDE.md §2 at file level.

## A.1 Live callers of `calculateNutritionTargets`

| Caller | Path | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Nutrition Targets screen (recalculate) | `src/screens/NutritionTargetsScreen.js:478` | LIVE-COND(Pro) |
| Pro goal setup (goal/phase change) | `src/screens/ProGoalSetupScreen.js:308` | LIVE-COND(Pro) |
| Pro onboarding (first targets) | `src/screens/ProOnboardingScreen.js:892`, `:1552` | LIVE-COND(Pro onboarding) |

All three route through the single input builder `buildNutritionEngineInputs`
(`src/lib/coachingGoals.js:345-388`) — created precisely so onboarding and the update flow cannot drift on
`bodyFatSource` (comment at `:331-344` records the historic bug where they did).

`getPlanNutritionContext` (`nutritionEngine.js:1032-1189`) — **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE**. Grep shows the only
non-self references are `src/lib/__tests__/nutritionEngine.test.js`. Its `recoveryModifier`,
`volumeCeiling`, `failureExposureLevel`, `deloadFrequencyWeeks`, `refeedRecommendation` and its own
embedded adaptive-TDEE call therefore feed nothing live. (The live refeed path is `coachApply.computeRefeedDay`
— the file says so at `coachApply.js:181-183`.)

## A.2 BMR — formula selection

`calcBMR(sex, ageYears, heightCm, weightKg, bodyFatPercent, bodyFatSource)` `nutritionEngine.js:584-606`.

- **INPUTS**: sex, clamped age/height/weight, body fat %, body fat source.
- **DECISION**: Katch-McArdle (`370 + 21.6 × LBM`, `LBM = weight × (1 − BF%/100)`) is used only when
  `Number.isFinite(bodyFatPercent) && bodyFatPercent > 0 && bodyFatPercent < 60 &&
  isBaselineBodyFatSource(bodyFatSource)`. Otherwise Mifflin-St Jeor:
  male `10w + 6.25h − 5a + 5`; anything else `10w + 6.25h − 5a − 161`.
- **SAFEGUARDS**: the `0 < BF% < 60` band mirrors `computeFFMFloor`'s band so a corrupt reading cannot
  poison lean-mass maths (`:587-592`). Source vocabularies:
  - `isAuthoritativeBodyFatSource` (`:573-575`) = `dexa | caliper | bia` — the only sources that may
    drive the **FFM safety floor**.
  - `isBaselineBodyFatSource` (`:577-582`) = the above plus `visual | manual | self_reported` — may drive
    the **starting baseline** (BMR formula, protein basis) but never the floor.
  - `photo_scan` is deliberately in NEITHER list (pinned by `src/lib/__tests__/ffmFloor.test.js:35` and
    `nutritionEngine.test.js:684`), so a photo-derived body fat can never gain Katch-McArdle or floor authority.
- **OUTPUT**: `{ bmr, formula: 'katch_mcardle'|'mifflin', lbm }`; surfaced as
  `bmrFormula: 'Lean mass-adjusted formula' | 'Standard calorie formula'` (`:961`).
- **USER EXPLANATION**: the string above, plus the confidence line from `calcConfidence` (`:708-718`):
  dexa/caliper `high`, bia `medium`, visual/manual/self_reported/photo_scan `low`, none `medium`. Copy at
  `src/screens/NutritionTargetsScreen.js:86-90` (`CONFIDENCE_LABELS`), including the explicit
  "Useful for a starting baseline, not a safety floor."

## A.3 TDEE / maintenance and activity factors

`ACTIVITY_MULTIPLIERS` `nutritionEngine.js:19-25`: `sedentary 1.2, light 1.375, moderate 1.55,
active 1.65, very_active 1.725`. Header comment `:12-18` records that `active`/`very_active` were tuned DOWN
from 1.725/1.9 for a gym-only population, cites Pontzer 2016 and the contesting Davy 2025, and tells the user
to compare a 4-week trend.

`maintenanceKcal = round(bmr × multiplier)`, unknown level falls back to `1.55` (`:854-855`).
Mapping from schedule: `daysToActivityLevel` (`coachingGoals.js:324-329`) — `<=2 light`, `<=4 moderate`,
`<=5 active`, else `very_active`. Note the user never picks an activity level directly; it is derived from
training days per week. **LIVE**.

## A.4 Goal rates and surplus/deficit sizing

`PHASE_ADJUSTMENTS` `:27-34` (fraction of maintenance):
`lean_gain +0.10`, `build +0.17`, `maintain 0`, `recomp −0.05`, `mild_cut −0.13`, `aggressive_cut −0.22`.
`PHASE_LABELS` `:36-43` give the user-facing names.

Experience scaling applies **to surpluses only** (`:861-865`), via `SURPLUS_EXP_MULT` `:791-796`:

| experience | lean_gain × | build × |
|---|---|---|
| beginner | 1.30 | 1.25 |
| intermediate | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| advanced | 0.65 | 0.80 |
| competitive | 0.50 | 0.65 |

Sources cited in comment: PMC10620361 (2023 RCT), Barakat 2020. Deficits are never scaled by experience.

`GAIN_RATE_TARGETS` `:800-805` (kg/week, emitted as `gainRateTargetMin/Max`):
beginner 0.25–0.50, intermediate 0.15–0.30, advanced 0.05–0.20, competitive 0.03–0.15.

Reachability: `aggressive_cut` is selectable **only** on `NutritionTargetsScreen` (`GOALS` at
`:68-75`) and is **filtered out under calm mode** (`:622`, `:817`:
`GOALS.filter(g => !(calm && g.key === 'aggressive_cut'))`). It is NOT in `TRAINING_PHASES`
(`coachingGoals.js:223-293`), so the goal/phase picker cannot reach it. `recomp` maps 1:1.
So: `aggressive_cut` = **LIVE-COND(Nutrition Targets screen, calm mode off)**.

## A.5 Macro derivation

Order of operations in `calculateNutritionTargets` (`:807-990`): clamp inputs → BMR → TDEE → phase
adjustment → **sex floor** → **loss-rate gates** → **EA caution** → protein → fat → carbs as the remainder.

**Protein** — `calcProtein` `:721-764`, tables `PROTEIN_APPROACHES` `:63-96`.

| approach | display range | LBM rates (lean_gain/build/maintain/recomp/mild_cut/aggressive_cut) | BW rates | floor g/kg BW |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| standard | 2.0–2.7 g/kg | 2.5 / 2.5 / 2.3 / 2.6 / 2.8 / 3.0 | 2.2 / 2.2 / 2.0 / 2.2 / 2.5 / 2.7 | 2.0 |
| optimised (default) | 2.2–3.0 g/kg | 2.8 / 2.8 / 2.6 / 2.9 / 3.1 / 3.2 | 2.5 / 2.5 / 2.2 / 2.6 / 2.8 / 3.0 | 2.2 |
| advanced | 2.5–3.2 g/kg | 3.0 / 3.0 / 2.8 / 3.1 / 3.2 / 3.3 | 2.8 / 2.8 / 2.5 / 2.8 / 3.0 / 3.2 | 2.5 |
| custom | "Your value" | null | null | 1.2 |

- **DECISION**: basis is `lbm` when `lbm > 0 && isBaselineBodyFatSource(bodyFatSource)`, else `bodyweight`
  (`:744-761`). `custom` applies the user rate to **bodyweight** (coach convention, `:736-742`).
- **SAFEGUARDS**: `custom` with no value silently falls back to `optimised` so a null table cannot be
  dereferenced (`:722-732`, records the Hermes crash it fixed). Custom rate clamped to
  `PROTEIN_CUSTOM_MAX_GKGBW = 3.5` (`:136`). Result floored at `approach.floor × weightKg` (`:733`, `:763`).
  Auto-selection: `ADVANCED_PROTEIN_GOALS` (`:783-786`, the seven physique divisions) auto-picks `advanced`
  unless the caller specifies (`:837-838`).
- A second, separate cap `PROTEIN_MAX_GKGBW = 2.2` (`:131`, Morton 2018 upper CI) lives only in
  `getPlanNutritionContext` — **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE** (see A.1). The live path has no 2.2 cap.
- **OUTPUT**: `proteinG`, `proteinGPerKg`, `proteinGPerKgLbm`, `proteinBasis`, `proteinApproach`,
  `proteinRateUsed`, plus `perMealProteinG` and `mealFrequency` (`:954-955`: 5 meals for
  `aggressive_cut`, else 4; cited to Mamerow 2014 and Frontiers Nutrition 2024).

**Fat** — `FAT_TARGETS_GKG` `:142-149`: lean_gain 1.0, build 0.9, maintain 1.0, recomp 0.85, mild_cut 0.8,
aggressive_cut 0.75 (g/kg BW). Hard floor `max(0.5 × weightKg, 40 g)` (`:933`) — a hormonal minimum.

**Carbs** — pure remainder: `carbKcal = max(targetKcal − proteinKcal − fatKcal, 0)` (`:937`), `/4`.
Energy constants `:98-100`: protein 4, carb 4, fat 9.

**Reconciliation** — `actualTargetKcal = proteinKcal + fatKcal + carbKcal` (`:941`), so the emitted
`targetKcal` is macro-consistent, not the pre-rounding figure. Band `kcalMin/kcalMax = ±10%` (`:944-945`);
this band is what the meal-plan assembler and the calorie bank treat as the engine's published tolerance.

## A.6 SAFETY — sex calorie floors (HARD SAFETY RULE)

`nutritionEngine.js:874-881`: `kcalFloor = sex === 'male' ? 1500 : 1200`. If the phase target lands below it,
a warning is pushed and the target is **raised**; `floorApplied = true`.

`floorApplied` (`:869-873`, `:986`) is the **structured** contract: the comment states downstream consumers
must gate on this flag, never on warning-string matching. Consumers:
- `mealPlanAssembler.targetWasFloored` (`src/lib/food/mealPlanAssembler.js:62-67`) — flag first, regex over
  persisted warnings only as a back-compat fallback for old snapshots.
- `dayVariantTargets` refuses to cycle a floored target (`mealPlanAssembler.js:94`).
- `DiaryScreen` disables calorie banking on a floored target (`src/screens/DiaryScreen.js:422-423`).

The same floor is **re-enforced at the apply boundary**: `src/lib/coachApply.js:29-38`
(`KCAL_FLOOR = 1200`, `KCAL_FLOOR_MALE = 1500`, `kcalFloorForSex`). The header at `:22-28` records the
2026-07-01 CRITICAL audit finding that the Apply path used to floor everyone at 1200, letting a male target
be written below 1500. A third copy lives in `src/lib/food/calorieBank.js:149-151` (`sexFloorKcal`).

Copy: the technical floor lines are collapsed into one plain banner on `NutritionTargetsScreen.js:1330-1340`
— "Your numbers came out below the minimum we hold targets at, so we raised them. The target above is your
safe minimum. Eating below it would work against your training, recovery and health."
Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE**.

## A.7 SAFETY — loss-rate gates (HARD + SOFT)

`nutritionEngine.js:101-103`: `MAX_SAFE_LOSS_RATE = 0.008` (0.8 %BW/wk), `HARD_GATE_LOSS_RATE = 0.015`
(1.5 %BW/wk), `KCAL_PER_KG_FAT = 7700`.

`estimateWeeklyRate` `:766-771` = `(targetKcal − maintenanceKcal) × 7 / 7700`.

At `:887-906`, when `targetKcal < maintenanceKcal`:
- `lossFraction > 1.5%` → **HARD GATE**: warning pushed, then
  `targetKcal = round(maintenanceKcal − (0.015 × weight × 7700)/7)` and `floorApplied = true`.
  Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE**.
- `1.5% >= lossFraction > 0.8%` → warning only, target unchanged:
  "…exceeds the recommended 0.8 % threshold. Consider slowing the rate to preserve muscle mass."
  Classification: **SOFT COACHING RULE / UX WARNING**.

The 1.5% threshold is shared, and the codebase deliberately keeps three consumers in agreement at exactly
`-1.5`: the coach's `rapidLossOverride` (`weeklyCoach.js:931-936`), the `rapidWeightLossFlag`
(`weeklyCoach.js:1256-1266`, comment F3/EN-9 records the boundary-disagreement fix), and the ED detector's
`RAPID_LOSS_PCT_PER_WEEK` (`edPatternDetector.js:30`).

## A.8 SAFETY — FFM energy floor (HARD SAFETY RULE)

`FFM_FLOOR_KCAL_PER_KG = 30` (`nutritionEngine.js:117`), sourced to IOC RED-S consensus
(Mountjoy 2014 BJSM 48:491-497; Mountjoy 2023 BJSM 57:1073-1097, DOI 10.1136/bjsports-2023-106994).

`computeFFMFloor(weightKg, { bodyFatPercent, bodyFatSource, sex })` `:628-657`:
- Throws on non-positive/non-finite weight (`:629-631`) — callers guard for this (see `weeklyCoach.js:984-996`
  and `DiaryScreen.js:249-257`).
- `credibleBF` requires `0 < BF% < 60` **and** `isAuthoritativeBodyFatSource` (dexa/caliper/bia only).
  Then `ffmKg = weight × (1 − BF%/100)`, `source: 'katch_mcardle'`.
- Otherwise `FFM_FALLBACK_FRACTION` (`:124-127`): male `0.78`, female `0.72`, unknown → male fraction.
  Comment `:119-123`: chosen so the floor errs HIGH (more protective).
- `floorKcal = round(ffmKg × 30)`.

Enforcement points:
1. **Inside the adaptive resize** — `computeAdaptiveTDEEAdjustment` `:386-404`. Fires only when the caller
   supplies `ffmFloorContext` with `recentIntakeDaysLogged >= 5`. If `recentIntakeAvgKcal <= floorKcal` and
   the adjustment is negative, the adjustment is clamped to 0, `floorHeld = true`, and the insight is
   replaced with the named floor explanation (`:402`). Increases are never clamped.
2. **In the weekly coach** — `weeklyCoach.js:1109-1154`. Independent gate: same 5-day data bar, weight falls
   back to today's EWMA when the profile weight is null (`:1126-1128`; the comment records the Wave-3 blocker
   where a null profile weight let a cut through). A pending negative `calorieAdjustment` is nulled and
   `ffmFloorHeld = true`; a held-decision row of `type: 'ffm_floor'` is pushed at `:1437-1442`.
3. **In the calorie bank / per-day / diary floor** — `safeDayFloorKcal({ sex, ffmFloorKcal })`
   (`src/lib/food/calorieBank.js:159-163`) = `max(sex floor, FFM floor)`. Computed live in
   `DiaryScreen.js:248-258` and `PerDayTargetsScreen.js:52-60`.

Data feed: `getRecentIntakeSummary` (`src/lib/food/db.js:618-640`) — 7-day local-calendar window over
`daily_intake_rollups`, `avgKcal` divided by **days logged**, not by 7 (`:610-615`), `daysLogged` = distinct
days with `entries_count > 0`.

User copy (identical wherever it fires):
"Precision Coaching has held your calorie target. Your seven-day average intake of N kcal is at or below your
safety floor of M kcal. Eating below this level for long stretches can compromise recovery and lean mass."
(`nutritionEngine.js:402`; the coach's held-decision variant at `weeklyCoach.js:1440`; the `why` line
`ffm_floor_hold` at `weeklyCoach.js:422-424`.)

## A.9 SAFETY — preventive energy-availability caution (UX WARNING, safe-by-construction)

`EA_CAUTION_KCAL_PER_KG = { male: 35, female: 40 }` (`nutritionEngine.js:664`), deliberately set ABOVE the
30 kcal/kg hard floor so the warning fires BEFORE an under-fuelling cut is prescribed (`:659-663`).

`energyAvailabilityCaution(targetKcal, maintenanceKcal, body)` `:679-706`:
- Returns null unless a genuine deficit (`targetKcal < maintenanceKcal`) and inputs are usable.
- `proxyEA = targetKcal / ffmKg` (FFM from `computeFFMFloor`, so it inherits the conservative fallback).
- **Unknown sex takes the FEMALE 40 line** (`:687-691`, audit F3/EN-7: unknown previously fell to the male
  35 line, warning a female profile ~12% later).
- `suggestedKcal = clamp(round(line × ffmKg), sexFloor, maintenanceKcal)`. The comment at `:694-696` proves
  the nudge **can only ever raise calories**, never lower, and never below the sex floor.
- Emitted as `eaCaution` on the target (`:987`) plus a warning string (`:916-923`).

Surface: `NutritionTargetsScreen.js:1354-1372` renders a one-tap "Ease this cut to about X kcal" control that
steps the goal down one notch (`aggressive_cut → mild_cut → recomp → maintain`) and recalculates. The code
comment at `:1351-1353` notes this is ED-safety-adjacent and was deliberately left without a haptic.

## A.10 EWMA weight trend — two deliberately different smoothers

| | `nutritionEngine.computeEWMA` | `weeklyCoach.computeEWMA` |
|---|---|---|
| location | `nutritionEngine.js:168-185` | `weeklyCoach.js:40-57` |
| alpha | `EWMA_ALPHA = 0.28` (~3.5-day memory) | `0.1` (~10-day memory) |
| input shape | `{ weightKg, date }` | `{ weightKg, loggedAt }` |
| output shape | `{ ...point, ewma }` (3 dp) | `{ loggedAt, rawKg, ewmaKg }` (2 dp) |
| use | diet-planning surfaces (BodyMetrics, weight-trend card, adaptive TDEE) | the weekly-coach trend signal |

The shape divergence is intentional (`nutritionEngine.js:161-167`, `weeklyCoach.js:33-38`): "so callers can't
accidentally use the wrong one and have the wrong field names compile."

Shared hardening (DATA-001 / F3 EN-6): both drop rows where `Number(weightKg)` is non-finite **or `<= 0`**,
so a single 0 kg import artefact cannot drag the trend into a fake rapid-loss signal
(`nutritionEngine.js:176`, `weeklyCoach.js:47`). Third copy in `robustTrend.js:185`.

`ewmaValues(values, alpha)` `nutritionEngine.js:191-202` — generic numeric EWMA (2 dp) used for the body-fat
trend chart (GAP row 25). **LIVE-COND(BodyMetrics, body-fat history present)**, `BodyMetricsScreen.js:53`.

`computeWeeklyWeightChange(ewmaData)` `:211-245`:
- Date-aware path: walks back to the newest entry at least `MIN_SPAN_DAYS = 6` before the last, then
  normalises `(Δewma / spanDays) × 7`. Returns null if no such point exists.
- Index fallback (only when entries carry no parseable date): needs `>= 8` points, uses index −8, because
  7 points spans 6 days and would read ~17% optimistic (`:206-210`).

`robustTrend.js` (`robustTrackingLatest`, `robustTrackingSevenDaysAgo`) is a **third** trend read: Holt
level+trend with an asymmetric robust clamp on the residual. Per `weeklyCoach.js:786-804` it drives the
**decision** reads (`onTarget`, `offTargetDirection`) while **safety** (rapid loss, the +calorie boost
magnitude, the ED detector) stays on the plain less-damped EWMA. That split is the load-bearing safety
property, pinned by `src/lib/__tests__/engine-invariants.test.js:163` ("a genuine rapid loss still fires
rapid-loss safety + ED s1 (robust smoothing must not mask it)") and `cycleRobustSmoothing.test.js`.

## A.11 Adaptive TDEE — `computeAdaptiveTDEEAdjustment` (`:277-424`)

- **INPUTS**: `ewmaData`, `prescribedKcal`, `currentTDEEEstimate`, `adherenceFactor` (default 1.0),
  `ffmFloorContext`, `rapidLossOverride`, `actualIntakeKcal`, `updateGain` (default 0.5).
- **GATES**: `MIN_POINTS = 14` (`:317`); `computeWeeklyWeightChange` must be non-null.
- **CONFIDENCE**: `ewmaCoverageWeeks` (`:256-264`) counts **distinct calendar days / 7**, falling back to row
  count only when rows carry no date — so several weigh-ins on one day cannot inflate confidence
  (COMP-026 prerequisite; pinned at `nutritionEngine.test.js:312`). `>=4 high`, `>=3 medium`, else `low`.
- **MODEL** (`:330-350`):
  - `estimatedActualKcal` = the real logged 7-day average when `actualIntakeKcal` is finite and > 0 (B1,
    founder-approved 2026-07-02, "the model reads what was eaten, not what was promised"), else
    `prescribedKcal × adherenceFactor`.
  - `expectedKgPerWeek = ((estimatedActualKcal − currentTDEEEstimate) × 7) / KCAL_PER_KG` where
    `KCAL_PER_KG = 7700` (`:247`).
  - `discrepancy = actual − expected`; `rawAdjustmentKcal = round(−discrepancy × 7700 / 7)`.
  - `safeGain = min(0.65, max(0.5, updateGain))` — **hard clamp** (`:348`): a misconfigured caller can
    neither weaken damping below 50% nor pierce the 0.65 cap. Pinned by `engine-invariants.test.js:224`.
  - `adjustmentKcal = round(rawAdjustmentKcal × safeGain)`; `adjustedTDEE = currentTDEE + adjustmentKcal`.
- **SAFEGUARDS, in order**: FFM floor clamp (A.8) → `rapidLossOverride` upward-only clamp (`:410-412`,
  applied last so it composes without double-counting).
- **USER EXPLANATION** (`:355-374`): `<50 kcal` → "Your weight is tracking exactly as planned. No change
  needed." Otherwise the copy states the **actual direction from `actualKgPerWeek`**, not from the adjustment
  sign — the 2026-07-01 audit note at `:361-366` records that the old copy told a fast-losing user the
  opposite of reality. Rendered as "Your weight has risen/fallen X kg/week. Adding/Trimming N kcal/day to
  match what your recent trend suggests you are burning."

Live callers: `weeklyCoach.js:1018`/`:1034` (**LIVE-COND(Pro, >=14 weigh-ins, maintenance + target stored)**);
`src/hooks/useWeightTrend.js:57` (**LIVE-COND(Pro, targets with `tdee`)**, 90-day window);
`src/screens/BodyMetricsScreen.js:560`.

## A.12 Step-trend confidence modifier — `computeStepTrendModifier` (`:478-567`)

Constants `:440-447`: `STEP_WINSOR_CAP 40000`, `STEP_DELTA_MIN 1500`, `STEP_DELTA_RATIO_MIN 0.20`,
`STEP_BASELINE_FLOOR 4000`, `STEP_PERSIST_MIN 1000`, `STEP_GAIN_BASE 0.50`, `STEP_GAIN_MAX 0.65`,
`STEP_GAIN_RAMP_SPAN 2500`. Windows: recent = ages 0-13, baseline = ages 14-41; sufficiency `>=10 of 14`
and `>=14 of 28`; persistence requires both halves of the recent window on the same side of baseline by
`>= 1000` steps with `>= 3` logged days each; **direction must agree** with the sign the weight trend already
chose. The header `:429-437` states the non-negotiable: steps never produce, size, or reverse a calorie change
and are never given a kcal value (the named MyFitnessPal "eat-back" anti-pattern).

**Status: INTERNAL / effectively unreachable in production.** The single production caller,
`src/screens/CoachOutputScreen.js:1714-1717`, passes `dailyStepsSeries: null, stepsTodayKey: null` with the
comment "Step targets are not part of the shipped coaching product", and `:1737-1738` passes
`currentStepsTarget: 0, stepsEnabled: false`. So `weeklyCoach.js:1027` never enters the modifier branch, the
step prescription block (`weeklyCoach.js:1156-1199`) always takes the `!stepsEnabled` branch, and
`weightTrend.stepTrendLineFor` (`src/lib/weightTrend.js:59-68`) never renders. The maths and its invariant
tests remain live in `engine-invariants.test.js:215-360`.

## A.13 Diet-break trigger — `shouldSuggestDietBreak` (`:1003-1026`)

`DIET_BREAK_THRESHOLD_WEEKS = 8` (`:107`, MATADOR 2017 Int J Obesity). Guards a null/invalid start date
explicitly (`:1005-1009`), because `new Date(null)` is epoch 0 and would read ~2,900 weeks of deficit.
Returns `{ suggest, weeksInDeficit, message }`. Called live from `weeklyCoach.js:1299`.

## A.14 Complete clamp inventory in `calculateNutritionTargets`

| Clamp | Value | Line |
|---|---|---|
| age | round, `[13, 100]`, default 28 | `:829` |
| height | `[100, 250]` cm, default 170 | `:830` |
| weight | `[30, 350]` kg, default 75 | `:831` |
| BF% for Katch | `(0, 60)` exclusive | `:587-592` |
| activity multiplier fallback | 1.55 | `:854` |
| sex kcal floor | 1500 / 1200 | `:874-880` |
| hard loss gate | 1.5 %BW/wk | `:890-899` |
| soft loss warning | 0.8 %BW/wk | `:900-905` |
| protein floor | `approach.floor × kg` | `:733`, `:763` |
| custom protein ceiling | 3.5 g/kg BW | `:136`, `:739` |
| fat floor | `max(0.5 × kg, 40 g)` | `:933` |
| carbs | `max(remainder, 0)` | `:937` |
| output band | ±10% | `:944-945` |

`Number.isFinite` is used rather than `??` throughout the clamps (`:826-828`) so an explicit `NaN` falls back
to the default rather than poisoning every downstream value — pinned by `nutritionEngine.test.js:621-672`.

# B. WEEKLY COACH — nutrition side (`src/lib/weeklyCoach.js`, 1,881 lines + `coachApply.js`)

Single production entry: `runWeeklyCoach(inputs)` (`:512`), called only from
`src/screens/CoachOutputScreen.js:1695`. **LIVE-COND(Pro; screen is `withProGuard`'d as 'Coaching decision',
`RootNavigator.js:224`)**.

Determinism: F10/EN-5 — the clock is read ONCE at the entry (`nowMs = Date.now()`, `:520`) and threaded into
every time-anchored read (7-day trend cutoff, diet-break weeks, refeed cadence, ED-detector trend), never
re-read mid-run (`:513-519`). Pinned by `weeklyCoach.f10.test.js`.

## B.1 Phase vocabulary and goal rates (`PHASE_CONFIG`, `:324-330`)

| key | label | goalRatePct /wk | isCut | isBulk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mild_cut` | Mild cut | −0.375 | true | false |
| `recomp` | Hold muscle, lose fat | −0.125 | **false** | false |
| `maint` | Maintenance | 0 | false | false |
| `mild_bulk` | Lean bulk | +0.1875 | false | true |
| `mod_bulk` | Lean bulk | +0.375 | false | true |

`PHASE_ALIASES = { bulk: 'mod_bulk' }` (`:347`) — before this, a bulking user silently fell through to
maintenance and was coached at 0%/wk. EN-4 (founder ruling 2026-07-02) deleted the dead `agg_cut`/`mod_cut`
rows and made `recomp` live but **deliberately not a cut**, so it can never gain the cut levers
(calorie resize, refeed, diet break, macro cycling) — pinned by `phaseVocab.en4.replay.test.js`.

`STEPS_BANDS` `:333-339` exist but are dead in production (A.12).

## B.2 Data-confidence gate (`assessDataConfidence`, `:114-140`) — HARD SAFETY-ADJACENT HOLD

- `weigh_ins < 3` → `data_hold`, early return at `:700-728` with **every adjustment null**.
- unusual event (any non-empty check-in note) + `weigh_ins < 5` → `data_hold`.
- `weigh_ins < 5` → medium; adherence unknown → medium; `weeksInPhase < 2` → low; unusual event → medium.

`weighInDayCount` (`:679-692`, F10/EN-8) counts **distinct local calendar days** in the 7 days ending at the
most recent weigh-in, deduped by `localDayKey`, with untimed rows counting one each. The comment states the
result is always `<=` the old row count, so the gate can only ever HOLD more, never adjust more.

D18 photo corroboration (`corroborateConfidenceLevel`, `:185-192`) may raise the **emitted** confidence
caption by exactly one step on the ladder `['low','medium','high']`, never lowers, never originates, never
moves `data_hold`, and is suppressed under any hold. It touches only the display field: the
pre-corroboration `confidence.level` is what fed `offTargetWeeksRequired` and hence every calorie/macro/
training/floor decision (`:1679-1717`). Pinned by `progressScanSafetyFloorIsolation.test.js`.

## B.3 On-target band and off-target direction

`onTargetBand = max(0.2 × |goalRatePct| + 0.05, 0.15)` (`:812`). The 0.15 floor exists so maintenance
(goalRate 0) does not collapse to a ±0.05%/wk band and judge normal noise as off-target (D1 #6). It only ever
WIDENS the band. `onTarget` / `offTargetDirection` read `decisionRatePct` = robust trend, falling back to the
plain rate (`:794-819`).

## B.4 Adherence mapping — `mapCalsAdherence` (`:465-474`) **LIVE**

ALGO-004 single source of truth across the screen, the history builder and tests:
`null → null`; `'untracked'|'hit'|'under'|'over'` pass through; `'yes' → 'hit'`;
`'no'` → `'under'` if `avgKcal < targetKcal`, `'over'` if not, and a bare `'no'` when the numbers are absent
(deliberately neutral rather than guessing a direction and sizing a correction the wrong way).

Upstream derivation: `deriveCalsAdherence({ rollups, targetKcal })` (`src/lib/checkinDerive.js:71-81`) —
within 10% of target on the average of **logged days only** counts as `'yes'`. The file header (`:1-10`)
explicitly states these are DISPLAY-tier pre-selections the user can override and are NOT the ED safety
system. `WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:1029-1033` shows the derivation with days-logged count and average.

`adherenceFactor` for the adaptive model (`weeklyCoach.js:980-982`): `'under' → 0.9`, `'over' → 1.1`,
else `1.0`. Superseded by the real logged average when `recentIntakeDaysLogged >= 5` (B1).

## B.5 The calorie-adjustment decision ladder

**Gate `canAdjustCals`** (`:952-964`), all must hold:
`!cycleOverride && !scoffPositive && currentCalTarget != null &&
(calsAdherence !== 'untracked' || foodDiaryStandsIn) &&
(rapidLossOverride || (consecutiveOffTargetWeeks >= offTargetWeeksRequired && lastCalAdjustmentWeeksAgo >= 2))`.

- `offTargetWeeksRequired` = 2 at high confidence, 3 otherwise (`:922`).
- `foodDiaryStandsIn` (`:949-951`) = `recentIntakeDaysLogged >= 5 && recentIntakeAvgKcal > 0 &&
  checkinRecentEnough`, where `checkinRecentEnough` = this week's check-in exists OR a completed check-in
  within 14 days (`:947-948`). Founder decision 2026-07-02: one skipped week still adjusts; a user whose
  wellbeing capture has gone dark returns to the old freeze. Missing/unknown fails toward the freeze.
- `scoffPositive` = `(userProfile.scoffScore ?? 0) >= 2` (`CoachOutputScreen.js:1741`), from the 5-question
  SCOFF screen (`src/screens/WellbeingCheckScreen.js:16-22`, scored at `:71`).
- `cycleOverride` = the check-in's menstrual-cycle flag (see C.5).

**Rapid-loss override** (`:931-936`) — **HARD SAFETY RULE**:
`phase.isCut && !cycleOverride && actualRatePct <= -1.5 && energyScore <= 2`. Bypasses BOTH the two-week
cooldown and the `consecutiveOffTargetWeeks` gate, upward only. Locked in `MOVE_3_UPWARD_GATE_COMPRESSION.md`.

**Magnitudes** (`:1040-1107`):

| condition | change | note copy |
|---|---|---|
| rapid-loss override | `min(300, round(125 + max(0, −1.5 − rate) × 150))` | "Weight is dropping faster than the target rate and energy is low. Adding calories straight away to protect recovery." |
| cut, losing too slowly | `−150` if adherence `'hit'`, else `−100` | "Weight is coming down slower than the target rate." |
| cut, losing too fast (non-compressed) | `+125` | "Weight is dropping faster than the target rate. Slowing it down protects muscle." |
| bulk, gaining too slowly | `+150` | "Weight gain is below the target rate." |
| bulk, gaining too fast | `−125` | "Weight is going on faster than the target rate. Pulling back keeps fat gain in check." |

**Adaptive resize** (`:1078-1087`): only when `adaptiveCal.confidence === 'high'`, never on the rapid-loss
path, and **only in the same direction** the fixed logic chose (`Math.sign` equality). It can right-size, never
reverse, never bypass a gate.

**±5% cap** (`:1092-1095`): `change = sign(change) × min(|change|, round(currentCalTarget × 0.05))`. The
rapid-loss +300 absolute cap can only be tightened further by this, never relaxed. Pinned at
`engine-invariants.test.js:317`.

**Senior clamps, applied after sizing, in order**:
1. FFM floor (`:1129-1154`) — nulls a negative adjustment.
2. ED-pattern lockout (`:1415-1425`) — nulls a negative adjustment and pushes `ed_pattern_lockout`.

## B.6 Held decisions (`:1407-1477`) — the calorie-hold explanation ladder

Order (deliberate, the strongest safety message first):
1. `ed_pattern_lockout` — top slot; carries `signals` and `goalLockAdvanced` so the card can render the rich
   locked copy rather than a plain reason.
2. `ed_pattern_cleared` — "Hold lifted. The signals that triggered the hold have settled for two weeks."
3. `ffm_floor` — the named seven-day/floor sentence.
4. `rapid_loss_corrected` — carries `kcalDelta`, `weeklyLossPct`, `energyScore`.
5. Generic `calories` holds, **only when neither `ffmFloorHeld` nor `edPatternHeld`** (F3/EN-10: never stack a
   generic reason under the ED lockout). Sub-ladder: `scoffPositive` → `cycleOverride` → `onTarget` →
   cooldown → weeks-remaining → `'untracked'` ("Calories stay where they are. Food wasn't tracked this week,
   so any change would be a guess.").

## B.7 Diet break (`:1287-1315`)

`phase.isCut` only. Prefers `goalStartDate` from the profile via `shouldSuggestDietBreak(goalStartDate,
new Date(nowMs))`; falls back to `weeksInPhase >= 8` for older profiles. Copy branches at 12 weeks.
`goalStartDate` is written in `ProGoalSetupScreen.js:207-215`: set on entering a deficit phase, cleared on
leaving, preserved while staying.

## B.8 Macro cycling (`:1317-1344`) and refeed (`:1346-1376`)

**Macro cycle gate**: `dayCalorieCyclingAllowed({ goalPhase, goalLockAdvanced, trainingGoal })`
(`coachingGoals.js:215-217`) = `isCutPhase(goalPhase) && (goalLockAdvanced || isCompetitionGoal(trainingGoal))`.
This is the **single source of truth** shared with the meal-plan assembler
(`mealPlanService.js:104`) so the coach card and the plate plan can never disagree.
`isCutPhase` accepts only `'mild_cut'` (`coachingGoals.js:204-208`).

`computeMacroCycle(nutrition, trainingDaysPerWeek, { sex })` — `coachApply.js:133-176`:
- `MACRO_CYCLE_REST_DAY_CARB_CUT = 0.25` (`:111`).
- `restDayCarbs = round(baselineCarbs × 0.75)`;
  `trainingDayCarbs = round((baselineCarbs × 7 − restDays × restDayCarbs) / trainingDays)`.
  Weekly carb total (and so weekly average kcal) is preserved by construction.
- Protein and fat held constant. Day kcal derived from the carb delta at 4 kcal/g.
- **Refuses** (returns null) when: no target/carbs, `T` outside 1..6, the split rounds to a no-op, **or a
  cycled day would land below `kcalFloorForSex(sex)`** (`:151-159`, F3/EN-2). The comment states the sacred
  floor applies to every SERVED DAY, not just the weekly average, and that clamping up instead would silently
  break the "weekly average preserved" promise the copy makes. **HARD SAFETY RULE**.
- `trainingDays` in the coach = `clamp(round(sessionsPlanned), 1, 6)` (`weeklyCoach.js:1329`).

`computeRefeedDay(nutrition)` — `coachApply.js:194-208`. Eligible only when `phase.isCut &&
isCompetitionGoal(trainingGoal)` (`weeklyCoach.js:1354`), cadence `frequencyWeeks = 1` gated on
`lastRefeedAt` (`:1355-1361`). Raises the day to stored `tdee` by adding carbohydrate, holding protein and
fat: `carbsKcal = max(0, tdee − protein×4 − fat×9)`. Returns null when there is no maintenance figure or the
target already sits at or above maintenance.

## B.9 Apply flow — AUTOMATIC vs PROPOSAL vs REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION vs MANUAL-ONLY

Founder rule (`coachApply.js:1-7`): "the coach surfaces each adjustment as a suggestion with an Apply button;
nothing changes until the user taps. Calories included (founder decision 2026-05-28: uniform model, no silent
auto-apply)."

State machine: `markApplied(output, key, details)` (`:300-312`) writes
`appliedAdjustments[key] = { appliedAt, ...details }` AND sets `adjustments[key].applied = true` (legacy
render path), returning a NEW object. `isApplied(output, key)` (`:318-322`) reads the map first, falling back
to the legacy flag. Applied state rides inside the `coach_outputs.output_json` blob — no schema migration
(`:10-16`).

| Adjustment | Compute | Persist target | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| calories | `computeCalorieTargets` `coachApply.js:66-87` | `nutrition_targets` + AsyncStorage `@volyume_nutrition_targets` | **REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION** (`CoachOutputScreen.js:1145`) |
| diet break | `computeDietBreakTargets` `:99-105` | `nutrition_targets` | REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION (`:1347`) |
| macro cycle | `computeMacroCycle` `:133-176` | `userProfile.macroCycle` (local profile) | REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION (`:1387`) |
| refeed | `computeRefeedDay` `:194-208` | `userProfile.refeed` (local profile) | REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION (`:1436`) |
| training volume | `computeVolumeApply` `:338-362` | `planned_muscle_volume` | REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION (`:1220`) |
| deload | `computeDeloadVolume` `:265-290` | `planned_muscle_volume` | REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION (`:1294`) |
| cardio | — | `userProfile.cardioTarget` | REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION (`:1258`) |
| held decisions, EA caution, cycle note, `whyThisWeek`, `cardioFlag`, `cardioAcknowledgement` | — | none | **PROPOSAL / INFORMATIONAL** (no Apply) |
| ED-pattern raise/clear | `detectEdPatternFlag` / `hasEdPatternCleared` | `ed_pattern_flags` table | **AUTOMATIC** (`CoachOutputScreen.js:1802-1819`) |

`computeCalorieTargets` detail: protein is **held**, fat and carbs scale by `ratio = newKcal / current`, the
whole existing row is spread first so `tdee`/`bmr`/`phase` survive the save (`:72-86`), and
`newKcal = max(kcalFloorForSex(sex), current + change)`; returns null (no-op) when the floor clamps it back to
the current value.

**Autonomy modes** — `userProfile.coachAutonomy ∈ { 'coached', 'collaborative' (default), 'manual' }`
(`SettingsCoachingScreen.js:47`, `:233-241`; `CoachOutputScreen.js:1013-1014`).
- `manual` → `applyDisabled = true`; every `onApply` prop is stripped (`CoachOutputScreen.js:2306-2376`).
  **MANUAL-ONLY**.
- `collaborative` → tap to apply. **REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION**.
- `coached` → the effect at `CoachOutputScreen.js:2038-2084` invokes the SAME handlers a tap would, walking a
  fixed order (deload → training → calories → cardio → dietBreak → macroCycle → refeed), one at a time.
  **AUTOMATIC**, but hard-gated by D16: `if (output.autoApplyHoldActive) return;`.

`autoApplyHoldActive` (`weeklyCoach.js:1496-1506`) is the ONE place the engine answers "is a hold open right
now": `deloadSuggested || matrixDeload || poorRecovery || safetyHold || ffmFloorHeld || edPatternHeld ||
rapidWeightLossFlag || scoffPositive || calmMode`. **HARD SAFETY RULE** — an open hold forces confirm-first
regardless of mode; a more autonomous mode changes WHO confirms, never whether the clamps run.

## B.10 How weigh-ins and intake logs feed the decisions

- Weigh-ins: `morning_weights` → `getMorningWeights(userId, 60)` (`CoachOutputScreen.js` load) → `EWMA(0.1)`
  for the coach trend, `robustTracking*` for the decision reads, `nutritionComputeEWMA(0.28)` for the adaptive
  resize (`weeklyCoach.js:979-1018`), `computeWeeklyTrendPct` for the ED detector (`:1389`).
- Intake: `food_entries` → `recomputeRollup` (`food/db.js:503-539`, **excludes `is_planned = 1`**) →
  `daily_intake_rollups` → `getRecentIntakeSummary` → `recentIntakeAvgKcal` + `recentIntakeDaysLogged` →
  the FFM floor context, `actualIntakeKcal` for B1, and the `foodDiaryStandsIn` unfreeze.
- Check-in: `weekly_checkins` → `calsAdherence`, `energyScore`, `sorenessScore`, `stressScore`,
  `cycleOverride`, `sleepHours`, `jointPain`, `notes`, `trainingPerformance`.

# C. TARGETS PLUMBING

## C.1 Stored target — `nutrition_targets`

Local schema `src/lib/database.js:298-316`: one row per user, columns `bmr, tdee, target_kcal, protein_g,
carbs_g, fat_g, phase, bmr_method, activity_level, confidence, warnings (JSON TEXT), gdpr_consented`, plus
`goal` and `protein_approach` added by a later migration (`:1732-1733`). Write: `saveNutritionTargets`
(`:4403-4466`, upsert-by-user with a fire-and-forget cloud push). Read: `getNutritionTargets` (`:4468-4480`,
parses `warnings` back to an array). Sync: registry entry `nutrition_targets` (`sync/registry.js:164`),
handler `sync/tables/nutritionTargets.js`.

Note `maintenanceKcal` has no column — `tdee` IS maintenance. `coachApply.computeDietBreakTargets` and
`computeRefeedDay` both say so explicitly (`:100-102`, `:182-186`).

## C.2 `nutritionTargetsView.js` (73 lines) — display only

Header `:1-11` is explicit: "These are NOT the nutrition engine and NOT the ED safety floors."
- `KCAL_PER_KG_TISSUE = 7700` (`:15`) — display only.
- `hydrateLoadedTargets(raw, weightKg)` (`:28-56`): backfills a stored record's renamed/derived fields
  (`maintenanceKcal ← tdee`, `bmrKcal ← bmr`, `bmrFormula ← bmrMethod` mapping `katch|lbm →
  'Lean mass-adjusted formula'`, derives `targetRateKgPerWeek` and `proteinGPerKg`), fixing the "blank
  breakdown" defect on old records. No-op on a freshly computed record.
- `getRecommendedMeals(proteinG, weightKg)` (`:68-73`): smallest count in `[3, 6]` keeping per-meal protein
  at or below `0.55 g/kg` (the MPS ceiling); falls back to 4. **LIVE-COND(Pro, Nutrition Targets)**.

## C.3 `food/effectiveTargets.js` — the diary's precedence resolver **LIVE**

`resolveEffectiveTargets(targets, ctx)` `:34-87`. Precedence, locked by tests and stated at `:5-15`:

1. **Refeed day** (`isRefeedDay` → `refeed`)
2. **Macro cycle** (`macroCycle` → `isTrainingDay ? trainingDay : restDay`)
3. **Banked delta** (`applyBankToTarget(targets, bankedDelta)`)
4. **Per-day-of-week offset** (`applyBankToTarget(targets, clampedDelta)`), only on an otherwise-plain day
5. **Flat stored target**

**"The engine's stored target is untouched at every step, so the coach, the rapid-loss gate and the
ED-pattern detector always see the real target"** (`:12-15`). This is the load-bearing safety property of the
entire display layer.

Two floor clamps live here:
- The per-day offset is clamped so `base + delta >= floorKcal`; a base already at or below the floor with a
  downward offset clamps to zero change, never a further cut (`:48-58`). **HARD SAFETY RULE**.
- A **persisted** macro-cycle day from before `computeMacroCycle`'s floor gate existed is lifted to the floor,
  routing the lift through carbs at 4 kcal/g so kcal and macros stay self-consistent (`:61-79`, F3/EN-2
  defence-in-depth). **HARD SAFETY RULE**.

`dayTypeLabel(ctx)` `:96-102`: `'Refeed day' | 'Training day' | 'Rest day' | 'Higher-calorie day' |
'Lower-calorie day' | null`.

Diary wiring: `DiaryScreen.js:452-459` (memo), floor computed at `:248-258` as
`safeDayFloorKcal({ sex, ffmFloorKcal: computeFFMFloor(latestWeight, latestBodyComp).floorKcal })`.

## C.4 `food/perDayTargets.js` — per-weekday planning offsets (gap #13)

Header `:1-33` states it is a PLANNING layer, never a coaching one; the engine's stored target is never
written; every offset is hard-clamped in `resolveEffectiveTargets`; it applies only on an otherwise-plain day.

- Keys: `PERDAY_TARGETS_KEY = '@volyume_perday_target_offsets'`,
  `PERDAY_TARGETS_UPDATED_AT_KEY` for the last-write-wins clock.
- `WEEKDAY_KEYS` Monday-first (`:43`), matching the diary's `weekDatesMon` model.
- `MAX_PERDAY_OFFSET_KCAL = 1500` (`:52`) — presentation hygiene, symmetric; safety is the separate senior floor.
- `weekdayKeyFromIso` parses as a LOCAL calendar date (`:66-77`), so the weekday matches what the user sees.
- Cloud sync: `perday_target_offsets` (`sync/registry.js:238-243`, migration 110), strict LWW —
  `applyPerDayOffsetsFromCloud` only overwrites when the cloud row is strictly newer, and never calls
  `scheduleSync` (a pull can't loop back into a push) (`:172-178`).

Screen: `src/screens/PerDayTargetsScreen.js` (219 lines), `withProGuard('Per-day targets')`
(`RootNavigator.js:211`), `STEP_KCAL = 50`, shows the live clamped number so a user always sees the real safe
value (`:22-28`).

## C.5 `food/calorieBank.js` — "Plan a bigger day" (CB-1)

Pure weekly redistribution holding the weekly total constant (`sum(deltas) === 0`), so the coach's 7-day
rolling average, the rapid-loss gate and the ED detector see identical inputs to a flat week (`:5-10`).

- `MIN_BANK_DELTA_KCAL = 50`, `MAX_BANK_DELTA_KCAL = 500` (founder-confirmed 2026-06-16) (`:32-36`).
- `planCalorieBank(...)` `:52-95`: `roomUp = bandMaxKcal − bigDayBase`;
  `roomDownMin = min(other − floorKcal)`; `maxSpread = roomDownMin × n`;
  `bump = floor(min(requested, maxBankDelta, roomUp, maxSpread))`. Refuses with a **named reason**
  (`invalid_input | no_room | floor | too_small`) and writes nothing. Integer reductions sum to exactly the
  bump so the delta map sums to zero. **HARD SAFETY RULE** (no day may breach the floor).
- `sexFloorKcal(sex)` `:149-151` (third copy of 1500/1200); `safeDayFloorKcal({ sex, ffmFloorKcal })`
  `:159-163` = `max(sex floor, FFM floor)`.
- `displayBankedDelta({ bankingAvailable, ... })` `:171-173`: returns 0 unless banking is currently allowed,
  **even if a bank is still persisted** — stops a stale bank applying after a carve-out closes.
- `applyBankToTarget(targets, deltaKcal)` `:216-227`: shifts kcal through **carbs only** (protein and fat
  untouched), clamps carbs at 0, and shifts kcal only by what carbs actually absorbed so the displayed kcal
  stays macro-consistent.
- `bankedPlanDayEdits(...)` `:195-209` (CB-1b): routes each day's delta through `applyMacroDeltaToPlan` so the
  planned FOOD moves too, not just the target number.

Availability gate in the diary (`DiaryScreen.js:422-423`):
`!!targets && !targetWasFloored(targets) && !macroCycle && !refeed && !edFlagOpen`.
The ED read fails **CLOSED**: `getOpenEdPatternFlag(userId).catch(() => 'read_failed')` with
`setEdFlagOpen(!!edFlag)` (`DiaryScreen.js:230-234`), so a transient read error keeps banking disabled.
Storage: `userProfile.calorieBank` via `useAppStore.setCalorieBank` (`store/useAppStore.js:1868-1878`),
device-local, not synced. Sheet: `src/components/food/CalorieBankSheet.js`.

## C.6 Goal protein plumbing

There is no `goal-protein.js`. Goal → protein flows: `TRAINING_PHASES[].nutritionKey`
(`coachingGoals.js:223-293`) → `phaseToNutritionKey` (`:300-302`) → `buildNutritionEngineInputs.goal`
(`:383`) → `calcProtein(goal, ...)` table lookup. Goal-driven approach auto-selection is
`ADVANCED_PROTEIN_GOALS` (`nutritionEngine.js:783-786`, `:837-838`). Persisted as
`nutrition_targets.protein_approach` and `userProfile.proteinApproach`.

## C.7 `femaleNutritionAwareness.js` (65 lines)

Returns null for any non-female `sex` (`:27`). Scope note `:5-16`: awareness content ONLY; it does not track,
total or score any micronutrient and changes no food data, schema or target; it prioritises foods to include,
never foods to avoid, and signposts symptoms to a GP. Three nutrients: Iron, Calcium + vitamin D, Vitamin B12,
plus a footnote suggesting a ferritin test and stating "This is general guidance, not medical advice."
Surface: `NutritionTargetsScreen.js:1376-1400`. **LIVE-COND(Pro, sex === 'female')**.
Classification: **INFORMATIONAL COPY**.

## C.8 Menstrual-cycle features — `cyclePrefs.js` + `cyclePhase.js`

`cyclePrefs.js` (39 lines): opt-in stored at `@volyume_cycle_tracking` in AsyncStorage, **off by default**,
**not synced** (`:12-14`: "a privacy opt-in defaults off on every device"). Header `:3-7` frames it as the
extra Article 9 privacy gate above the app's existing health-data consent.
`shouldShowCycleQuestion(sex, enabled)` `:37-39` = `enabled === true && sex === 'female'` — one shared rule
for the check-in and the Settings toggle.

What it changes: the weekly check-in shows one optional question, writing `cycleOverride`
(`WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:775`). In the coach, `cycleOverride` **holds the entire calorie block**
(`weeklyCoach.js:954` inside `canAdjustCals`; `:1465-1466` supplies the held reason "Calories held. Cycle was
flagged this week so the weight reading isn't a reliable signal") and **suppresses the rapid-loss override and
the rapid-loss flag** (`:933`, `:1265`). Classification: **SOFT COACHING RULE** (it only ever holds).

`cyclePhase.js` (52 lines) — U4 annotation. `cycleTrendAnnotation({ sex, menstrual, trendPctPerWeek })`
`:35-52`. Fires only for `sex === 'female'` with the user's own parsed menstrual note flag
(`parseNoteFlags`, `weeklyCoach.js:444-454`), and only on a **RISE** within
`CYCLE_WATER_LOWER_PCT = 0.2` to `CYCLE_WATER_UPPER_PCT = 2.5` %BW/week. Header `:12-19` states the
non-negotiables: changes NO calorie target, floor, threshold or decision; never annotates a loss, so a
rapid-loss signal can never be softened or explained away; stands down above the upper bound rather than
falsely reassuring. Emitted as `cyclePhaseNote` (`weeklyCoach.js:1673-1677`, `:1739`).
Classification: **INFORMATIONAL COPY**.

Note the two paths use different inputs: `cycleOverride` is the explicit check-in question (needs the opt-in),
`noteFlags.menstrual` is regex over the free-text note (`/\b(period|menstr\w*|pms)\b/` plus "time of the
month"), which fires with or without the opt-in.

## C.9 `recompReframe.js` (194 lines)

`deriveRecomp(history, sets, exercises, { suppressed })` `:107-157`. Thresholds `:29-35`:
`FLAT_SLOPE_KG_PER_ENTRY = 0.15` over the last `WEIGHT_WINDOW = 8` entries (mirrors BodyMetricsScreen's phase
chip), `BODY_FAT_MOVED_PP = 0.5`, `MEASUREMENT_MOVED_CM = 1.0`, `STRENGTH_MOVED_KG = 2.5` (smallest standard
plate-pair increment). Renders only when weight held AND at least one stream moved.
`opts.suppressed` (calm mode or an open ED flag) short-circuits to `{ render: false }` (`:108`,
founder decision NA-coaching-6: "a 'weight flat, fat down' read can never reinforce restriction").
All deltas are Class-B body data: direction carries no valence (`:21-22`).

`buildRecompShareParams(vm, units)` `:183-194` fires **only** on the strength signal; body-fat % and
measurement deltas are never put on a share card even as a signed delta (`:165-181`, Article 9).
Classification: **INFORMATIONAL COPY** with a **HARD SAFETY** suppression and a **HARD PRIVACY** narrowing.

---

# D. THE FOOD DOMAIN — `src/lib/food/*` (48 modules, ~10.8k lines)

## D.1 Diary data layer — `food/db.js` (1,838 lines, ~72 exports)

**`logFoodEntry(userId, entry)`** `:59-140`:
- Grams validated by `isValidEntryGrams` (`servingEntry.js:52-55`: `1..MAX_ENTRY_GRAMS(5000)`), with the
  single carve-out that a `quick:*` ref may carry 0 (`:73-81`). Clamping is deliberately NOT used, because the
  macros are already scaled for the passed grams (`:63-72`, FOOD-001).
- Non-finite macros coerce to 0 rather than binding NULL against NOT NULL columns and crashing a write the
  user performs dozens of times a day (`:82-88`).
- `is_planned = 1` marks meal-plan scaffolding: **excluded from the rollup, adherence, the FFM floor and
  sync** until confirmed (`:89-92`, adherence model 2026-06-15).
- `weight_state ∈ { as_weighed (default), raw, cooked }` (`:27-30`) — a stored LABEL only, **no conversion is
  ever performed** (`:48-50`).
- `eaten_at`: `now` for a real log, **NULL for a planned row** until `confirmPlannedEntry` /
  `confirmPlannedDay` stamps it (`:94-99`, D22 15b).
- Telemetry: `food_logged` with `food_ref_source` + `meal_slot` only — quantity is deliberately excluded as
  dietary content (HP-2, `:124-129`); plus the `first_food_logged` activation first.

Other diary primitives: `updateFoodEntry` (`:143`, rewrites every column), `deleteFoodEntry`/`restoreFoodEntry`
(soft delete + undo), `getFoodEntriesForDay` (`:220`), `getRecentLoggedDays` (`:235`), `hasAnyFoodEntries`
(`:255`, the read-only-guard predicate), `confirmPlannedDay`/`confirmPlannedEntry` (`:294`,`:317`),
`getPlannedDaysInRange` (`:340`), `clearPlannedDay` (`:357`), `getFoodEntriesForRange` (`:379`).

**Rollups**: `recomputeRollup` (`:503-539`) sums `kcal/protein/carbs/fat/fibre` and `entries_count` over
`deleted_at IS NULL AND is_planned = 0` and upserts `daily_intake_rollups`. Fibre stores a real 0 rather than
NULL so a zero-fibre day is distinguishable from no data (`:533-536`, food review D-m5).
Sync direction for `daily_intake_rollups` is **pull_only, server_wins, serverAuthoritative**
(`sync/registry.js:99-106`).

**TZ migration**: `rekeyFoodEntriesToLocalDay` (`:550-589`) re-keys historical UTC `entry_date` values to the
local calendar day and rebuilds affected rollups **in one transaction** so a failure rolls back cleanly.

Also here: custom foods (`:459-499`), food preferences (`setFoodPreference`/`toggleFavourite`/`getDislikes`,
`:656-762`, one table with `kind ∈ {fav, dislike}` and soft-delete tombstones), water
(`setWater`/`getWater`/`deleteWater`, `:764-815`), recipes (`:817-1040`), `computeRecipeMacros` (`:1042-1071`),
saved meals (`:1104-1310`, inline `items_json`), curated-meal apply (`:1313`), meal plans (`:1355-1509`),
recipe apply (`:1511`), and the sync push/pull handlers (`:1565-1838`).

## D.2 Dates and view models

- `food/diaryDates.js` (51 lines): `isoDate`, `shiftDate`, `weekDatesMon` (the Mon..Sun week calorie banking
  uses), `weekdayShort`, `friendlyDate` (Today/Yesterday/Tomorrow, `todayIso` injectable). All keys are the
  LOCAL calendar day (TZ-1).
- `food/diaryViewModel.js` (24 lines): `deriveDiaryDayViewModel(entries, { readOnly })` — in read-only mode
  planned entries are filtered out entirely; otherwise it counts distinct planned slots and totals planned
  macros separately.
- `food/diaryDaySummary.js` (87 lines): `buildDiaryDaySummary` + `formatDiaryDaySummary` — logged / remaining
  / over, per-macro "Ng left" / "Ng over" / "on plan" chips, planned kcal chip, day-type chip. Neutral copy,
  no valence.
- `food/diaryTimeline.js` (135 lines): ONE chronological list with Morning/Afternoon/Evening labels
  (`MORNING_END_HOUR 12`, `AFTERNOON_END_HOUR 17`). Untimed (bulk-confirmed) entries sort to their meal's
  **conventional** position derived from `slotOrder`, never an invented clock time, and no display time is
  ever attached to them. **ED-safety non-goal, explicit** (`:23-28`): "this module NEVER computes or exposes a
  gap between entries, a 'fasting window', an early/late judgement, or any derived meal-timing commentary."

## D.3 Meal slots — `food/mealSlots.js` (211 lines)

Numbered model: `DEFAULT_MEALS_PER_DAY = 4`; keys `meal_1..meal_N`. Legacy keys
(`breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack/preworkout/postworkout`) never disappear — `buildMealSlots` unions any slot
that has entries onto the numbered ladder (`:141-153`). `slotOrder` (`:118-125`) puts legacy day-meals first,
then numbered, then peri-workout (90/91), then snack (95).

**Peri-workout slots are OFF BY DEFAULT** (`:141-146`, founder device report 2026-07-11: half-built and
confusing when every user saw two permanently empty cards). Gated on `userProfile.mealPlanPeriWorkout`,
surfaced as "Around training" on MealPlanScreen, one toggle for both diary and generator
(`DiaryScreen.js:105-109`). **LIVE-COND(preference on)**.

Custom meal names (gap #1): slot KEYS never change; only labels are overridable, stored device-local at
`MEAL_LABELS_KEY = '@volyume_meal_labels'`, trimmed and capped at 24 chars (`:41-51`). Screen:
`src/screens/MealNamesScreen.js`, `withProGuard('Meal names')` (`RootNavigator.js:210`).

`inferMealSlotForHour(hour, slotKeys)` `:195-211`: maps the ladder evenly across the waking eating window
(`EATING_WINDOW_START_HOUR 6` to `EATING_WINDOW_END_HOUR 22`), nearest centre wins, ties lean earlier.
**Peri-workout slots are excluded from the guess** because they are intent-specific, not time-of-day.
Pure — the caller passes the hour.

## D.4 Logging paths

**Search** — `food/waterfall.js` (333 lines). Five sources, first hit wins for barcode; for free-text search a
WEAK local hit no longer suppresses live sources (E3 refinement):
1. Local SQLite (`custom_foods` + `foods`) `<50ms` — `sources/localCache.js`
2. Bundled OFF snapshot (already in `foods`)
3. Bundled CoFID (already in `foods`)
4. Live OpenFoodFacts (~800ms) — `sources/liveOff.js`
5. USDA FoodData Central (~1200ms) — `sources/usda.js`, requires `EXPO_PUBLIC_USDA_API_KEY`
   (**LIVE-COND(build-time env var set)**; `usda.js:16-29` records that a computed `process.env` lookup was
   never inlined by Metro so USDA silently never ran in real builds — now a static dot path).
Constants: `MIN_QUERY_LEN = 2`, `NETWORK_SEARCH_FANOUT_LIMIT = 10`, `WEAK_LOCAL_MIN_HITS = 3` (limit-aware).
Live hits are promoted into `foods` (cache promotion), so the next lookup is a step-1 hit.
`refetchStaleFood` (`:309`) does one opportunistic re-fetch per food_ref per app session (`_refetchAttempted`).

FTS: `toFtsMatch` (`localCache.js:33`) quotes every word as a prefix token, which also neutralises every FTS
operator so user text can never be parsed as one (injection guard).

Search UI: `food/searchTabs.js` — `SEARCH_TABS = [recents ("Recent"), suggested, favourites, frequents,
custom ("More")]`; a 2+ char query searches the database from any tab (`selectTabRows`);
`rankByPersonalHistory` promotes favourites (weight 3), slot-recents and frequents (2), the user's own custom
foods (1) above generic matches, stably within each bucket.

**Barcode** — `src/screens/ScanBarcodeScreen.js` (485 lines), `react-native-vision-camera`'s built-in
MLKit-backed `codeScanner`. Scan → `resolveBarcode` (`waterfall.js:264`) → detail sheet on a hit, or
ScanLabel with the EAN prefilled on a miss. Locks after the first successful scan, re-arms on focus, pauses
the camera when backgrounded. `withProGuard('Barcode scanning')`.

**OCR label scan** — `src/screens/ScanLabelScreen.js` (511 lines), two-step: front of pack (name) then
nutrition panel (macros).
- `food/ocr.js` (83 lines): `@react-native-ml-kit/text-recognition`, on-device, free, no API key, no network.
  `isOcrConfigured()` reports whether the native module is linkable; when absent the screen surfaces a
  "Type it in" CTA. **LIVE-COND(EAS build with the native module)**. The file records that a paid Google
  Cloud Vision adapter and its env-var gate were removed as violating the locked free-stack constraint.
- `food/labelName.js` (105 lines): picks the product name from front-of-pack blocks by font size (frame
  height) and vertical position, dropping pack sizes, nutrition rows, legal/URL/store lines. Keeps a name that
  merely CONTAINS a macro word ("High Protein Granola"); drops a bare macro row ("Protein 20g"). Max 50 chars.
- `food/ocrParser.js` (186 lines): `parseNutritionLabel(rawText)` → `{ fields, confidence, hasAnchor }`.
  Fields `kcal100g, protein100g, carbs100g, fat100g, fibre100g, servingG`.
  Normalisation `:22-34` disambiguates a comma by the digit count AFTER it: exactly 3 = thousands separator,
  1-2 = decimal — the 2026-07-01 audit records "2,000 kJ" previously becoming 2 kJ (~3x under-read).
  kcal has its own unit-trailing matcher; kJ falls back via `/4.184`.
  D-M4: a "per serving"/"per portion" qualifier in the gap makes the parser skip to the NEXT number (the
  per-100g column), since Volyume stores per-100g.
  Confidence is `high` only when a per-100g anchor is present, else `low`, else `missing`.
  `fieldNeedsCheck(level, prefillValue, current)` `:131-137` flags a field amber only while it still holds the
  low-confidence prefill — the flag clears the moment the user edits it. **UX WARNING**.
- `food/writeback.js` (183 lines): OFF contribution queue. Consent key
  `@volyume_off_writeback_consent_v1`, **default OFF**; `MAX_RETRIES = 3`,
  `RETRY_BACKOFF_MS = [2000, 8000, 30000]`; endpoint `product_jqm2.pl`; UA `Volyume/1.1`. Only the label photo
  and confirmed macros are sent. `shouldShowOffConsentCard` offers the one-time Diary card only after a first
  completed barcode-heal chain, never mid-task (COMP-022).

**Servings / gram solving**
- `food/servingEntry.js` (55 lines): `buildServingUnits` (household serving first, then grams);
  `initialServingState` — a known prior portion opens in grams at that exact amount, so long-press-to-adjust
  and one-tap re-log can never diverge; otherwise one named serving, else 100 g. `resolveGrams` never returns
  NaN. `MAX_ENTRY_GRAMS = 5000`.
- `food/gramSolve.js` (28 lines): `clampRoundGrams` (clamp to `gramRangeOf(foodKey)`, round to 5 g) and
  `solveGramsForKcal`. Extracted because three hand-copied copies of the same clamp/round maths existed
  (food review E-m4).
- `food/macros.js` (138 lines): `scaleMacros(per100, grams)` — the ONE per-100g→portion scaler; tolerates both
  field shapes (`kcal_100g` and `kcal100g`); kcal to whole, macros to 1 dp; **fibre stays null when absent so
  "no data" never reads as a real 0**; non-finite per-100g reads as 0 (audit F-006). Also `scaleSugarG`,
  `scaleSodiumMg`, `perServingTotals`, `resolveServingG`.
- `food/loggingPayloads.js` (23 lines): `buildFoodEntryPayload`, `buildSlotRecentPayload`.

**Bulk ops** — `food/bulkEntryOps.js` (67 lines), driving the Diary multi-select toolbar (GAP row 26):
`deleteEntries`, `restoreEntries` (undo, food audit F-1), `moveEntriesToSlot`, `copyEntriesToDate`.
`entryToPatch` always sends the WHOLE row because `updateFoodEntry` rewrites every column and a partial patch
would null the macros (`:9-13`).

**Quick add** — `foodRef` prefix `quick:` (`food/db.js:73`), macros entered directly, quantity 0 allowed.
Component `src/components/food/QuickAddSheet.js`.

## D.5 Food library, sources, normalisers, curated data

- `food/seed.js` (338 lines): two bundled `.dat` snapshots — `assets/seed/off_uk_snapshot.dat` (branded UK,
  refreshed weekly by a GitHub Action) and `assets/seed/cofid_uk.dat` (~3k generic UK foods, OGL v3.0).
  Per-snapshot AsyncStorage idempotency flag keyed by generated-at. Upsert on `(source, source_id)`: a new id
  inserts fully, an existing one tops up ONLY the micronutrient columns via COALESCE so a re-import can never
  blank a known value. CoFID populates 24 of the 27 micros as of 2026-07-10; the OFF snapshot populates none.
- `food/libraryDelta.js` (250 lines): `pullFoodLibraryDelta` against the `migrate_028` read-only RPC.
  `THROTTLE_MS = 6h`, `PAGE_SIZE = 5000`, `MAX_PAGES_PER_RUN = 5` (25k rows/foreground). Every error is logged
  with its boundary; no load-bearing dependency.
- `food/sources/localCache.js` (284 lines): `searchLocalByName` (rank 0 = prefix match, 1 = substring),
  `findLocalByBarcode`, `resolveFoodRef` (resolves `custom:` / `global:` / `curated:` refs).
- `food/sources/liveOff.js` (181 lines): `OFF_MICRO_FIELDS` maps the 27 NRV columns. Two documented data
  rules: OFF stores every mass nutriment's `_100g` in plain grams regardless of display unit (×1000 / ×1e6
  conversions here); and a literal 0 is treated as **unknown**, never a verified zero, because OFF is
  crowdsourced with no CoFID-style "Tr"/"N" marker (a real product reported `sodium_100g: 0` beside
  `salt_100g: 0.4`).
- `food/sources/usda.js` (103 lines) + `food/normalisers/usdaToFood.js` (71 lines): nutrient id/number dual
  lookup (Foundation uses ids, Branded uses numbers); a row missing macros is dropped rather than surfaced as
  partial data. `USDA_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500`.
- `food/curatedFoods.js` (153 lines): `CURATED_FOODS` keyed staple table + `resolveComponent(foodKey, grams)`.
- `food/curatedMeals.js` (258 lines): `DIETS = ['omnivore','pescatarian','vegetarian','vegan']`, `dietAllows`,
  `CURATED_MEALS`, `mealItems`, `mealTotals`, `getCuratedCandidates({ diet, slot, excludeFoodKeys,
  excludeTags })`.
- `food/foodRoles.js` (409 lines): `ROLES = ['protein','carb','fat','veg','free']`; `ROLE_TOLERANCE_G = 5`;
  the full FSA-14 `ALLERGENS` list with UK labels (`:167-183`) and a hand-tagged `TAGS` map; gram clamps
  `ROLE_GRAM_RANGE` (protein 50-350, carb 15-400, fat 5-60, veg 40-300, free 5-150) plus per-key
  `GRAM_RANGE_OVERRIDES` (olive_oil 5-30, whey 15-60, honey 5-40, avocado 30-150, potatoes 80-400,
  milks 50-400, eggs 50-250, egg_whites 60-400, fruit ranges). Comment `:161-166`: allergen filtering is
  best-effort by design and the UI must say so; the copy always points at the label and never says "safe".
  **UX WARNING**, not a hard safety claim.
- `food/mealAdditions.js` (819 lines): free flavour additions per curated meal (founder 2026-06-30, prompted by
  a friend asking whether he could add saffron to "chicken & rice"). **HARD RULE** at `:11-15`: every addition
  must be genuinely negligible in calories — herbs, spices, aromatics, citrus, vinegar, near-zero condiments;
  NEVER oils, nuts, seeds, cheese, avocado, honey, sugar syrups. They are educational and **never logged**,
  so the diary stays honest. Tagged with the same FSA-14 vocabulary; `filterAdditionsForProfile` must be
  applied at every render site (R1 safety fix 2026-07-10). Tagging is deliberately conservative
  (over-tagging only hides a suggestion; under-tagging exposes an allergic user).
  `ADDITIONS_INTRO`: "Optional extras. Add any you fancy for flavour. They will not change the meal's numbers."
  `ADDITIONS_FOOTNOTE`: "Amounts here are a pinch or a splash. If you use a lot of sauce, log it so your diary
  stays honest."

## D.6 Frequents and freshness

- `food/frequents.js` (38 lines): server recomputes the top-20 foods over 30 days nightly (cloud migration
  051); the client pulls a snapshot into `food_frequents` when the tab opens and the cache is stale.
  `FREQUENTS_MAX_AGE_MS = 12h`. Deliberately outside the sync queue/conflict machinery: Frequents is
  disposable, a failed refresh leaves the last good cache. **LIVE-COND(migration 051 applied — it is)**.
- `food/freshness.js` (73 lines): reuses the existing `foods.fetched_at` column as "last verified" — no new
  column, no migration. `STALE_THRESHOLD_MS = 30 days`. `isNetworkSourced` = `off | usda` only (cofid is
  bundled reference data with no live re-fetch API; `user_ocr` is a manual scan; `custom` lives in another
  table). `formatLastVerified` returns calm relative wording ("Checked today" / "Checked 3 weeks ago") and
  "Never implies the food is wrong -- it only states when it was last checked against its source."
  **INFORMATIONAL COPY**.

## D.7 Meal suggestions — `food/mealSuggest.js` (226 lines)

Rule-based, no LLM (`:1-6`). Pure and deterministic.
- `perMealMacros(remaining, mealsLeft)` `:26-34` — a pick fills ONE meal's share, not the whole rest of the day.
- `mealsLeftToday(mealsPerDay, loggedSlots)` `:42-46` — `max(1, mealsPerDay − distinct logged slots)`.
- `slotMatches(candidateSlots, slot)` `:65-79` — accepts a string slot or an array of allowed kinds; bare
  numbered slots pass everything (the diary's flexible model carries no food character), so ranking falls back
  to macro fit.
- `fitScore(remaining, macros)` `:109-119`:
  `proteinFill − 0.6 × overshoot − 0.30 × fatMiss`, where `proteinFill = min(macros.protein,
  remaining.protein) / max(remaining.protein, 1)`, `overshoot = max(0, macros.kcal − remaining.kcal) /
  max(remaining.kcal, 1)`, and `fatMiss = min(|macros.fat − remaining.fat| / max(remaining.fat,1), 2)`.
  Protein-first with a bidirectional, capped, lower-weighted fat-alignment nudge (added 2026-06-16 because
  selection previously ignored fat entirely and a day could drift well under the fat target).
- `suggestFood` `:127-161` targets remaining protein (falling back to kcal), clamps `[20, 400] g` and rounds
  to 5 g.
- `rankSuggestions` `:194-226`: returns **no suggestions** when under ~50 kcal and ~5 g protein remain, rather
  than padding the day (an ED-relevant restraint). De-dupes by `kind:name`, `limit = 8`.

## D.8 Meal plans

**`food/mealPlanAssembler.js` (1,079 lines)** — the deterministic day/week assembler.
Safety by construction (`:11-19`): "this module never computes a calorie target. It consumes
`calculateNutritionTargets` output, whose floors … are already applied upstream. Day variants only ever move
calories BETWEEN days inside the engine's published [kcalMin, kcalMax] band with the weekly total preserved,
and variant cycling disables itself entirely when the engine raised the target to a floor. When preferences
make the target unreachable the day is returned flagged `withinTolerance: false` with the residual: the plan
never silently under-feeds to 'make it fit'."
Determinism: same `(target, prefs, schedule, seed)` in, same plan out; `mulberry32` seeded jitter for
"regenerate"; ties break on meal id.

- `targetWasFloored(target)` `:62-67` — structured flag first, regex fallback for pre-flag snapshots.
- `dayVariantTargets(target, opts)` `:80-139`: `MAX_CYCLE_DELTA_KCAL = 300`,
  `MIN_MEANINGFUL_CYCLE_KCAL = 50`. Returns flat when `!allowCycling`, when there is no mix of day types, or
  when the target was floored. Fat convention `equalised` (default, modern RP) holds fat; `higher_rest_day`
  gives ~25% of the rest-day cut back as fat and cuts carbs deeper. Each variant's kcal is derived from the
  grams actually moved and clamped to the engine band (food review E-M2), so the band check and the per-meal
  share describe the same day.
- `buildSlotList` `:197-205`, `slotCharacterFor` `:230-239`: Meal 1 places a BREAKFAST meal (the
  "curry-for-breakfast" fix), the final meal is a cooked main (lunch/dinner), middle meals draw
  lunch/dinner/snack.
- `diagnoseDayPlan` `:255-...`: one actionable diagnosis with reason priority
  `unfilled_slots > oversized pin > calorie miss > protein shortfall`; severity `minor <=3%`,
  `moderate <=8%`, else `major`; structural problems always major. Plain-English hint per reason.
- `assembleDayPlan` `:598`, `dayScore` `:981`, `assembleDayPlanBestOf` `:1000` (local search),
  `assembleWeekPlan` `:1026`.

**`food/mealPlanService.js` (592 lines)** — the only DB-touching bridge. "The service NEVER computes or lowers
a calorie number: it consumes the stored engine target verbatim" (`:17-18`).
`storedTargetToEngineTarget` reconstructs the ±10% band and re-derives `floorApplied` from the persisted
warnings so a floored target never cycles even when loaded from storage. Async surface:
`generateAndSaveMealPlan`, `planNextWeek`, `regenerateActiveMealPlan`, `generateAndSaveDayPlan`,
`loadActiveMealPlan`, `answerTrainingTodayOnActivePlan`, `repeatPlanDayOnActivePlan`,
`applyCoachAdjustmentToActivePlan`, `applyPlanDayToDiary`, `applyPlanWeekToDiary`, `resyncBankedPlannedFood`,
`restoreUnbankedPlannedFood`. `diarySlotFor` (`:443-447`) maps plan keys to diary keys
(`pre_workout → preworkout`, `post_workout → postworkout`; numbered shared).
`applyPlanDayToDiary` writes every item with `isPlanned: true` (`:478`) so it does not count towards adherence
until confirmed. `applyPlanWeekToDiary` is **non-destructive**: any date that already has entries (real or
planned) is skipped, never clobbered. Telemetry `meal_plan_assembled` carries counts + kind only, never food or
user data, and never blocks a plan (`:122-139`).

**`food/planEdit.js` (187 lines)** — the inverse of the assembler and the feature's differentiator: when the
coach changes nutrition it reaches into the user's ACTUAL plan and moves real food.
Rules (`:186-196`): **protein is PROTECTED**; carbs are the lever, fat second; pre/post-workout carbs are
preserved where possible; a remainder that carbs cannot absorb converts to fat at
`CARB_PER_FAT_G = 2.25` (Macros Inc convention), **never to protein**; and a **FLOOR DOUBLE-CLAMP** re-checks
that the post-edit plan total never lands below the engine's `kcalMin` / the day floor —
"A food-level edit can never realise a cut the engine itself refused." Saved-meal blocks (no component list)
are left untouched. Single export `applyMacroDeltaToPlan({ plan, adjustmentKcal, floorKcal })` `:96`.
**HARD SAFETY RULE**.

**`food/planExplain.js` (139 lines)** — `buildPlanEditNarration(change, opts)`. Renders a planEdit record in
the coach voice at the gram of rice ("65 g less white rice at your third meal"). Two registers
(`supportive | precise`) share identical facts. Honest floor branches: when already under the floor the
headline is "Your plan stays as it is, and you have room to eat more." with body "You are at the lowest your
plan should go. There is nothing to take away. Keep logging." — never "nothing changes to keep you safe"
(`:53-64`). **HARD SAFETY-ADJACENT COPY**.

**`food/planPreferences.js` (137 lines)** — the standing food contract.
`DEFAULT_PLAN_PREFERENCES` `:23-33`: `diet 'omnivore'`, `excludeFoodKeys []`, `excludeTags []`,
`mealsPerDay 4` (clamped 3-6), `periWorkoutSlots false`, `variety 0` (0 = repeat / meal-prep, the default;
varied is opt-in), `rotationPool null` (optional 3-3-3 protein/carb/fat pool), `fatConvention 'equalised'`,
`pinnedMealIds []`. **Exclusions are HARD** (`:12-16`): an excluded food never appears in a generated plan, a
swap list, or a coach plan-edit; a meal is excluded when ANY component is. Exclusions can never push a plan
below the safety floors — the assembler reports `withinTolerance: false` instead of starving a day.

**`food/mealSwap.js` (299 lines)** — two levels. FOOD swap replaces one staple with a same-role alternative at
the exact grams holding the role's dominant macro within `ROLE_TOLERANCE_G = 5` (calories follow, which is how
coaches calibrate printed switches). MEAL swap replaces a whole plate with the best like-for-like alternative
for that slot, ranked against the outgoing meal's own totals. `mealStyleSignature` (`:98`) spreads the swap
pool across genuinely different plates rather than macro near-clones (founder directive 2026-06-12).
`mealNameFromComponents` (`:51`) renames a plate after a food swap so it never keeps a name that
misrepresents its contents (founder report 2026-06-15: a "Tuna …" meal whose tuna became cod).
Exclusions are honoured everywhere: a flagged food can never come back through a swap.

**`food/groceryList.js` (145 lines)** — pure aggregation of a stored week plan.
Two founder-decided resolutions grounded in code (`:5-15`): (NA-nutrition-4) there is no approved UK
supermarket-aisle map and the register forbids inventing one, so sections key off the existing macro roles —
Proteins / Carbs / Veg / Fats / Other; (NA-nutrition-5) there is no cooked→raw conversion factor in code, so
the list shows the plan's STORED grams as-is and never fabricates a converted figure (curated names already
say "(cooked)" / "(boiled)"). `buildGroceryList(plan)` + `formatGroceryListForShare(list)`.
Surface: sheet on `MealPlanScreen.js:1209` and share at `:552`.

## D.9 Recipes and saved meals

- `food/db.js:817-1040`: recipe CRUD, `setRecipeIngredients`, `listRecipesWithTotals`,
  `getRecipeWithIngredients`; `computeRecipeMacros(resolvedIngredients, totalServings)` `:1042-1071` returns
  `{ total, perServing }`, servings floored at 0.01.
- `food/recipeImport.js` (193 lines): pulls a schema.org/Recipe object from a page's JSON-LD. "No new
  dependency, no AI. Just fetch + JSON.parse + a regex." The extractor is pure and never throws — a malformed
  page yields null. `isAllowedRecipeUrl` (`:163`) is the URL allowlist guard. The user reviews everything.
- Saved meals `food/db.js:1104-1310`: inline `items_json` array (unlike recipes' child table), so applying is
  N `food_entries` inserts. `computeSavedMealTotals` (`:1104-1118`).
- Screens: `MyRecipesScreen`, `RecipeBuilderScreen`, `MyMealsScreen` — all `withProGuard`
  (`RootNavigator.js:250-252`).

## D.10 Micronutrients

- `food/micronutrients.js` (131 lines): `MICRONUTRIENTS` = **27** nutrients (13 vitamins + 14 minerals),
  each `{ key, column, label, unit, nrv, group }`. Reference values are **UK/EU NRVs** (EU Reg 1169/2011
  Annex XIII, retained in UK law) — the same daily reference a UK label uses.
  **HONESTY RULE** (`:13-17`): "a food with no value for a nutrient contributes nothing and is not counted as
  zero. A day total is only shown for a nutrient when at least one logged food carries a value for it."
  `computeMicronutrientTotals(items)` returns `{ totals, coverage: { withData, total } }` with `null` for
  unknown. `nrvPercent(key, amount)`. The module also emits the SQL fragments (`microSqlColumns`,
  `microSqlPlaceholders`, `microSqlUpsertExcluded`, `microValuesFromRow`, `microValuesFromInput`) so adding a
  nutrient is a one-line change everywhere.
- `food/micronutrientCoverage.js` (121 lines): **display-layer maths only** — the deterministic coaching
  engine never reads these (D22 16a/16b, `:1-9`). `scaleMicronutrients(per100Food, grams)` honours
  "unknown never 0". **`WEEKLY_COVERAGE_FLOOR = 0.5`** (`:35`): a nutrient enters the weekly average only when
  at least half of the window's total logged energy comes from entries whose food carries a known value for
  that nutrient; below the floor it is omitted entirely rather than shown as a misleadingly low average.
  Surfaces: `src/components/food/MicronutrientDetail.js` (per-food),
  `src/components/food/WeeklyMicronutrientsCard.js` on `FoodInsightsScreen` (weekly).
  Cloud: `migrate_116_food_library_pull_micros.sql` (applied).

## D.11 Adherence and insights

- `food/adherence.js` (26 lines): `ADHERENCE_TOLERANCE = { kcal 0.10, protein 0.10, carbs 0.15, fat 0.15 }`,
  `pctLabel`, `within(value, target, tolerance)`. Centralised (food review U-M3) so the pass/fail checks and
  the user-facing copy ("within 10% turns green") can never drift.
  Consumed at `FoodInsightsScreen.js:192-195`, `:479`, `:503-504`.
- `food/nutrientSummary.js` (91 lines): `summariseNutrients(rollups)` — **macro-level only** (protein, carbs,
  fat, fibre), averaged per LOGGED day. Header `:9-15`: "This is a factual average, never a good/bad
  judgement: it returns plain numbers, no colour, no target comparison, no streak. This neutrality is an
  ED-safety requirement … so this helper deliberately holds no concept of a limit or a target."
  Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE (design constraint)**.
- `food/sanityChecks.js` (130 lines) — gate before food data enters Precision Coaching's intake maths:
  | check | rule | code |
  |---|---|---|
  | `checkKcalPlausible` | finite, `>= 0`, `<= 900` kcal/100g (pure fat) | `kcal` |
  | `checkMacroMass` | non-negative, `p + c + f <= 110 g` per 100 g (10% slack for fibre/sodium/water/rounding) | `macro_mass` |
  | `checkKcalMatchesMacros` | `|k − (4p + 4c + 9f)| / derived <= 0.20` | `kcal_macro_mismatch` |
  | `checkFibrePlausible` | null allowed; else finite, `>= 0`, `<= 100` | `fibre` |
  `checkFoodSanity` returns the first failure with a coded `code` for telemetry — **counts and codes only,
  never the typed values** (food audit D-6). `:80-99` documents what is deliberately NOT enforced and why
  (fibre-vs-carbs is unsound across mixed EU/USDA conventions).
- `food/csvExport.js` (186 lines): `buildDiaryCsv` (pure) + PDF/CSV export via `expo-file-system` +
  `expo-sharing`. `csvEscape` neutralises spreadsheet formula injection by prefixing any cell starting with
  `= + - @ tab CR` with a single quote (A2-060).

# E. BODYWEIGHT

- **Capture**: `morning_weights` table (`database.js:512-520`), one row per day-window
  (`:5386-5400` upserts within the same day). Reads: `getMorningWeightsLast14Days` (`:5414`),
  `getMorningWeights(userId, limit = 90)` (`:5424`). Sync: registry `weight_log`
  (`sync/registry.js:32`), handler `sync/tables/weightLog.js`. Separate stream:
  `body_metric_log` (weight + body fat + nine measurement sites) via `bodyMetricsRepository`,
  synced as `body_composition_log` (`registry.js:146`). `bodyMetricsHistoryMerge.js` reconciles the two
  into the single series `runWeeklyCoach` is handed (`:50`).
- **Trend**: two EWMAs plus the robust tracker (A.10). `weightTrend.js` builds the "Your trend" card
  view-model:
  - `trendStateFor(entryCount)` `:19-25`: `0` (<1, card does not render), `1` (<7), `2` (<14), `3` (<42), `4`.
  - `isDiverging(actual, expected)` `:39-43`: `|actual − expected| > max(|expected| × 1.5, 0.25 kg/wk)` —
    the absolute floor keeps a maintain goal sane.
  - **COMP-027 Class B body-data rules** (`:10-14`): a bodyweight surface **never wears red** (the dot caps at
    `'watch'`, never `'act'`), the weight numeral is never coloured, and **under an open ED/wellbeing flag the
    card drops to direction-only copy with no rate, no maintenance number and no dot** (`:95-116`).
    Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE**.
  - Copy: state 1 "Log your weight for 7 days and your trend appears here."; state 2 "Still building
    confidence. Keep logging and this sharpens."; states 3-4 "Trending inside your band. Calories hold." /
    "Drifting a little above your band. Nothing to change yet." / "Trending a little under your target.
    Nothing to change yet."
  - Hook: `src/hooks/useWeightTrend.js` — 90-day window (the production 14-day window capped confidence at
    'low'), ED flag read **fails CLOSED** to `'read_failed'` (`:37-40`).
- **Units**: `src/lib/units.js` + `src/lib/format.js` (`toEnergy`, `energyUnitLabel`);
  `units ∈ {kg, lbs}` is threaded into `runWeeklyCoach` (`weeklyCoach.js:825`) purely for the delta label.
  Energy display unit `accessibility.energyUnit ∈ {kcal, kj}` is a separate accessibility preference.
- **Into coaching**: weigh-ins are the whole trend input for `onTarget`/`offTargetDirection`, the adaptive
  resize, the rapid-loss gate, the ED detector's s1, and the FFM-floor weight fallback.
  Direction: **weight → coaching is one-way**; coaching never writes a weight.
- **Into progress**: `BodyMetricsScreen` (1,892 lines) renders the EWMA weight line, the body-fat EWMA
  (`ewmaValues`), the adaptive maintenance estimate (`computeAdaptiveTDEEAdjustment` at `:560`), the phase
  chip, and the recomposition reframe card (suppressed under calm mode / open ED flag).
