# F. SAFETY (nutrition side)

## F.1 ED-pattern detector — `src/lib/edPatternDetector.js` (157 lines)

Pure, no I/O. Locked in `MOVE_2_ED_PATTERN_DETECTION.md`.

**Constants** `:30-36`, re-exported as `ED_PATTERN_CONSTANTS` `:149-157`:
`RAPID_LOSS_PCT_PER_WEEK −1.5`, `LOW_ENERGY_THRESHOLD 2`, `LOW_ENERGY_MIN_WEEKS 2`,
`UNDER_ADHERENCE_MIN_WEEKS 2`, `UNDER_ADHERENCE_WINDOW 3`, `WEIGHT_ONLY_MIN_WEEKS 2`, `WEIGHT_ONLY_WINDOW 3`.

**Signals** (`detectEdPatternFlag`, `:56-74`):
| id | name | rule | helper |
|---|---|---|---|
| s1 | `rapid_loss` | weekly trend `<= −1.5 %BW` | `isRapidLoss` `:111-114` |
| s2 | `low_energy` | energy **recorded** and `<= 2` for both of the last 2 weeks | `isLowEnergySustained` `:116-120` |
| s3 | `sustained_under_adherence` | adherence `'under'` in `>= 2` of the last 3 weeks | `isUnderAdherenceSustained` `:122-127` |
| s4 | `weight_only_checkins` | `>= 2` of the last 3 weeks had a check-in **with** `hasFoodData === false` | `isWeightOnlyCheckins` `:129-137` |

s4 counts only weeks that actually had a check-in, so a user who simply skipped a week is not penalised.

**Threshold**: fires at `>= 2` signals, raised to `>= 3` when `goalLockAdvanced` (`:65`).
The header states explicitly (`:26-27`) that **the FFM energy floor is a separate guardrail and is never
affected by `goal_lock_advanced`**.

**Clearance** — `hasEdPatternCleared(userState, weeklyHistory)` `:83-107`. Requires **POSITIVE evidence**, never
the mere absence of data (audit 2026-07-01 HIGH, `:93-100`): both of the last 2 weeks must have
energy **recorded** and above threshold, adherence not `'under'`, and `hasFoodData === true`; and the weight
trend must be a real finite reading confirmed non-rapid. "A protective hold must NOT lift just because an
at-risk user stopped logging." Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE**.

**What an open flag suppresses**:
| Surface | Effect | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Coach calorie cut | any negative `calorieAdjustment` is nulled | `weeklyCoach.js:1415-1425` |
| Auto-apply (Coached mode) | `autoApplyHoldActive` forces confirm-first | `weeklyCoach.js:1496-1506` |
| D15 volume escalation | gated off entirely | `weeklyCoach.js:1528-1543` |
| D18 photo corroboration | `photoCorroborationBlocked` | `weeklyCoach.js:1704-1711` |
| Calorie banking | disabled; a persisted bank stops displaying | `DiaryScreen.js:422-423`, `calorieBank.js:171-173` |
| Weight-trend card | direction-only, no rate/maintenance/dot | `weightTrend.js:95-116` |
| Step-trend line | suppressed | `weightTrend.js:59-68` |
| Recomposition reframe | `{ render: false }` | `recompReframe.js:108` |
| Weight/food-adjacent notifications | never scheduled; already-laid ones cancelled | `notifications/scheduler.js:107,128,157,210,553,583,646,744,859,977,1004` |
| Contest countdown | hidden | `contestCountdown.js:88-91` |
| "Great week" share card | withheld | `shareCard/greatWeek.js:33` |
| Coach report | held types redacted | `coachReport.js:66` |

**Persistence**: `ed_pattern_flags` table (`database.js:1038-1050`), one open row per user.
`getOpenEdPatternFlag` / `raiseEdPatternFlag` / `clearEdPatternFlag` `:8037-8088`.
Written **automatically** by `CoachOutputScreen.js:1802-1826` on the run that fires or clears, which also
cancels the morning/evening weigh-in prompts immediately (Q1 ED-safety: their weekly triggers are laid days
ahead and would otherwise fire in the background where no delivery handler runs) and re-lays them on clear.
Synced as `ed_pattern_flags` (`registry.js:130`).

**Goal lock** — `user_body_profile.goal_lock_advanced` (`database.js:1066-1067`),
`setGoalLockAdvanced`/`getGoalLockAdvanced` `:8092-8110`. Screen
`src/screens/GoalLockConsentScreen.js`, reached from the Coach tab as a self-serve edit surface (the
onboarding interstitial was removed 2026-05-29). Two options: `advanced` ("I have prior experience or I'm
working with a coach") raises the ED threshold from 2 signals to 3, **FFM floor still applies**; `standard`
(default) keeps 2. `shouldShowGoalLockOnboarding` (`coachingGoals.js:183-187`) is the remaining predicate.

**Locked copy** — `src/lib/whyThisTemplates.js:534-560` `ED_PATTERN_LOCKOUT_COPY`, verbatim per
`MOVE_2_ED_PATTERN_DETECTION.md`, **identical for free, pro and complete users**:
header "Held this week"; title "We've held your calorie cut"; body naming the three signals and
"Even when a cut is going well in numbers, sustained low energy is a safety signal. We'd rather pause than
push. / Once your fuelling and energy recover for two weeks, we'll suggest new targets.";
`bodyGoalLockExtension` for the 3-signal case; `ctaSupport 'Get support'`;
`bottomNote` "You can keep using Volyume normally. Your weight log, food diary, training, and check-ins all
continue. Only the calorie target stops shifting."; and a `readMoreBody` naming relative energy deficiency and
stating "The hold is not a punishment."
`ED_PATTERN_CLEARED_COPY` `:553-560`. `RAPID_LOSS_CORRECTED_COPY` `:568-577`: "We've added calories straight
away … This isn't a punishment for hitting your goal too fast. It's a safety call. Steady is the goal."
`ED_SUPPORT_LINKS` `:579-585` (`en-GB` Beat, `en-US` NEDA, `en-AU` Butterfly, default Beat) +
`getEdSupportLink(locale)`.

**Card**: `src/components/food/HeldDecisionCard.js` — amber "Held this week" badge, plain body, optional
"Why?" link, and a **"Get support" button linking to Beat** for `type === 'ed_pattern'` only. The link never
dead-ends: on failure it surfaces the address in an alert (`:19-25`).

## F.2 Wellbeing — `src/lib/wellbeing.js` (36 lines)

`WELLBEING_KEY = '@volyume_wellbeing_mode'`, values `'calm' | 'normal' | 'unspecified'` (default), asked once
during first run and changeable in Settings. Stored in AsyncStorage.
`WELLBEING_HELPLINE` (`:16-17`): **"If you're struggling, Beat Eating Disorders UK: 0808 801 0677 (free,
confidential)."** `isCalm(mode)` `:34-36`.

Calm mode on nutrition surfaces:
- `NutritionTargetsScreen.js:303-311` reads the mode and treats a **read failure as calm/suppressed**
  (`isCalm(m) || m === 'read_failed'`) — fail closed. It then removes `aggressive_cut` from the goal list
  entirely (`:622`, `:817`).
- `weeklyCoach.js` `calmMode` gates the D15 over-performance escalation (`:1542`), contributes to
  `autoApplyHoldActive` (`:1505`) and to `photoCorroborationBlocked` (`:1710`).
- `recompReframe` and the progress-scan coach note are suppressed under calm mode.
- Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE** for the gates, **SOFT COACHING RULE** for the copy softening.

## F.3 SCOFF wellbeing screen — `src/screens/WellbeingCheckScreen.js`

Five SCOFF questions (`:16-22`), private, "stored only on this device". Score = count of `true`
(`:71`), written to `userProfile.scoffScore` (local, authoritative for gating) and best-effort to
`user_body_profile.scoffScore` with an explicit failure log (audit F-007, `:74-79`).
`score >= 2` shows: "Thank you for sharing that — Some of your answers suggest it may be worth speaking to
your GP or a registered dietitian alongside your training. We've noted this so your coaching focuses on
performance and support rather than restriction."
Consumed as `scoffPositive = (userProfile.scoffScore ?? 0) >= 2`, which **holds the entire calorie block**
(`weeklyCoach.js:954`), contributes to `autoApplyHoldActive` and `photoCorroborationBlocked`, and gates the
D15 escalation. Classification: **HARD SAFETY RULE**.

## F.4 Tier-blindness verification

`proGate.js:22-23` states the mandate. Verified by inspection: `nutritionEngine.js` imports nothing at all;
`edPatternDetector.js` imports nothing; `coachApply.js` imports nothing; `wellbeing.js` imports only
AsyncStorage; `weeklyCoach.js` receives `userTier` **only** for the differential-paywall detector
(`:630`, `:1656-1667`) and never reads it in any calorie, macro, floor or hold path. The ED lockout copy
states "Identical for free, pro, complete users" (`whyThisTemplates.js:531`) and the rapid-loss copy states
"safety output is tier-blind" (`:566-567`).

## F.5 Classification summary

**HARD SAFETY RULES** (never weaken; every one is enforced at more than one boundary):
1. Sex calorie floors 1500 male / 1200 female-or-unknown — engine `:874-881`, apply `coachApply.js:29-38`,
   bank `calorieBank.js:149-151`, macro cycle `coachApply.js:151-159`, per-day offsets
   `effectiveTargets.js:44-58`, plan edit `planEdit.js:193-196`.
2. FFM energy floor 30 kcal/kg — `nutritionEngine.js:117`, `:386-404`; `weeklyCoach.js:1109-1154`;
   `safeDayFloorKcal`.
3. 1.5 %BW/week hard loss gate — engine `:890-899`; coach `rapidLossOverride` `:931-936`;
   `rapidWeightLossFlag` `:1256-1266`; ED s1 `edPatternDetector.js:30`.
4. Upward-only clamps: `rapidLossOverride` (`nutritionEngine.js:410-412`), FFM floor clamps cuts only.
5. ED-pattern lockout nulls any negative calorie adjustment; clearance requires positive evidence.
6. `autoApplyHoldActive` forces confirm-first in every autonomy mode.
7. Safety reads fail CLOSED: ED flag (`DiaryScreen.js:230-234`, `useWeightTrend.js:37-40`), wellbeing mode
   (`NutritionTargetsScreen.js:303-311`), `withReadOnlyProGuard`'s existence check
   (`ProGate.js:339-348`).
8. Class-B display rules: weight surfaces never wear red; ED flag reduces the trend card to direction-only.
9. `nutrientSummary` holds no concept of a limit or a target, by design.
10. Diary timeline never computes a fasting window, meal-timing gap, or early/late judgement.
11. Planned entries never count towards rollups, adherence, or the FFM floor until confirmed.

**SOFT COACHING RULES**: 0.8 %BW/week recommendation; the two-week cooldown and
`consecutiveOffTargetWeeks` gates; `cycleOverride` hold; `foodDiaryStandsIn`; adaptive resize (same-direction
only); `computeStepTrendModifier` (dead in production).

**UX WARNINGS**: the EA caution + ease nudge; engine `warnings[]` strings; `ocrParser.fieldNeedsCheck` amber
flags; `sanityChecks` reasons; the "best-effort, check the label" framing of allergen filtering.

**INFORMATIONAL COPY**: `femaleNutritionAwareness`; `cycleTrendAnnotation`; `freshness.formatLastVerified`;
`mealAdditions` intro/footnote; `recompReframe`; `WELLBEING_HELPLINE`; `ED_SUPPORT_LINKS`;
`NutritionEducationScreen` (ungated, `RootNavigator.js:139`).

# I. INTERACTIONS

## I.1 Nutrition → training volume (ONE-WAY)

`TRAINING_PHASES[].coachingPhaseKey` → `phaseToCoachingKey` (`coachingGoals.js:307-321`, which logs a warning
on an unknown phase rather than silently defaulting) → `planEngine.NUT_MULT` (`src/lib/planEngine.js:82-89`):

| nutrition phase | MEV × | MRV × |
|---|---|---|
| lean_gain | 0.95 | 1.10 |
| build | 0.95 | 1.10 |
| maintain | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| recomp | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| mild_cut | 1.00 | 0.90 |
| aggressive_cut | 1.05 | 0.80 |

Combined multiplicatively with experience, recovery and age multipliers at `planEngine.js:106-123`, with a
clash guard (`MEV >= MRV → MEV = max(2, MRV − 2)`) and a minimum-4-set floor for non-zero-MEV muscles.
**Note the naming**: `phaseToNutritionKey` feeds `calculateNutritionTargets`; `phaseToCoachingKey` feeds
`planEngine.NUT_MULT` and `weeklyCoach.PHASE_CONFIG`. `NUT_MULT` is keyed on the **nutrition** vocabulary
(`lean_gain`/`build`/`mild_cut`/…), not the coaching one — see UNCERTAINTIES U4.

Training volume never writes back into any nutrition target. Direction: **one-way, nutrition → training**.

## I.2 Deload ↔ diet break (INDEPENDENT, co-surfaced)

Both are computed in the same run but from disjoint inputs. Deload: `deloadTriggers >= 2` from
`consecutivePoorRecoveryWeeks >= 2`, `matrixDeload`, `weeksInPhase >= 6 && phase.isCut`, and
`sleepHours < 6 && poorEnergy` (`weeklyCoach.js:1268-1285`). Diet break: weeks in deficit only.
Note `weeksInPhase >= 6 && isCut` is the one shared term — a long cut contributes to BOTH a deload trigger and
(at 8 weeks) a diet-break suggestion. The `whyThisWeek` ladder ranks `deload_suggested` above
`diet_break_suggested` (`:1610-1611`), so only one is narrated as primary. Each has its own Apply row.

## I.3 Nutrition ↔ recovery (ONE-WAY into the coach; a second path is dead)

Live: recovery signals (energy, soreness, stress, sleep, joint pain, note flags) **gate** nutrition changes —
`poorRecovery` feeds `autoApplyHoldActive`, pauses cardio, and blocks a step bump; `energyScore <= 2` is half
the rapid-loss condition and ED signal s2. Nutrition does not modify recovery scoring.
Dead: `getPlanNutritionContext.recoveryModifier`/`deloadFrequencyWeeks` (LEGACY-UNREACHABLE, A.1).

## I.4 Nutrition ↔ bodyweight (TWO-WAY)

Weight → nutrition: trend drives `onTarget`, the adaptive resize, the rapid-loss gate, the ED detector, and
the FFM-floor weight input. Nutrition → weight: only via the real world; the app writes no weight.
But note `calculateNutritionTargets` reads the **latest logged weight**
(`ProGoalSetupScreen.js:295-302` refreshes the profile weight from BodyMetrics before recalculating), so a new
weigh-in changes the next computed target. Effectively **two-way through the user**.

## I.5 Check-in ↔ targets (TWO-WAY)

Check-in → targets: `calsAdherence`, `energyScore`, `cycleOverride`, `notes` all gate or size the weekly
calorie change, which is written to `nutrition_targets` on Apply.
Targets → check-in: `hasNutritionTarget` gates whether the calorie-adherence question is asked at all
(`WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:692`), and `targetKcal` is what `deriveCalsAdherence` pre-selects against
(`:505-509`). Genuinely bidirectional.

## I.6 Coach → meal plan → diary (ONE-WAY chain)

`handleApplyCalories` → `saveNutritionTargets` → `applyCoachAdjustmentToActivePlan` → `applyMacroDeltaToPlan`
→ `buildPlanEditNarration` shown on the coach card (`CoachOutputScreen.js:1186-1207`). Separately the diary
re-reads `nutrition_targets` on focus and resolves `effectiveTargets` over it. The plan is never read back
into a target.

## I.7 Calorie bank ↔ meal plan (TWO-WAY within the plan)

`applyBank` calls `resyncBankedPlannedFood` to move the planned FOOD to the banked targets; `clearBank` calls
`restoreUnbankedPlannedFood`. The stored meal plan is the **un-banked source of truth** and is never mutated,
which is what makes the restore possible (`mealPlanService.js:527-531`).

## I.8 Food logging → coach (ONE-WAY, load-bearing)

`food_entries` (confirmed only) → `daily_intake_rollups` → `getRecentIntakeSummary` → three distinct coach
inputs: the FFM floor gate, the B1 `actualIntakeKcal` model input, and the `foodDiaryStandsIn` unfreeze.
Also → `hasFoodData` in `recentWeeklyHistory` → ED signals s3 and s4.

# J. STATE

## J.1 Phase / goal vocabularies (three of them, mapped)

| layer | vocabulary | source |
|---|---|---|
| User-facing phase (`trainingPhase`) | `lean_gain, bulk, strength_size, weak_point, cut, recomp, maintain` | `coachingGoals.TRAINING_PHASES:223-293` |
| Nutrition key (`goal`) | `lean_gain, build, maintain, recomp, mild_cut` (+ `aggressive_cut` only via the targets screen) | `phaseToNutritionKey:300-302` → `nutritionEngine.PHASE_ADJUSTMENTS` |
| Coaching key (`goalPhase`) | `mild_bulk, bulk→mod_bulk, mild_cut, recomp, maint` | `phaseToCoachingKey:307-321` → `weeklyCoach.PHASE_CONFIG` + `planEngine.NUT_MULT` |

Physique divisions (`trainingGoal`): `general` plus 8 divisions (`PHYSIQUE_GOALS:26-112`).
`isCompetitionGoal` (`:193-195`) covers 7 of them (**`womens_physique` is in `PHYSIQUE_GOALS` and in
`ADVANCED_PROTEIN_GOALS` but NOT in `_GOAL_LOCK_COMPETITION_VALUES`** — see UNCERTAINTIES U3).

Legacy migration: `migrateProfileGoals` (`:396-424`) rewrites `general_hypertrophy`,
`strength_hypertrophy` and `weak_point_spec` on every profile load without forcing re-onboarding.

## J.2 Goal changes

`ProGoalSetupScreen.js:224-330` writes, in one profile update: `trainingGoal`, `trainingPhase`, `goalPhase`,
`goal` (= `phaseToNutritionKey(phase)`, kept in step so surfaces reading `userProfile.goal` match the saved
calories), `proteinApproach`, `goalStartDate`, `planWeakPoints`, and the training setup fields. Then it
recalculates and saves nutrition targets. If the recalc throws the goal save still lands and the user is
toasted "Goal saved, but targets didn't recalculate. Open Nutrition Targets to refresh" — no silent failure.
`GoalChangeSummaryScreen` explains the change in plain English beforehand and reads the ED flag.

## J.3 Goal lock

`goalLockAdvanced` — `user_body_profile.goal_lock_advanced`, read into the coach run
(`CoachOutputScreen.js:1747`). Effects: raises the ED threshold 2→3 (`edPatternDetector.js:65`) and is one of
the two ways to unlock day calorie cycling (`coachingGoals.js:215-217`). It **never** touches the FFM floor.

## J.4 Persistence map

| State | Where | Synced | Notes |

| `nutrition_targets` (targetKcal, macros, tdee, bmr, phase, goal, protein_approach, warnings) | SQLite | yes (bidirectional) | one row/user |
| `food_entries` | SQLite | yes (bidirectional, soft delete) | `is_planned` excluded from rollups; **see U1** |

| `foods` (library cache) | SQLite | seeded + delta-pulled | not per-user |

| `morning_weights` / `body_metric_log` | SQLite | yes (`weight_log`, `body_composition_log`) | |
| `ed_pattern_flags` | SQLite | yes | server-authoritative-ish, one open row |

| `userProfile.mealPlanExcludeTags` (allergens) | AsyncStorage | **yes** | deliberately synced: "an allergy silently lost on a device change is not an acceptable failure" (`store:1806-1814`, migration 112) |

# UNCERTAINTIES

**U1 — Numbered meal slots may not be reaching the cloud.** `supabase/migrate_059_meal_slots_numbered.sql` is
recorded as **HELD** in `supabase/README.md:25`, `:47`, `:56`, `:85` ("049 and 059 remain HELD … until the
next AAB ships"). Until applied, `food_entries.meal_slot` still carries the six-value CHECK from migrations
015/057, so any row written with `meal_1..meal_N` — which is the diary's **default** model
(`mealSlots.js:141-153`, `DEFAULT_MEALS_PER_DAY = 4`) — fails the CHECK on push. The migration header
(`:26-30`) says the failure is caught per table so the row stays local and the wider sync run still succeeds.
I could not verify from the repository whether 059 has since been applied out-of-band; the README is the
authoritative tracker and still lists it as held. If it genuinely is held, **most food-diary entries written
by the current client do not sync**. This needs founder verification against production, not a code read.

**U2 — `getPlanNutritionContext` is dead but not deleted.** No production caller (A.1). Its
`refeedRecommendation` (frequencyWeeks 2, durationDays 2, aggressive_cut only), `recoveryModifier`,
`volumeCeiling`, `failureExposureLevel` and `deloadFrequencyWeeks` therefore describe behaviour the app does
not exhibit. It also contains the only live use of `PROTEIN_MAX_GKGBW = 2.2`. I have classified it
LEGACY-UNREACHABLE on grep evidence; I cannot rule out a dynamic/`require`-based caller I did not find, though
none appeared in a repo-wide search.

**U3 — `womens_physique` is not a competition goal for the macro-cycle/refeed gate.**
`_GOAL_LOCK_COMPETITION_VALUES` (`coachingGoals.js:173-181`) lists `mens_physique, classic_physique,
bodybuilding, bikini, figure, wellness, womens_bodybuilding` — it omits `womens_physique`, which IS in
`PHYSIQUE_GOALS` (`:94-102`) and IS in `ADVANCED_PROTEIN_GOALS` (`nutritionEngine.js:783-786`). Consequences:
a Women's Physique competitor does not get the goal-lock onboarding prompt, does not qualify for refeeds
(`weeklyCoach.js:1354`), and reaches day calorie cycling only via `goalLockAdvanced`. Whether that omission is
intentional is not documented in code.

**U4 — `NUT_MULT` key vocabulary.** `planEngine.NUT_MULT` (`:82-89`) is keyed on `lean_gain, build, maintain,
recomp, mild_cut, aggressive_cut` — the **nutrition** vocabulary — while the comment at `coachingGoals.js:221`
says `coachingPhaseKey` "maps to planEngine NUT_MULT and weeklyCoach phaseConfig". `coachingPhaseKey` values
are `mild_bulk, bulk, mild_cut, recomp, maint`. Only `mild_cut` and `recomp` are in both sets, so if
`getAdjustedLandmarks` is actually passed a `coachingPhaseKey`, `mild_bulk`/`bulk`/`maint` would all fall to
the `{1.00, 1.00}` default and the surplus/maintenance volume overlay would be inert. I did not trace the
`nutritionPhase` argument to its call sites (out of this lane — that is B2/training), so I am flagging the
vocabulary mismatch rather than asserting a bug.

**U5 — `aggressive_cut` reachability.** It is absent from `TRAINING_PHASES` but present in
`NutritionTargetsScreen.GOALS`. So a user can set `aggressive_cut` on the targets screen while their
`trainingPhase`/`goalPhase` remain something else, and the weekly coach would read `goalPhase` (e.g.
`mild_cut`) rather than the targets screen's goal. Whether the two are reconciled anywhere is not visible from
the nutrition lane; `weeklyCoach` only ever reads `userProfile.goalPhase`
(`CoachOutputScreen.js:1718`), never `nutrition_targets.goal`.

**U6 — `parseNoteFlags.menstrual` bypasses the cycle opt-in.** `cycleOverride` requires the AsyncStorage
opt-in (`cyclePrefs.shouldShowCycleQuestion`), but `noteFlags.menstrual` (`weeklyCoach.js:452`) is regex over
free text and feeds `cycleTrendAnnotation` regardless of the opt-in. Since the annotation only ever adds a
reassuring line for a female user who wrote about her period, this reads as benign, but it is an inconsistency
in how the Article 9 opt-in is honoured across the two paths.

**U7 — Two independent FFM-floor evaluations per coach run.** `weeklyCoach.js:997-1002` builds an
`ffmFloorContext` for the adaptive call, and `:1129-1154` runs a second, separately-gated evaluation whose
weight fallback differs (profile weight → today's EWMA vs profile weight → last series weight). They will
normally agree, but I did not find a test pinning them to the same weight input, and a divergence would
produce a slightly different floor in the two places.

**U8 — Step-trend modifier status.** The single production caller passes `dailyStepsSeries: null` with the
comment "Step targets are not part of the shipped coaching product" (`CoachOutputScreen.js:1714-1716`). I have
classified `computeStepTrendModifier` and the whole step prescription block as INTERNAL/dead. If steps are
intended to ship, this is a wiring gap, not a maths gap. `daily_steps` still syncs (`registry.js:111`) and
`stepsSummary.js`/`activitySteps.js` still exist, so the data path is alive while the coaching path is not.

**U9 — Recipe/OFF network reachability not verifiable statically.** `isAllowedRecipeUrl`
(`recipeImport.js:163`) and the OFF/USDA endpoints depend on runtime network and build-time env
(`EXPO_PUBLIC_USDA_API_KEY`). I have marked USDA LIVE-COND(env var set) but cannot confirm from the repo
whether the key is set in the production EAS profile.

# CHAPTER D1 — PROGRESS, CHECK-INS, COACHING SURFACES, EDUCATION (covers PARTS 7, 8, 20)

# VOLYUME — LANE D1 SYSTEM MAP
## Progress / Analytics · Check-ins · Coaching output · Progress photos & scans · Explanation & education

Read-only archaeology of `/home/user/ADPhysique` as it stands on 2026-08-09.
Every claim below carries a repo-relative reference. British English throughout.

### Evidence key

| Tag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **LIVE** | Reachable by a real user on a shipped surface with no extra condition beyond navigation |
| **LIVE-COND** | Reachable, but only when a named condition holds (tier, data threshold, flag, preference) |
| **INTERNAL** | Real code with real consumers, but the consumer is another module, not a user-visible surface |
| **DARK** | Exported, tested, but no application import path reaches it (test-only reachability) |
| **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE** | Code kept deliberately for historic rows / future use; cannot fire on current write paths |
| **PLANNED-DOC-ONLY** | Described in docs/comments, no shipping implementation |
| **UNCERTAIN** | Recorded in the UNCERTAINTIES section, never guessed at here |

## A.1 Metric register

Format: **Name** | Definition | Raw source | Calculation module | Window | Personalisation | Shown | Decisions consuming | User decision supported.

### A.1.1 Body-weight family

**1. Morning weight (raw)** — a single logged bodyweight reading.
Raw source: `morning_weights` table (Home quick weigh-in, `HomeScreen.handleLogWeight` → `logMorningWeight`) **and** `body_metric_log` (BodyMetrics "Log weight" form → `logBodyMetric`). The split is accidental, documented at `src/lib/bodyMetricsHistoryMerge.js:1-16`.
Calculation: none. Merge/dedupe by calendar day: `mergeMorningWeightsIntoHistory` (`bodyMetricsHistoryMerge.js:91`), canonical engine series via `buildWeighInSeries` (`:73`, oldest-first `{weightKg, loggedAt}`, local-midday anchor).
Window: `getMorningWeightsLast14Days` for check-in/coach; 120 rows for the coach report (`coachReport.js:271`).
Personalisation: display unit `bodyWeightUnits` ('st' default, `WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:301`).
Shown: BodyMetrics history, Home TodayStrip, check-in step 1 (`WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:955-970`).
Consumed by: everything below. Status **LIVE**.

**2. EWMA trend weight (slow, α = 0.1)** — smoothed weight, ~10-day memory.
`computeEWMA(weights, alpha = 0.1)` (`src/lib/weeklyCoach.js:40`); latest `getLatestEwma` (`:62`); 7-days-ago `getEwmaSevenDaysAgo` (`:91`).
Corrupt-row guard: rows must be finite **and > 0** (`:47`, F3/EN-6) — a 0 kg sync artefact is dropped.
`getEwmaSevenDaysAgo` returns **null** when no reading is ≥7 days old (`:100`, D1 #3) rather than scaling a short span as a weekly rate.
Window: trailing 7 days against the latest reading.
Shown: check-in step 1 "trend {x}" (`WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:960`); CoachOutput StatChip labelled "7-day trend" (`CoachOutputScreen.js:2529`), tooltip `GLOSSARY.ewma` (`:2535`); BodyMetrics (`BodyMetricsScreen.js:1124`).
**Decisions consuming: the SAFETY reads only** — rapid-loss gate, +calorie boost magnitude, ED detector (`weeklyCoach.js:790-793` comment; `rapidLossOverride` at `:931`, `rapidWeightLossFlag` at `:1261`, `computeWeeklyTrendPct` at `:74`).
User decision supported: "is my weight actually moving, or is that just today's water?"
Status **LIVE**.

**3. Robust tracking trend (Holt's level+trend + asymmetric Huber clamp)** — the water-weight-robust DECISION trend.
`robustTrackingEwma` (`src/lib/robustTrend.js:182`), latest `robustTrackingLatest` (`:219`), 7-days-ago `robustTrackingSevenDaysAgo` (`:228`).
Constants `ROBUST_TRACKING_DEFAULTS` (`:173`): α 0.1, β 0.05, k 1.5 upward knee, madWindow 14, scaleFloor 0.25 kg, downwardKnee 4 (losses pass ≈ undamped).
Scale is **median |residual|**, not MAD, deliberately (`:199-204`) — MAD collapsed during sustained trends and caused the held COMP-024 promotion.
Window: trailing 7 days.
Shown: **nowhere directly.** This is a decision-only quantity.
Decisions consuming: `decisionRatePct` (`weeklyCoach.js:803`) → `onTarget` (`:813`) and `offTargetDirection` (`:817`) → every calorie / steps / cardio branch.
Status **INTERNAL** (never rendered).

**3b. Display robust smoother** — `robustEwma` (`robustTrend.js:63`) / `robustValues` (`:103`), clamped against the LEVEL. Display-only by intent (`:98-101`).
Shown: coach handover report trend table (`coachReport.js:288`), BodyMetrics trend takeaway.

### A.1.5 Consistency / streaks

**32. Weeks-running streak** — `computeStreak({weeks, edSuppressed})` (`src/lib/streak.js:125`).
Per-week states: `in-progress | kept | resting | paused | repaired | missed`. `KEEPING` = kept/resting/paused/repaired (`:26`).
Rules (`:16-22`, `labelBase` `:34`, `applyRepair` `:48`):
- the current week is never judged;
- kept = `completed >= target`, target from the plan or the user's own goal; with no target the run number is hidden entirely (`runLength = null`, `:144`);
- an engine deload week is `resting` and keeps the run with zero sessions;
- one missed week sandwiched between keeping weeks is `repaired`, capped at one per rolling 6 weeks (`REPAIR_WINDOW = 6`, `:27`);
- an open ED/wellbeing flag freezes every week to `resting` and sets `suppressed` so the UI hides the number.
Hook: `src/hooks/useWeeklyStreak.js` (fail-closed raw wellbeing read at `:86-88`, `:119`).
Shown: `WeeklyStreakStrip` (`AnalyticsScreen.js:461`), `ConsistencyEcho`, `StreakWeeksSection`.
Glossary: `GLOSSARY.streakWeeks` (`coachGlossary.js:90`) shared by ConsistencyEcho (`:80`) and WeeklyStreakStrip (`:78`) so the two can never diverge.
Status **LIVE-COND** (`weeklyStreak.render`).

**33. Per-week seam for partners** — `computeWeekState({completed, planned, target, isDeload, paused, edSuppressed})` (`streak.js:80`) → `{planned, done, weekMet, state:'training'|'resting'}`.
Privacy property (`:74-76`): a wellbeing hold and a planned recovery week both read `resting`, so a partner cannot tell them apart.
Consumers: `src/lib/partners/sharedStreak.js`, `partners/service.js:457`, `partners/weekSignalWriter.js`.
Status **INTERNAL** (feeds the partner surface).

**34. Perfect month** — `detectPerfectMonth(weeks)` (`streak.js:105`). Four most-recent finished weeks all in `{kept, resting, paused}` — `repaired` is deliberately excluded (`:106-108`) — with ≥1 genuinely `kept` week and >0 sessions.
Consumed by `streakState.js:105`; shown at `AnalyticsScreen.js:479-493`.
Status **LIVE-COND**.

**35. Streak milestones / longest-run PB** — `STREAK_MILESTONE_COPY`, `pendingMilestone`, `longestRunPb` in `src/lib/streakState.js` (207 ln) → `AnalyticsScreen.js:462-510`. Share button appears at ≥12 weeks (`:466`).
Status **LIVE-COND**.

**36. Beginner milestone ladder** — `MILESTONES` (`src/lib/milestones.js:50-93`), seven rungs:
`first_week` (3 sessions inside any rolling 7-day window, `hasThreeInSeven` `:115`), `sessions_5`, `sessions_10`, `sessions_25`, `sessions_50`, `sessions_100`, `first_pr`.
Deliberately NOT rungs on the summary surface: the very first session (owned by COMP-013's calibrated header) and the first PR (owned by `PRCelebration`) — the caller passes `everHitPR: false` (`:19-26`).
`claimMilestones(userId, facts)` (`:190`) marks **every** earned-and-unseen rung seen but returns only the most significant, so an imported history never replays rung-by-rung.
ED/calm suppression is the caller's job — a suppressed surface skips the call so the rung is caught later, not fired into a void (`:27-31`).
Shown: `WorkoutSummaryScreen.js:567`.
Status **LIVE**.

**37. Recovery EMAs (soreness / fatigue / joint)** — `computeRecoveryEMAs(workouts, now)` (`src/lib/recoveryEMA.js:48`), half-life 7 days, `weight = 0.5^(ageDays/7)` (`:11, :31`).

Consumed by insight rule 4 at a ≥18 % threshold (`insightsEngine.js:173-174`).
Status **INTERNAL**.

**39. Readiness summary line** — `buildReadinessSummary({currentMesoWeek, deloadSuggestion, fatigueHistory, lastSession})` (`src/lib/readinessSummary.js:48`).
Priority ladder: (1) plan-scheduled deload → "Deload week, pull effort back."; (2) `shouldDeload` → "Recent training signals point towards easing off soon."; (3) last session's low readings → "Last time out you were {sore / short on sleep / low on energy}. Worth listening to that today."; (4) fatigue avg ≥ 3.5 over the last 2 sessions → "Fatigue has been building…"; (5) default block-phase chip "Week N of M - stop R short of failure".
Thresholds: `LOW_SLEEP_OR_ENERGY = 2`, `HIGH_SORENESS = 3`, `FATIGUE_TREND_THRESHOLD = 3.5` (shared with `buildCoachBrief`, `:25-30`).
Returns null with no active block (`:56`).
Rationale note in-source: the pre-workout soreness/sleep/energy readings "are written and never read back to the user anywhere; surfacing the low readings here closes that loop" (`:71-73`).
Shown: `HomeScreen.js:1399-1401, :1843-1855`.
Status **LIVE-COND**.

**40. Recovery score (engine)** — `getRecoveryScore(energyScore, sorenessScore, stressScore)` (`weeklyCoach.js:203`), grades 1–4:
4 if soreness ≥4; 3 if energy ≤2 or soreness ≥3; 1 if energy ≥4 and soreness ≤1; else 2.
Stress ≥4 can only worsen the read to 3, never improve it (PIPE-001 / ALGO-006, `:211-218`). Missing inputs default to 3 (`:204-205`).
Status **INTERNAL** (grade never shown; its consequences are).

**41. Peak-week context adjustment** — `contextAdjustedRecovery` (`weeklyCoach.js:268`).
A grade-3 read in the block's final accumulation week reads as 2 for the push/hold branch **only** when: soreness ≥3 AND energy ≥3 (or null) AND stress <4, block has ≥3 accumulation weeks, and both persistence counters (`consecutivePoorRecoveryWeeks`, `consecutiveGrade3RecoveryWeeks`) are 0.
The **deload branch always reads the RAW grade** (`:292-298`) — founder red line.
Emitted as `peakWeekContextApplied` (`:1785`); when it produces a push, the copy names the real mechanism instead of borrowing "recovery is excellent" (`:907-909`).
Status **INTERNAL** + **LIVE** (via the note).

**42. Performance score** — `getPerformanceScore(sessionAdherence, prsThisWeek, trainingPerformance, sessionsCompleted, blockE1rmSlopePct)` (`weeklyCoach.js:239`), grades 1–4.
Top grade needs `trainingPerformance === 'exceeded'` OR (PR **density** ≥ `PR_DENSITY_STRONG = 0.3`, i.e. ~1 all-time PR per 3 sessions, or `blockE1rmSlopePct >= BLOCK_SLOPE_STRONG_PCT = 1.5`) with adherence ≥0.9 (`:221-227, :244`).
Legacy binary (`prsThisWeek > 0`) still stands when no session count is supplied (`:240-242`).
Status **INTERNAL**.

**43. Autoregulation matrix** — `autoregulationMatrix(recoveryScore, performanceScore, recoveryForPush)` (`weeklyCoach.js:295`).
| Condition | volumeDelta | signal | deloadFlag |
|---|---|---|---|
| recovery 4, or recovery ≥3 AND performance 4 (RAW grade) | −2 | reduce | true |
| recoveryForPush 3 or performance 3 | 0 | hold | false |
| recoveryForPush 1 AND performance 1 | +3 | push | false |
| recoveryForPush 1 or performance 1 | +2 | push | false |
| both 2 | +1 | push | false |
Status **INTERNAL** → surfaced as the training card.

**44. Session adherence** — `sessionsCompleted / sessionsPlanned` (`weeklyCoach.js:856`).
Hard gate (Andy Morgan rule): `< 0.5` short-circuits the whole run into `_buildAdherenceOutput` (`:857-859, :1846`) — "Get back to your full plan before changing anything."
Status **LIVE** (as the adherence output).

**45. Data confidence** — `assessDataConfidence({weigh_ins, adherenceKnown, weeksInPhase, hasUnusualEvent})` (`weeklyCoach.js:114`).
- `<3` weigh-ins → **`data_hold`** with a locked hold message (`:118-123`);
- unusual event flagged with `<5` weigh-ins → `data_hold` (`:126-131`);
- `<5` weigh-ins → medium; adherence unknown → at least medium; `weeksInPhase < 2` → low; unusual event → at least medium.
Weigh-in count is **distinct local calendar days** in the 7 days ending at the most recent reading, not raw rows (`weighInDayCount`, `:679-692`) — three weigh-ins on one day no longer pass the gate. The result is always ≤ the old count, so this can only HOLD more, never adjust more (`:676-678`).
`hasUnusualEvent` = any non-empty check-in free-text note (`:697`).
Shown: `CONFIDENCE_CAPTIONS` (`src/lib/coachOutput/viewCopy.js:88-92`) rendered at `CoachOutputScreen.js:2690-2704`, with the "Only N weigh-ins landed this week" addendum keyed off the REAL logged confidence, never the photo-corroborated one (`:2696-2700`).
Status **LIVE**.

**46. Photo-corroborated confidence step** — `corroborateConfidenceLevel(baseLevel, photoCorroboration, {suppressed})` (`weeklyCoach.js:185`).
Ladder `['low','medium','high']` (`:152`), `data_hold` deliberately absent so a safety hold can never be lifted (`indexOf` → −1 → unchanged, `:190`).
Raises by **exactly one step**, only on `direction === 'supports'`, never lowers, never originates, clamped at `high`.
Moves **only** the emitted `confidence` display field; `offTargetWeeksRequired` and every downstream decision use the pre-corroboration level (`:160-168`, `:1688-1693`).
Blocked entirely (`photoCorroborationBlocked`, `:1704-1711`) under ED lockout, FFM floor, rapid loss, safety hold, positive wellbeing screen, or calm mode.
Status **LIVE-COND** (Pro + a scored scan at Moderate+ confidence with 3+ comparable points).

### A.1.8 Composed narratives

**50. Weekly story (4 chapters)** — `buildWeeklyStory({weekLabel, sessionStats, prsThisWeek, intake, targetKcal, coachOutput, isCurrentWeek, suppress})` (`src/lib/weeklyStory.js:134`).
Chapters in fixed order: Training → Eating → Weighing in → This week's decision (`:146-151`).
Eating "close to" band = ±5 % of target (`:64`).
Body chapter under `suppress`: direction-only, no numbers, no rate label, mirroring `deriveWeightTrend`'s ED branch (`:80-93`).
`suppress` = open ED flag OR calm mode OR a **failed** safety read (fail closed) — composed at `WeeklyStoryScreen.js:85-89`; the catch path calls `buildWeeklyStory({weekLabel, suppress: true})` (`:108`).
Status **LIVE-COND** (Pro).

**51. Coach brief (Home)** — `buildCoachBrief({fatigueHistory, deloadSuggestion, lastWorkoutDaysAgo, blockProgress})` (`src/lib/homeCoachBrief.js:10`).
Rules: (1) deload suggested → "Recovery week"; (2) avg fatigue of last 2 sessions ≥3.5 → "Fatigue building"; (3) ≥5 days since last session → "Good to see you back"; **(4) REMOVED** by founder ruling 2026-08-06 — "Muscle groups need attention" fired whenever 2+ muscles sat below their weekly minimum mid-week, which is the guaranteed mid-plan state, so the brief was telling users to override their own plan's rotation (`:42-47`); (5) avg fatigue ≤2 → "Looking good"; (6) default "Ready when you are".
`blockProgress` is still accepted but unused (`:8-10`).
Status **LIVE**.

**52. Free-tier weekly one-liner** — `buildFreeCoachLine({sessionsThisWeek, morningWeights, edFlagOpen, calmMode})` (`coachResponse.js:520`).
Free-safe by construction: sessions + **direction-only** weight (no rate, no figure, no units), needs ≥4 morning weights; suppressed entirely under a flag/calm (`:533`). Returns null rather than fabricating.
Shown: `HomeScreen.js:642`.
Status **LIVE-COND** (free tier).

**53. Insight cards ("For you")** — `generateInsights(args)` (`src/lib/insightsEngine.js:60`), `rankAndCapInsights(insights, max = 3)` (`:235`).
Six rules, severity 0 info / 1 notice / 2 warning:
| # | Type | Trigger | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `under_mev_muscle` | trained at all but under MEV for 3 rolling weeks; requires a real 3-week base (≥6 completed sessions spanning ≥3 weeks, `:79-80`) | 1 |
| 2 | `peaked_lift` | last 2 sessions hit the top of the rep range with rir ≥1 | 1 |
| 3 | `stalled_lift` | 4 sessions at identical top weight+reps with avg rir ≥3 | 1 |
| 4 | `recovery_warn` | soreness EMA week-over-week ≥ +18 % | 2 |
| 5 | `deload_due` | over MRV in ≥2 of the last 4 weeks, or fatigue EMA ≥4.3 | 2 |
| 6 | `gentle_rhythm` | trained ≥4 of the last 21 days (info, never a threat, `:211`) | 0 |
Malformed rows are filtered up front so one corrupt workout cannot crash the surface (`:64-66`).
Shown: `AnalyticsScreen.js:624-631`, dismissable.
Status **LIVE**.

**54. Plateau banner** — `selectPlateauForBanner(sets, {now, maxStalenessMs})` (`src/lib/plateauSurfacing.js:33`).
Reuses `detectPlateau` from `algorithms.js` read-only; needs ≥3 sessions per exercise; a lift untouched for >14 days (`PLATEAU_MAX_STALENESS_MS`, `:21`) is a dropped lift, not a plateau. One banner slot: longest stall wins, ties by most sets, then most recent.
ED note in-source: input is `workout_sets` only, so it is training-only and needs no suppression — with an explicit instruction to add the same gate if that ever changes (`:8-12`).
Copy: `plateauBannerLine(exerciseName, weeks)` (`:101`).
Shown: `HomeScreen.js:769`.
Status **LIVE**.

Stat row: Sessions, Sets (`GLOSSARY.workingSets` tooltip, `:229`), Volume/tonnage (`GLOSSARY.tonnage`, `:234`), Avg session.
Records list with `GLOSSARY.estMax` on `1rm_estimate` rows (`:265`).

**56. Chart windowing + takeaways** — `src/lib/chartWindows.js`.
`TREND_WINDOWS` 1M/3M/6M/Y (`:17-22`), `VOLUME_WINDOWS` 4W/8W/3M/6M (`:24-29`), default `3M` (`:31`).
`pickInitialWindowKey` widens to the widest window holding ≥2 points rather than showing a dead default (`:66`).
`windowPhrase` says "All N weeks/months" when the window reaches past the earliest datum, so the label never over-claims (`:84`).
Takeaways: `weightTakeaway` (`:118`, **average only, no direction or delta, under an ED flag** `:122-124`), `e1rmTakeaway` (`:135`), `volumeTakeaway` (`:149`), `workloadTakeaway` (`:185`).

**Neutral variant** when: open ED flag, SCOFF ≥2, calm mode, or a FAILED read of the flag or body profile (`:265-266`) — bodyweight rows are never even read (`:271`).

Artefact class is explicitly the opposite of a share card: the user's own complete data, on-device, shared only by explicit action (`:8-16`).

## B.1 Does the scan actually do ML/vision? YES — on-device, two engines, no network

Verified in `src/lib/progressScanVision.js`:

- **Primary engine: TFLite.** `MODEL_SOURCE = require('../../assets/ml/selfie_segmentation_v2.tflite')` (`:44`), run through `react-native-fast-tflite`.
  Model: **MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation (general), 256×256**, converted to builtin ops only (PINTO model zoo #109). Version string `mediapipe_selfie_segmentation_general_builtin_ops_v2` (`:21`).
  IO contract: `[1,256,256,3] float32` in → `[1,256,256,1] float32` sigmoid mask out, enforced by `validateProgressScanModelContract` (`:84-108`).
  **Root-cause history in-source (`:3-20`):** the ORIGINAL asset contained the MediaPipe-proprietary custom op `Convolution2DTransposeBias`, which stock TFLite could not resolve — interpreter construction threw on **every** device, both platforms, so *the TFLite path had never worked and every scan silently rode the native fallback* (Sentry VOLYUME-1F). The v2 filename is deliberately different because `resolveBundledModel` caches by name.
- **Fallback engine: native.** `PROGRESS_SCAN_NATIVE_SEGMENTATION_MODEL_VERSION = 'mlkit_selfie_segmentation_16.0.0-beta6'` (`:22`) — Android ML Kit.
- **Measurement, not classification.** After segmentation the mask is measured: `measureMaskSignals` (`:670`) places anatomical bands; `blurScoreFromRgb` (`:399`) is a local sharpness measure.
  `PROGRESS_SCAN_MEASUREMENT_VERSION = 'silhouette_bands_anatomical_v3'` (`:42`), versioned independently of the model so two scans measured differently are never compared as if the body changed.
  **v1→v2 history (`:28-38`, founder real-device evidence 2026-07-13):** v1 bands sat one anatomical station too low across the board — "waist" read the hip/crotch region including loose shorts, "hip" read mid-thigh and was bimodal on stance (`waistToHip` reached an impossible 3.1 on one device), "thigh" read the knee. v2 places true stations, sums split limb segments so legs-apart measures the same tissue as legs-together, and restricts geometry to the dominant mask component.
  **v3 (same day):** hands hanging beside the hips were being summed into hip and thigh widths; sub-half-width runs are now dropped ("tighten the hip read").
- **Body-fat estimator asset:** `assets/ml/progress_scan_bf_estimator_v1.json`, imported at `progressScanAnalysis.js:1`, version `PROGRESS_SCAN_ESTIMATOR_VERSION = bfEstimatorAsset.id` (`:8`). Used by `estimateBodyFatFromScanAssets` (`:1556`).
- **Local or remote?** **Entirely local.** The model is a bundled asset resolved into `caches/progress_scan_models/` (`:19`); no network call exists in the module. `progressScanClassificationHistory.js:15-19` states the constraint explicitly: progress-photo scans "and every value derived from them stay on the device by constraint and never leave the phone", and the table is deliberately absent from `sync/registry.js` and `sync.js`.
- **No LLM anywhere.** Consistent with CLAUDE.md §2.

## B.2 What the scan produces

**Poses.** `REQUIRED_SCAN_POSES = ['front','back']`, `OPTIONAL_SCAN_POSES = ['side']` (`progressScanAnalysis.js:4-5`). `requiredPosesComplete` (`:144`), `requiredModelBackedPosesComplete` (`:169`).

**Quality gates** — `FINAL_SCAN_QUALITY_GATES` (`:16-27`): lighting 0.25, blur 0.18, framing 0.25, pose 0.22, segmentation 0.30, separation 0.20, **tiltDegrees 10** (tightened from 20 on founder real-device evidence: an 11° tilt collapsed the shoulder measurement while sailing under the old gate).

**Retake reasons** — `RETAKE_REASONS` (`progressScanVision.js:46-56`): too_dark, too_blurry, whole_body_not_visible, multiple_people, segmentation_low_confidence, clothing_or_background_uncertain, pose_not_clear, camera_tilted, silhouette_implausible.
`UNAVAILABLE_RETAKE_REASONS` (`:57-62`): no_person_detected, native_preprocess_unavailable, native_preprocess_shape_unusable, mask_shape_unusable.

**Score-withhold reasons** — `SCORE_WITHHOLD_REASONS` (`progressScanAnalysis.js:29-48`) adds: missing_required_pose, model_unavailable, measured_signals_incomplete, estimate_out_of_range, duplicate_pose_content, and `silhouette_implausible` ("a broken capture must withhold the score, never hand out a confidently wrong one", `:44-47`).

**The Volyume Score** — `computeVisualLeannessScore(inputs)` (`:551`), calibrated by `calibrateVolyumeScore(rawScore)` (`:631`), version `volyume_physique_scan_score_v2` (`:12`).
Required ratios: `waistToShoulder`, `waistToHip`, `waistToHeight`, `bodyAreaRatio` (`REQUIRED_SCORE_RATIO_KEYS`, `:15`).
Display always re-clamps to 0–100 because a corrupt STORED value once rendered "900/100" (`progressScanDisplay.js:14-19`, audit E-F2).

**Leanness bands** — `PROGRESS_SCAN_LEANNESS_BANDS` (`:50-58`): Foundation 0–49, Active 50–59, Athletic 60–69, Defined 70–79, Lean 80–89, Very Lean 90–96, Peak Condition 97–100.

**Progress signals** — `PROGRESS_SIGNAL_COPY` (`:60-69`): Baseline set, Clear positive trend, Slight positive trend, Holding steady, Slight drift, Clear drift, Trend not ready, Inconclusive.

**Confidence tiers** — high / moderate / low / not_enough / unknown (`:71-85`), ranked 3/2/1/0/0. `computeScanConfidenceScore({assets, biasFlags, inputs})` (`:479`).

**Bias flags** — `deriveProgressScanBiasFlagsFromProfile(profile)` (`:263`), `deriveBiasFlags({sex, userFlags, modelValidated, quality})` (`:280`). Uncertainty margin `uncertaintyMarginPctPoints({quality, biasFlags, baseMargin: 3.5})` (`:290`), range `buildEstimateRange` (`:309`).

**Comparability** — `scanSetupStability(currentScan, previousScan)` (`:1121`) and `scanComparability(currentScan, previousScan)` (`:1213`).
Minimum interval `PROGRESS_SCAN_MIN_COMPARISON_INTERVAL_MS = 7 days` (`:13`).
Delta explanation: `explainMeasuredScanDelta({currentScan, previousScan})` (`:1307`).

**Consent** — `PROGRESS_SCAN_CONSENT_VERSION = 'progress_scan_v1_2026-07-04'` (`:7`).

## B.3 The tier→render contract (the single enforcement point)

`buildScoreTierContract(scan, {suppressed, revealed})` (`progressScanResultsContract.js:52`) returns booleans a caller checks before rendering: `showScore`, `showBand`, `showTrendDirection`, `showTrendSize`, `requiresRevealAffordance`, `revealed`, `caveatText`, `accessibilityLabel`.

| State | showScore | showBand | Accessibility label |
|---|---|---|---|
| `suppressed` | false | false | "Score hidden." (`:72`) |
| no numeric score | false | false | "Not enough confidence. No score available." (`:91`) |
| tier `not_enough` (unknown tiers fold here, `:39-43`) | false | false | as above (`:112`) |
| tier `low` | only when `revealed` (`:118`) | — | requires an explicit per-scan "show score anyway" affordance; `revealed` is caller-owned and never persisted (`:50-51`) |
| tier `moderate` / `high` | true | true | chip label always accompanies the score (`:47-48`) |

Chip labels are a fixed set (`CONFIDENCE_CHIP_LABEL`, `:24-29`): "High confidence", "Moderate confidence", "Low confidence", "Not enough confidence".

`buildScanReceipt(scan, {previousScan})` (`:240`); `isRecalibratedAssessment` (`:293`) + `RECALIBRATION_NOTE_TEXT` = "Scores were recalibrated in an update. Your photos are unchanged." (`:301`).

**Meaning moment** — `MEANING_MOMENT_TITLE` "Before your first score", `MEANING_MOMENT_BODY`, `MEANING_MOMENT_BUTTON` "Understood" (`:304-307`), rendered by `src/components/ProgressScanMeaningMoment.js`, gated `meaningMomentSeen === false && scoredScans.length > 0 && !suppressed` (`ProgressPhotosScreen.js:1120`), seen-flag in `progressScanPreferences.js:131-145`.
**It shows once ever and is never reachable again** — this is precisely why finding O2 added the persistent `GLOSSARY.volyumeScore` tooltip carrying the same framing (`coachGlossary.js:92-105`).

## B.4 Trend view

`buildTrendPoints(scans)` (`progressScanTrendViewModel.js:40`) orders scans and classifies each against its **immediate predecessor only**, calling the engine's own `scanComparability` fresh per adjacent pair — never against a more distant scan (`:6-9, :52`).
Marker **shape** encodes confidence, never colour alone (`markerShapeForTier`, `:20-24`): solid = high/moderate, hollow = low, `unscored` = withheld/not-enough.
A low-tier point never shows its number in the trend view (`pointValueText`, `:30-34`) because the trend view has no per-point reveal affordance.
Language ladder `trendLadderLabel(comparableCount, totalCount)` (`:78`): chain length ≥3 → "A trend", 2 → "An early read", else "Your starting point". Never a streak/achievement framing (`:76-77`).
Empty state: `TREND_EMPTY_STATE_TEXT` = "Trends appear after three comparable photo sets." (`:15`).

## B.5 Coach evidence chain

**v1 resolver** — `resolveProgressScanCoachNote({scan, output, suppressed, trendOnly})` (`progressScanCoachResolver.js:97`).
Returns **null** when suppressed, when there is no scan, when `scan.source !== PHOTO_SCAN_SOURCE`, or when `scan.confidence === 'not_enough'` (`:103-104`).
Every returned note carries `usedFor: 'visual_trend_context_only'` and `affectsTargets: false` (`:141-142`).
`decisionLine(output)` (`:85`) always states non-authority: "Your weekly targets still come from your logs, weight trend, training and recovery, not from your photos." / "Photos never set your targets."
Wave 4 fix (`:115-127`): `decisionLine` is now appended to `foldedCoachLine` too, because `coachLine`'s not-comparable/baseline branches did not state non-authority — so **every** render path now carries the sentence. Guarded by `progressScanCoachIsolation.guard.test.js`.
Every string passes the shared jargon blocklist and an em/en-dash ban (`clean`, `:12-23`).

**v1 evidence shape** — `buildProgressScanCoachEvidence({scan, note})` (`progressScanCoachEvidence.js:87`).
`affectsTargets: false` is a **hard-coded literal, never a variable and never derived**, so flipping it requires editing that exact line; the guard test pins the literal, not just the runtime value (`:19-22`).
`PROGRESS_SCAN_COACH_EVIDENCE_USED_FOR_VALUES` is a frozen two-value enum (`:52-55`); widening it is a founder-approved event.
Known gaps documented, not silently filled: per-asset capture quality, scan id and baseline scan id are always null (`:25-38`).

**v2 packet** — `buildScanEvidencePacket` (`progressScanCheckInEvidence.js:377`), composed via `composeScanEvidencePacket({scan, note, weightTrend, goalPhase, targetsChanged, heldDecisions, loadSignal, nowMs, windowDays = 10})` (`:508`).
Frozen enums: `PROGRESS_SCAN_EVIDENCE_STATUS` = no_scan_ever, no_recent_scan, valid, low_confidence, withheld, not_comparable, baseline (`:88-96`); `PROGRESS_SCAN_ASSESSMENT` = supports, conflicts, visual_change_weight_stable, inconclusive, not_used, insufficient_data (`:98-105`).
Flat band `WEIGHT_FLAT_BAND_KG = 0.25`, reused from `weightTrend.js`'s maintain floor rather than invented (`:109-116`).
This module is **source-guarded to stay engine-import-free**: it mirrors `PHASE_ALIASES` and the SIGN of each phase's `goalRatePct` locally with the real numbers cited, rather than importing `weeklyCoach.js` (`:62-66, :118-134`).
Classification order (`:183-198`): 1 direct contradiction → `conflicts` with `conflictSource: 'scale'` (weight and intake always win); 2 both match the goal → `supports`; 3 scale plateaued but the scan still moves the goal's way → `visual_change_weight_stable` (the recomposition read); 4 anything else → `inconclusive`.
**`conflictSource: 'performance'` is deliberately NOT implemented** (`:199-207`): `loadSignal`'s vocabulary describes training-load progression, not body composition, and no non-invented mapping exists. `loadSignal` is accepted in the signature but never read.
`buildScanEvidenceReceipt(packet, {targetsChanged, heldDecisions})` (`:334`).

**Corroboration signal** — `derivePhotoCorroborationSignal(packet)` (`:556`). The **one** derivation of the signal `corroborateConfidenceLevel` expects. Passes through `eligibleForAssessment` (scored, High/Moderate, comparable, in-window, 3+ trend points) and collapses everything except 'supports'/'conflicts' to null. A null packet derives to `{eligible:false, direction:null}`, which is inert (`:546-549`).
Consumed at `CoachOutputScreen.js:2183`.

## B.6 Check-in evidence surface

Composed in `WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:627-664`. Notable engineering:
- The week-over-week weight delta is computed **with the engine's own exported helpers** (`getLatestEwma` / `getEwmaSevenDaysAgo`, `:645-646`) over 14 days, because `runWeeklyCoach` has not run for this week yet. The alternative (first-to-last across this week's few readings) "reads as 'flat' most weeks and would bias the classification toward the recomposition message for someone genuinely losing on target" (`:617-621`).
- `goalPhase` comes from the last SAVED coach output, else defaults to `'maint'` (`:622-623`).
- Nothing is persisted; a skipped/absent scan never blocks or delays submit (`:624-625`).
- Under suppression the packet is **null**, so every scan surface is entirely absent, not a neutral placeholder (`:625-626`).

Rendered at step 1 (`:979-997`): headline, detail, `usedSentence`, and the confidence chip when `status === 'valid'`.
Accessibility label composed by `scanEvidenceAccessibilityLabel(packet)` (`:186-189`).
Fast-path row shows only the confidence chip label, only for `status === 'valid'` (`:1299-1304`).

**Pre-check-in prompt** — `ScanPromptCard` (`:158-182`): "Add a progress scan first?" / "It is optional and skipping it changes nothing." Actions: "Do a scan" / "Not now".
`showScanPrompt` (`:674-676`) requires: not suppressed, not dismissed this visit, packet resolved, and status is `no_scan_ever` or `no_recent_scan` — a recent low-confidence attempt already carries its own retake guidance, so re-prompting "would push a second capture at someone who just did one" (`:666-673`).
"Not now" is component state only — nothing persisted, no streaks, no guilt copy (`:227-229`).

## B.7 Suppression, Pro gating and the share-card exception

**The gate** — `src/hooks/usePhotoSuppression.js`.
`isPhotoSuppressed(calm, edFlagOpen)` (`:39`) is the single canonical OR; every other composition must call it rather than re-write `calm || edFlagOpen` inline (`:28-38`).
`derivePhotoSuppression({mode, edFlag})` (`:48`) fails **closed** on ambiguity: the wellbeing `'read_failed'` sentinel is matched explicitly and the ED-flag `'read_failed'` sentinel is a truthy string.
The hook starts `suppressed = true` and only lifts once BOTH reads confirm a clean state (`:59`) — a comparative/weight/share surface must never flash first.
Both reads are RAW: `AsyncStorage.getItem(WELLBEING_KEY)` not `getWellbeingMode()`, because the helper swallows errors to `'unspecified'` and would fail OPEN (`:66-68`).

**What is gated on ProgressPhotosScreen** (`suppressed = photoSuppressed || calm`, `:189`):
| Capability | Gate | Line |
|---|---|---|
| Compare scans | `scoredScans.length >= 2 && !suppressed` | `:1107` |
| Compare photos | `photos.length >= 2 && !suppressed` | `:1108` |
| Share | `!readOnly && (scanShareItems ≥2 or photos ≥2) && !suppressed` | `:1109` |
| Trend view | `visibleScans.length > 0 && !suppressed` | `:1114` |
| Meaning moment | `!suppressed` | `:1120` |
| Score value | `suppressed ? 'Hidden'` | `:1232` |
| Progress signal | `suppressed ? …` | `:1236` |
| Confidence | `suppressed ? 'Hidden'` | `:1239` |
| Receipt | `!suppressed && scanForDay` | `:1270` |
| Recalibration note | `!suppressed && …` | `:1273` |
**Still available while suppressed:** viewing your own dated photos, and deleting them (`usePhotoSuppression.js:20-21`).

**Pro gating.** The Progress-tab NavTile carries `pro={tier !== 'pro'}` (`AnalyticsScreen.js:659`); the screen itself is wrapped in `withReadOnlyProGuard` so a lapsed user gets view-only access (`ProgressPhotosScreen.js:158`).

**The before/after share-card exception.** CLAUDE.md §2 records the single founder-approved exception (progress-photos programme, 2026-07-03): the Pro before/after progress card **may show bodyweight beside each photo**; it is withheld entirely under calm mode or an open ED flag; name, measurements and private notes stay banned.
Implementation: `src/components/BeforeAfterShareSheet.js`, `src/lib/shareCard/beforeAfterParams.js`, `src/lib/shareCard/drawShareCard.js`; the withholding rides `canShare` above.

**Calibration export** — `isProgressScanCalibrationExportAllowed(user)` (`progressScanCalibrationAccess.js:11`) returns true in `__DEV__`, else only for three hard-coded founder emails (`:1-5`). Consumed by `progressScanCalibrationTelemetry.js` and `ProgressPhotosScreen.js`.
Status **LIVE-COND (founder-only)**.

## B.8 Capture guidance

`progressCaptureGuide.js`:
- `PROGRESS_STUDIO_SETUP_STEPS` (`:7-26`): Frame / Light / Repeat, each with icon and copy.
- `PROGRESS_STUDIO_AVOID` (`:28-34`): mirror selfies, backlighting or deep shadows, bulky clothing, arms blocking the waist, cropped feet or head.
- `PROGRESS_SCAN_SEQUENCE` (`:36-40`): Front relaxed, Back relaxed, Side relaxed.
- `POSE_CAPTURE_GUIDANCE` (`:60-94`): per-pose title, line, four checks, three avoids.
- `QUALITY_FIRST_CAPTURE_NOTE` (`:42-43`): "If a set is not clear enough for a score, it still stays in your photo library."
- `BASELINE_FIRST_POSE_SENTENCE` (`:49`): "These become your reference set." Shown once, the first time a pose is ever saved, because it seeds every future ghost overlay. **Never a hard block.**
- `firstPoseRetakeCopy(baseCopy)` (`:55`): a firmer but still advisory nudge for a flagged first-ever pose; "Save without score" stays available.
- `buildProgressStudioCaptureRoutes` (`:116`): complete_latest / scan / scan_library, or guided / camera / library.
- `buildProgressStudioHowItWorksCopy` (`:229`) — includes the explicit limit: "The coach may use broad trend direction as low-confidence context. It cannot use one photo as proof of readiness or a reason to make aggressive changes."

**Capture defaults** (founder 2026-07-12, `progressScanPreferences.js:14-23`): front camera, 5-second timer. Rationale is capture-consistency: the back camera hides the framing, and the Score depends on consistent framing. An explicit user choice (including timer 0) is always preserved (`:63-68`).
`hideExactNumbers` **defaults to TRUE** (`getProgressScanHideExactPreference`, `:34-42`) — including on a read failure.

# PART C — CHECK-INS

## C.1 The weekly check-in: gates before any question

`WeeklyCheckInScreen.js`, gate state machine at `:233` — `loading | wrong_day | day_late | already_done | too_soon | need_weights | open | load_error`.

| Gate | Condition | Copy / escape | Line |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wrong_day` | today ≠ scheduled day and not exactly one day late | "Come back on {day}" + "Change check-in day" → CoachingReminders | `:386-389, :1384-1425` |
| `already_done` | one day late AND a check-in already exists | "You're all caught up" + "View your coach review". Resolved **before** the data gates (founder device report 2026-08-03 / audit X10: a completed cycle fell through to `day_late` or even `need_weights`) | `:555-565, :1430-1461` |
| `too_soon` | `daysSinceFirstWeight < FIRST_CHECKIN_MIN_DAYS` | "First check-in needs more data"; names the exact unlock date via `firstReviewUnlockDate` | `:566-578, :1504-1542` |
| `need_weights` | fewer than `MIN_WEIGH_INS` readings in the **trailing 7 days** | "A few more weight readings needed"; escapes "Log my weight first" (cross-tab deep link) and "Check in anyway" | `:579-580, :1544-1589` |
| `day_late` | exactly one day past the scheduled day, data gates passed | "You're one day late…"; "Check in anyway" / "Wait for {day}" | `:581-584, :1463-1502` |
| `load_error` | any throw during load | "Couldn't load your week" + "Try again". **Fails CLOSED**, never opens the form (PIPE-006, `:588-595`) | `:1591-1615` |

**Ordering safety** — the wrong-day gate is resolved FIRST, before any throwable data read, because a later throw used to fall into the catch and fail OPEN, letting a user check in on the wrong day (`:381-389`).

**The trailing-7-day window is deliberate and ruled** (`:394-411`, X11): `MIN_WEIGH_INS` is *defined* as weigh-ins in the trailing 7 days (`trialActivation.js`), and Monday-anchoring it would refuse a daily logger who opens the screen on a Monday. **Only the copy changed** ("in the last 7 days"), not the window. Session and PR counts on the same screen ARE Monday-anchored via `localWeekStartMs` — two different facts, no longer sharing one name.

**Day-late anchoring (OB-7)** — `dayLate = (todayDay - scheduledDay + 7) % 7 === 1`; when true, `anchorMs = Date.now() - 86400000` and every week window anchors to yesterday so the review covers the week that was missed (`:371-379`).

**Scheduled day** — read from `@volyume_notification_prefs.checkinDay`, default 0 = Sunday (`:355-367`).

## C.3 Fast Check-In (COMP-008)

`fastEligible` (`:688-693`): gate is `open`, the user has not forced the wizard, `trainingPerformance != null`, and (no nutrition target OR `calsAdherence != null`) and (no cardio prescription OR `cardioAdherence != null`).
`fastCanSubmit = energyScore !== null && sorenessScore !== null` (`:696`).

The rationale is explicit (`:678-687`): energy and soreness are "the two inputs we deliberately never derive, because they feed the recovery score and the rapid-loss safety calorie-raise and must stay a conscious tap." Gating is on the **to-be-saved state**, so a value the user could not auto-fill falls back to the wizard rather than silently saving a guess.

Card (`renderFastCheckIn`, `:1268`): read-only rows for Training, Nutrition, Cardio, Weight, and Progress scan (valid only), each with a green tick; one muted provenance line ("From your logged sessions: N of M - from your diary: N of 7 days logged"), then the two chip rows.
Escape hatch: "Add more detail" → `forceFullWizard` (`:1751-1766`).

## C.4 Derivation, missing answers, and persistence

**Derived training verdict** — `deriveTrainingPerformance({completed, planned, prs, volDeltaPct})` (`checkinDerive.js:54`):
returns **null** when `!planned || completed === 0`; ratio <0.5 → `dropped`; ratio ≥1.0 AND (prs>0 or volume up ≥5 %) → `exceeded`; volume down ≥10 % → `struggled`; ratio ≥0.9 → `hit`; else `struggled`.
Plain-language mirror `PERF_VERDICT_TEXT` (`:96-101`): "looks like you beat your targets" / "on track with your plan" / "a bit below your usual" / "well down on your usual".

**Volume delta window** — `getWeeklyVolumeByMuscle(user.id, 2, weekStartMs + 7d)` (ALGO-001, `:459-476`): anchored to the END of the Monday-anchored check-in week, so "this week" is the week being submitted and "last week" is the full prior Mon–Sun week, not a rolling wall-clock window.

**Cardio prefill** — `cardioComplianceFromLog(s.sessions, target)` with a functional setter so the log-derived prefill cannot clobber a saved override loaded by the re-entry prefill (`:284`).

**Missing answers on submit** (`handleSubmit`, `:739`):
- `sleepHours` is **validated, not coerced**: non-finite or outside 0–24 aborts the save with a toast (AC-15, `:751-763`) — a −1 previously reached the engine and rendered "sleep averaged -1.0 hours".
- Everything else is written as `?? null`: `calsAdherence`, `stepsAdherence`, `cardioAdherence`, `trainingPerformance`.
- `stepsAvg: null` always (`:773`).
- `cycleOverride: showCycle && cycle === 'yes'` (`:775`).
- `jointPain: jointPain === 'yes'` — so an unanswered joint question saves as **false**, not null (`:777`).
- `soreMuscles` joined with commas or null (`:778`).
- `notes` = free text plus auto-appended lines "Joint pain flagged this week." and "Sore: {list}." (`:779-783`).
- Re-entry strips those auto lines with `stripAutoNotes` (`checkinDerive.js:85`) so a resubmit cannot duplicate them.

**Re-entry / edit** (`:512-538`): "already checked in" is detected by `existingCheckin.energyScore != null`, because a row can exist from a completed workout that wrote only `sleep_quality` (`:488-494`). Saved answers are prefilled; a legacy `training_performance` holding a session-difficulty string falls back to the derived verdict rather than a stuck non-selection (`:530-535`).

**Post-submit** (`:786-859`):
1. `recordScanClassification(userId, {assessment, status})` — best-effort, enums only, never a photo/score/free text, never synced, never read by any engine (`:786-797`).
2. Reschedule `scheduleNextCheckinReminder` from the **flat** prefs blob — a previous nested `prefs.checkin.enabled` shape that nothing wrote meant the reschedule never fired (`:800-816`).
3. `scheduleWeeklyCoachReady` (Monday 09:00 default, opt-out) (`:818-825`).
4. `scheduleMissedCheckinFollowups(userId)` — re-lays the follow-up pair against the next expected occurrence (`:828-831`).
5. Notification-permission prompt if `undetermined`: "Daily weight reminders… A 7-day trend is much more reliable than a single reading." (`:839-858`).
6. Navigate to `CoachOutput` with the week start.

## C.5 Session-level feedback (separate from the weekly check-in)

**Pre-workout intent prompt** — `READINESS_ROWS` (`HomeScreen.js:109-128`), a **1–3 domain presented on a 1–5 scale's values**:

| Field | Label | Chips |
|---|---|---|
| `soreness24hBefore` | "Soreness coming in" | Fresh (1), Mild (2), Sore (3) |
| `sleepQuality` | "Sleep last night" | Poor (2), OK (3), Good (4) |
| `energyScore` | "Energy today" | Low (2), OK (3), High (4) |

Note the **remap**: soreness runs 1–3 while sleep/energy run 2–4 on a 1–5 domain. `readinessSummary.js:21-27` documents this explicitly, with `LOW_SLEEP_OR_ENERGY = 2` and `HIGH_SORENESS = 3`.
`WorkoutSummaryScreen.js:445-452` remaps again for the adaptive engine: `soreness = [0,2,3,4][soreness24hBefore-1] ?? 2`, `pump = [1,1,2,4][overallPump-1] ?? 3`.

**Post-workout feedback** — `WorkoutSummaryScreen.js:1504-1524`, collapsed behind "Rate this workout", labelled **optional** (`:1484`).
COMP-008 moved soreness/energy/sleep to the pre-workout prompt "captured where they are accurate" (`:60-62`); the post-workout block keeps only what you can judge once the work is done:

| Field | Label | Scale | Labels (`RATING_LABELS`, `:63-68`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sessionDifficulty` | "Difficulty" | 1–5 | Very Easy, Easy, Moderate, Hard, Brutal |
| `overallPump` | "Muscle engagement" | 1–3 | None, Mild, Good |
| `jointDiscomfort` | "Joint discomfort" | **0–3** | None, Slight, Moderate, Significant |
| `fatigueLevel` | "Fatigue" | 1–5 | Fresh, Mild, Moderate, High, Exhausted |
Plus free-text "Anything notable from this session" and a separate "Notes for next time" field (`:1514-1536`).

**Note:** `src/lib/feedback.js` is **NOT** session feedback — it is the in-app bug/sentiment report sheet writing to `user_feedback` in Supabase, with three trigger paths (contextual / shake / settings) and four suppression rules (never twice in 14 days per trigger, never within 2 min of a crash banner, never during an active workout, never on the same screen twice per session) (`:1-24`).

## C.6 Cadences

| Cadence | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly check-in | user-chosen day (`checkinDay`, default Sunday), +1 day grace, then wait for the next cycle | `WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:355-379` |
| First check-in unlock | `FIRST_CHECKIN_MIN_DAYS` days of data **and** the next scheduled day after that | `trialActivation.js`, `firstReviewUnlockDate` |
| Weigh-in eligibility | `MIN_WEIGH_INS` in the trailing 7 days | `trialActivation.js` |
| Coach ready push | recurring Monday 09:00, default on | `WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:818-825` |
| Weigh-in cadence guidance | "Logging every other day gives enough readings to smooth out that noise" | `:1561` |
| Body-metrics cadence | no enforced cadence; user-initiated form | `BodyMetricsScreen.js` |
| Progress photos | "Use progress photos once a week. Retake sooner only when you are fixing a poor photo set." | `progressCaptureGuide.js:238` |
| Scan comparison minimum | 7 days | `progressScanAnalysis.js:13` |
| Block reflection | at block end | `BlockReflectionScreen.js` |
| Refeed | weekly when eligible (`frequencyWeeks = 1`) | `weeklyCoach.js:1356` |
| Diet break | ≥8 consecutive weeks below maintenance | `weeklyCoach.js:1295-1315` |
| Calorie-change cooldown | 2 weeks, bypassed only by the rapid-loss safety path | `weeklyCoach.js:961` |

## C.7 Missed check-in behaviour

`src/lib/notifications/missedCheckin.js` — two single-shot pushes per missed episode:
- **evening**: 20:00 local on the check-in day, or occurrence + 2 h when the user's check-in hour is ≥19:00 (`eveningSlotFor`, `:65`).
  Copy: title "Your check-in is ready when you are{, Name}", body "Your check-in data is ready to review. It takes about two minutes." (`:31-34`).
- **followup**: +48 h (`FOLLOWUP_GAP_MS`, `:20`).
  Copy: title "Your weekly trend is ready{, Name}", body "Tap to see how the week compares, whenever suits you." (`:35-38`).

**"you missed" is banned** (`:7-13`). Early disengagement is named as the strongest churn predictor.
The module is kept pure with **no imports**; quiet hours, the push budget, ED-flag suppression and the Pro/toggle gates all live in `scheduler.js::scheduleMissedCheckinFollowups` (`:12-16`).
Re-laid after every successful submit (`WeeklyCheckInScreen.js:831`).

# PART D — COACHING OUTPUT SURFACES

## D.1 CoachOutputScreen structure (3522 lines)

Zoning is decided by the pure `selectCoachOutputZones(output, {dietBreakSuggested, hasMacro, hasRefeed})` (`src/lib/coachOutputZones.js:16`):
- hero from `output.primary.domain`: training|deload → `'training'`; calories|steps → `'nutrition'`; dietBreak (when suggested) → `'dietBreak'`;
- everything else applyable collapses into `secondaryKinds`; macro/refeed appear only when present and are **never** the hero (`:30-31`);
- `dietBreakInSafety` when a diet break is suggested but is not the hero — the DietBreakCard is founder-confirmed as a safety block and never renders in the collapsible secondary (`:13-15`).

Render order (`:2421-2846`), with a four-beat staged disclosure (`stage()`, `:2418-2419`) — the SAFETY zone and held decisions are **deliberately never animated** (`:2416-2417`):

1. Week header — `weekLabel` + `weekRangeLabel(weekStart)` (`:2429-2432`).
2. One-time adherence-why line, shown once ever on the first real weekly output (D15, `:2438-2445`).
3. **Coach lead card** — commitmentAnswer → acknowledgement → interpretation (`:2453-2478`). The photo sentence is deliberately *not* folded in here (D86); the base interpretation renders.
4. **Hero zone** — `SectionLabel "This week's main move"`, the hero card, and a one-line WHY so "the WHY never sits a scroll away from the WHAT" (`:2486-2497`). When `primary.domain` is null: a non-applyable hold hero, "Hold steady this week." if holds exist else "Nothing to change. The plan is working." (`:2503-2517`).
5. **Trend chips** — 7-day trend (with `GLOSSARY.ewma` tooltip; numeral never coloured, Class B), sessions `N/M`, PRs when >0 (`:2521-2552`).
6. Share-week button, only on a genuinely great ED-safe week; success tint, never amber (`:2562-2580`).
7. **LedgerCard** — working + off items merged into one two-group object (`:2585-2587`).
8. **`CollapsibleSection "More adjustments (N)"`** — the secondary zone (`:2592-2600`).
9. Plan-edit receipt "at the gram of rice" (`:2604-2609`).
10. "Plan next week's meals" — Fresh week / Repeat last week (`:2614-2654`).
11. Cardio recovery caution, cardio acknowledgement, cycle-phase note — three advisory one-liners with distinct icons, no Apply (`:2659-2680`).
12. **WhyBlock** → Methodology (`:2686`).
13. **Confidence caption** + the "Only N weigh-ins landed this week" addendum keyed off the REAL confidence (`:2690-2704`).
14. **Progress photos card** — compact, low on the page (D86, `:2706-2736`).
15. **Focus this week** — `coachResponse.cue ?? buildFocus(...)` (`:2741-2750`).
16. **SAFETY zone, always visible, never collapsed**: `RapidLossAlert`, the diet break when it is a safety block, `HeldDecisionsCard` (`:2752-2765`).
17. **Next check-in card** — preCommitment + forward (`:2774-2784`). Founder device report 2026-08-06: these were two bare floating Text lines reading as debris; same content, now inside the card idiom.
18. Contest countdown, deliberately BELOW the safety shelf and null under any open wellbeing flag; peak week adds the medical line (`:2792-2807`).
19. "Coaching history" link — added because a consistently on-target user never saw a route to it (`:2816-2825`).
20. "Done" (quiet, outline — the hero Apply is the screen's only amber fill).
21. Medical-guidance line (`:2842-2844`). The credential jargon row (volume landmarks / autoregulation / RED-S) was **removed** by D86 as "misaligned technical filler" (`:2837-2841`).

## D.4 Apply-path safety enforcement (`coachApply.js`)

- **Sex-aware calorie floors:** `KCAL_FLOOR = 1200`, `KCAL_FLOOR_MALE = 1500`, `kcalFloorForSex(sex)` (`:29-38`). These MUST match `nutritionEngine.js`; the audit 2026-07-01 CRITICAL was that the Apply path floored *everyone* at 1200, so a male cut suggestion could be written below the 1500 floor.
- **Protein held constant**; fat and carbs scale with the ratio; the whole existing row is spread first so `tdee`, `bmr`, `phase` are not nulled (`computeCalorieTargets`, `:66-87`).
- **`ABSOLUTE_WEEKLY_SET_CEILING = 30`** (`:48`): a last-resort backstop when a `planned_muscle_volume` row carries neither mrv nor mav; without it the apply path fell back to `+Infinity`, "the one line that could let progression run away" (PROG-1).
- **Deload dose:** `deloadSharePct(strain) = 60 - 5 × clamp(strain, 0..4)` (`:230`), floor 40 % at strain ≥4; **monotonic by construction**; an **unreadable strain fails CLOSED to heavy** (unknown → 4, the smallest/most protective dose, `:220-225`).
  `deloadFloor(mev) = max(1, round(mev × 0.5))` — founder ruling: MEV is a productive-training landmark, **not** automatically a recovery-week minimum, and must never force a deload UPWARD (`:238-244`).
  The achieved peak is capped at the row's own planned sets before the share applies (review #4) because achieved peaks carry half-credit for secondary work (`:255-260`).
- **Macro cycle:** rest-day carb cut `0.25` of baseline, freed carbs spread across training days so the weekly average kcal is unchanged (`:111, :133`). The sacred floor applies to **every served day**, not just the weekly average — no cycle is proposed rather than serving a sub-floor day (`:151-159`).

## D.5 Pre-tap disclosure (`coachApplyView.js`)

Row outcomes (`:16-21`): `ok` | `floor_clamp` | `floor_hold` | `unavailable` | `none`.
`classifyCalorieApply` (`:37`) calls the **real** compute function and the real exported floor — nothing recomputes a floor or threshold of its own (`:6-9`).
Strings: `floorHoldLine` "Held at your safe minimum of X." (`:89`); `floorClampLine` "Applied to your safe minimum, X." (`:94`); `macroCycleHoldLine` "Held: a rest day would fall below your safe minimum of X." — attributed correctly, because the weekly target is not itself at the floor (`:98-106`); `preTapTargetLine` "→ X kcal/day, stays until your next check-in." (`:113`); `signedEnergyChange` (`:119`).
All honour the kJ display preference via `formatEnergy`/`energyUnitLabel` (NU-6).

## D.6 Coaching-card classification — EVERY card

Classes: **INFORMATIONAL** (no action) · **AUTOMATIC** (the engine writes it with no user step) · **PROPOSAL** (offered with an Apply the user may ignore) · **REQUIRES-CONFIRMATION** (an explicit confirm/consent step beyond a single Apply tap) · **MANUAL-ONLY** (only the user can act; the app never writes).
