The read-only guard **fails CLOSED**: a thrown or rejected probe renders
`ProLocked`, never the screen, and a hung read is raced against a 4 s timeout
that also fails closed (`ProGate.js:326-356`). Pinned by
`components/__tests__/ProGate.readOnlyGuard.test.js`.

`withProGuard` also preserves a partner invite code at the moment the gate
intercepts, so an invited free user's code is not silently dropped (A1 s9.3,
`ProGate.js:293-307`).

## E.3 Free/Pro split as coded

**FREE** (from `WelcomeScreen.AFTER_TRIAL_BULLETS:35-40` and the FAQ at
`ProUpgradeScreen.js:48-51`, cross-checked against what is NOT guarded in
`RootNavigator`): unlimited workout logging, building your own plans, the plan
library, the exercise library, personal records, progress stats, training blocks,
the exercise/volume charts, training reminders, the getting-started nudge,
importing from Hevy/Strong, backup/restore/CSV export, and every Display and
Accessibility setting (COMP-029 explicitly makes appearance a FREE display
setting, `SettingsDisplayScreen.js:11-12`).

**PRO**: everything in the `withProGuard` list above, plus the Pro-conditional
Settings rows (Nutrition targets, Per-day targets, Dietary needs, Coaching
reminders, Skip name on label scans, Read cardio sessions), plus the four Pro
rows inside Settings > Coaching (Cardio logging, Coaching tone, Autonomy, Show
the science), plus session readiness ADJUSTMENT (the ask itself is free, the
adjustment is not, `SettingsCoachingScreen.js:143-151`).

Per-feature paywall copy lives in `ProGate.FEATURE_BENEFIT` (`:26-49`), keyed by
the exact `withProGuard` label, with `DEFAULT_BENEFIT` as the fallback. It is
presentational only and never consults or moves the free/Pro line (`:23-25`).

## E.4 Trial cascade (`src/lib/payments/cascade.js`)

State-changing verbs, each wrapping an RPC and returning the RPC's jsonb; no
exception ever crosses the module boundary (`:1-33`):

| Verb | RPC / reason | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `startCascade()` | `start_cascade` | Article 9 consent -> `pro_trial_active`. Mirrors the trial into the local store, **awaiting `setTier('pro')`** because the navigator routes onboarding on `store.tier` (founder repro 2026-07-02, `:126-132`). Then lays cascade-gate reminders and the COMP-023 day-3 value moment from the returned end date |
| `payAt(tier, ref, surface)` | client-side only | `setOptimisticPaid()`. **The client never writes its own paid tier** -- the authenticated `upgrade_tier` rejects `'pro'` (migration 067) |
| `confirmPurchase({purchaseToken, subscriptionId})` | Edge Function | Android -> `play-billing-rtdn` `{purchaseToken, subscriptionId}`; iOS -> `app-store-verify` `{jws, productId}`. On success pulls the authoritative tier immediately |
| `skipToFree(surface)` | `upgrade_tier` reason `user_skip` | -> free |
| `skipToPro(surface)` | removed | returns `{ok:false, error:'skip_to_pro_removed_in_2_tier_model'}` (`:384-386`) -- **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE stub** |
| `autoDowngrade('free', surface)` | reason `auto_downgrade` | day-14 trial end; any other target is rejected |
| `cancel(surface)` | reason `user_cancelled` | webhook EXPIRATION, default surface `play_billing_rtdn` |
| `graceLapsed(surface)` | reason `grace_lapsed` | 3-day timer |
| `refunded(surface)` | reason `refunded` | webhook REFUND |

Pure read helpers:
- `stageOf(profile)` -> `unstarted` \| `pro_trial` \| `paid` \| `free`
  (`:450-462`).
- `canStillTrial(profile)` -> `trialState === 'unstarted'` (`:470-473`).
- `daysRemaining(profile, now)` -> floor of days to the trial end, null when not
  in a trial, 0 once past (`:480-494`).

**Trial length**: the in-app cardless trial is **14 days**
(`trialActivation.js:18 TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS = 14`), with the value moment on day 3
(`TRIAL_DAY3_OFFSET_DAYS = 3`). The 7-day store intro offer is a separate store
subscription phase that begins only if the user subscribes afterwards
(`cascade.js:145-151`, `:389-391`). C1 (founder ruling 2026-07-11) removed the
trial duration from the differential-paywall BODY copy because two files stated
different numbers (7 vs 14) and both rendered on screen; the badge CTA is now the
single source of truth (`differentialPaywall.js:4-9, 43-48`).

Telemetry fan-out per transition: always `cascade_state_transition`, plus
`cascade_started` / (`paid_converted` + `cascade_advanced`) /
(`churn_at_gate` + `cascade_skipped_ahead`) / `subscription_cancelled`
(`:67-103`).

Tested in `src/lib/__tests__/payments.cascade.test.js`.

## E.5 The cascade gate screen (`src/screens/CascadeGateScreen.js`)

Variants: `'day14'` (canonical, the one real gate) and `'payment_failure'`;
`'day21'`/`'day28'` are accepted as synonyms so stale scheduled notifications
still resolve (`:8-13`, `:86-90`). Copy:
- day14: "Your Pro trial is winding down" / "Pro keeps the weekly coaching and
  the food log. Free keeps your data and safety checks, but some features become
  view-only." (`:112-113`).
- payment_failure: "We couldn't take your payment" / update billing in the store
  within 3 days or drop to Free (`:124-125`).

Purchase path mirrors ProUpgrade: `purchasePackage` -> `payAt` ->
`confirmPurchase`, with a user-cancel branch that logs info rather than an error,
and a distinct store-unavailable message (`:225-283`). Skip path calls
`cascade.skipToFree` (`:292-300`). A factual training recap renders on the
trial-end variant only, render-only and best-effort (`:175-178`, `:348+`).

## E.6 Paid-entitlement reconciliation and offline grace (`cascade.js:250-363`)

`PAID_ENTITLEMENT_OFFLINE_GRACE_MS = 24 h` (`:256`), a named constant, balancing
"do not punish a brief offline spell" against "do not let a lapsed or offline
device keep Pro forever". `reconcilePaidEntitlement(profile)`:

- Runs **only** for `trial_state === 'paid_pro'` (`:283`); trials are
  server-cron driven.
- No real Play provider: within grace, no-op; past grace,
  `lockStalePaidEntitlement()` -- a **local-only** drop to free with **no server
  write**, because the entitlement could not be confirmed so a lapse is not
  actually known (`useAppStore.js:629-640`). Reason `stale_no_provider`.
- Play read throws: same shape, reason `stale_read_failed`.
- Play reports active: `markPaidEntitlementVerified()` refreshes
  `@volyume_paid_verified_at`.
- Play reports inactive but the device was verified active within grace:
  **defer**, logged at info level not warn, because this branch is the reconciler
  self-healing as designed and it fired three warnings in ten minutes of the
  founder's clean-slate walk (Sentry VOLYUME-26, `:345-354`).
- Play reports inactive past grace: `cancel('client_reconcile')` -- an
  authoritative server downgrade.

The code is explicit that this is defence in depth, NOT a substitute for the RTDN
push, which remains mandatory release infrastructure (`:265-267`), and that a
false revoke is recoverable via Restore purchases (`:279`).

## E.7 Play Billing and catalogue

`src/lib/payments/catalogue.js`: **`pro_monthly` (£2.99/month)** and
**`pro_annual` (£19.99/year)**, both frozen (`:33-50`). `BILLING_PERIODS =
['monthly','annual']`, `TIERS = ['pro']`. `annualSavingsPct()` computes the
badge percentage from the reference figures (`:101-105`). The header is
emphatic (PLAY-002, `:19-24`): `priceText`/`priceNumber` are a **reference and
the input to `annualSavingsPct()` only**, never a user-facing display price; do
not wire them back into a screen as a fallback because they would show the wrong
currency and amount to a non-UK user and could diverge from what the store
actually charges. The 7-day intro free-trial offer is configured per product in
each store, not here.

`src/lib/payments/usePlayPrices.js`: `priceFor(tier, period)` returns **null**
until the store responds, with **no hardcoded fallback**; callers render a
price-free "Subscribe" or a short loading state. Prices are cached at module
level so returning to a paywall in the same session shows them with no flash
(`:10-17`).

`src/lib/payments/playBilling.js` (888 lines) owns the `react-native-iap` wrap,
`isReal()`, `getCustomerInfo()`, `restorePurchases()`, `purchasePackage(skuId,
{preferWinback})`, `ensureDisplayPrices()`/`getDisplayPrices()`, and the
sheet-level `purchase_initiated`/`completed`/`failed` telemetry. A user-cancelled
sheet is deliberately kept OUT of `purchase_failed` so failure metrics stay clean
(`ProUpgradeScreen.js:196-199`).

## E.8 Restore purchases (`src/lib/payments/restore.js`)

Idempotent and never charges (`:9-11`). Reads Play's active entitlements; `'pro'`
present means restore, otherwise `{ok:true, tier:null}`. Skips the unlock when
`currentTrialState === 'paid_pro'` already. Otherwise `payAt` for the optimistic
unlock, then **awaited** `confirmPurchase` so the server tier is rewritten, not
merely optimistically unlocked -- without it a device with a stale server tier
would revert to free after the optimistic window (M-3/SUB-003, `:62-72`). A
failed confirm does NOT fail the restore; the outcome is returned as
`serverConfirmed`.

Restore entry points: `ProLocked` on **every** Pro lock screen
(`ProGate.js:264-279`), `SubscriptionScreen` (`:99`), and `ProUpgradeScreen`.

## E.9 Lapse detection and win-back

`src/lib/payments/lapseDetect.js` makes NO entitlement decision of its own; it
turns a reconcile result into the win-back lifecycle (`:4-6`).
- `isAuthoritativeLapse(result)` = `downgraded === true && active === false &&
  !result.reason` -- the stale lockdowns carry a reason, the real lapse does not
  (`:31-36`).
- Explicitly NOT a lapse: the stale local lockdown (unverified, self-heals) and a
  trial auto-downgrade (reconcile only runs for `paid_pro`) (`:13-18`).
- `isConfirmedActive` clears the episode and cancels any scheduled win-back -- a
  fresh slate -- and only touches the OS notification layer when an episode is
  actually open, so the healthy paid launch never does (`:50-62`).

`src/lib/payments/winbackState.js`: two hard rules -- **one win-back per
episode** (`winbackLaid`) and an **absolute floor of one win-back per 180 days
across episodes** (`WINBACK_FLOOR_MS`, `:38`), so a serial canceller is never
drip-fed (`:18-22`). Default delay 30 days (`:40`); a stated return shifts it
(`in_a_month` 30, `two_three_months` 75, `not_sure` 60, `:42-46`). Keys:
`@volyume_winback_episode_v1`, `@volyume_winback_last_fired_v1`,
`@volyume_winback_stated_return_v1`. The stated-return answer is captured at
cancel time, BEFORE any episode exists, so it lives under its own key
(`:24-26`). Copy lives in `src/lib/notifications/winbackContent.js`; the
scheduler self-guards on no episode, ED suppression, an uncleared floor, or a
past fire date (`lapseDetect.js:68-70`). The one-time post-lapse sheet is
`components/PostLapseSheet.js` (`shouldShowPostLapseSheet` /
`markLapseSheetShown`, `winbackState.js:99-115`), and the cancel reason is
captured by `components/CancelReasonSheet.js` + `lib/cancelReason.js`.

## E.10 Differential paywall (`src/lib/differentialPaywall.js`)

Fires only when ALL hold (`:11-16`): tier is free; weekly check-in adherence is
`under` or `over` in 2 of the last 3 check-ins (a single off-week does not fire);
and exactly one of four locked contexts matches. Contexts in priority order:
`deload`, `stalled_lift`, `missing_tdee`, `block_summary` (`:72-77`).

**Safety amendment (audit 2026-05-31, founder decision)**: the two
safety-adjacent distress contexts `extreme_soreness` and `energy_crash` were
REMOVED as conversion triggers, because surfacing a paywall when a user's
soreness or energy is crashing reads as monetising distress and works against the
tier-blind safety system. The detector still accepts the scores but they no
longer fire a paywall, and the recovery guardrails remain free and unaffected
(`:21-28`). Never fires for paid users, ever (`:17-19`). Copy is locked verbatim
with a snapshot test (`:40-41`), under 25 words each, no jargon-blocklist terms.
Rendered by `components/DifferentialBadge.js`; dismissal key
`@volyume_differential_banner_dismissed_<...>`.

## E.11 Paywall surfaces and their triggers

| Surface | Trigger | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ProLocked` full screen | Any `withProGuard` route reached by any means (tab, deep link, stale nav state). Emits `feature_locked_viewed` once per feature key | `ProGate.js:151-283`, `:164-175` |
| `ProGate` inline lock chip + sheet | Wrapping any Pro content inline | `ProGate.js:71-145` |
| `ProUpgrade` modal | `source: 'settings_account'`, `'pro_gate'`, `'pro_gate_teaser'`, `'coach_pitch_card'`; registered in five stacks | `SettingsAccountScreen.js:39`, `ProGate.js:88, 232, 242`, `YouScreen.js:419`, `RootNavigator.js:433,461,488,525,583` |
| `CascadeGate` modal | Trial-end and payment-failure; also reachable from `SubscriptionScreen` with `{variant:'day14', period}` | `RootNavigator.js:581`, `SubscriptionScreen.js:131` |
| Differential badge | See E.10 | `components/DifferentialBadge.js` |
| Home trial-value banner | `@volyume_trial_value_banner_dismissed_<...>` | `HomeScreen.js:563` |
| Home Pro teaser card | Free tier | `components/HomeProTeaserCard.js` |
| `TierComparisonStrip` | On `ProUpgrade` and `Subscription` | `SubscriptionScreen.js:165` |
| Post-lapse sheet | One-time after an authoritative lapse | `components/PostLapseSheet.js` |

**Show-then-sell**: the food-diary lock (`feature === 'Food diary'` or
`'Nutrition'`) renders a read-only example day above the ask (founder decision
#6). It exposes no Pro action, and the whole teaser block is one tap target
routing to `ProUpgrade`, so it cannot read as tappable-but-dead
(`ProGate.js:176-179, 223-239`).

## E.12 Trial activation

`start_cascade` at Article 9 consent is the ONLY grant point in the app
(`Article9ConsentScreen.js:130-147`). `src/lib/trialActivation.js` is the single
source of truth for the gate constants -- `FIRST_CHECKIN_MIN_DAYS = 5` and
`MIN_WEIGH_INS = 3` are defined there and imported BACK by
`WeeklyCheckInScreen`, precisely so the promised unlock date and the real gate
can never drift (`:8-11, 21-24`). `firstReviewUnlockDate` uses local MIDNIGHT
rather than the reminder time, so the named day is open at any hour and a keen
early-morning tap cannot break the promise (`:50-57`).

## E.13 Founder Pro ledger -- INTERNAL

`supabase/migrate_108_founder_pro_ledger.sql`, contract-tested at
`src/lib/__tests__/founderProLedger.contract.test.js`:
- A **private, hashed** table `private.founder_pro_ledger` with `email_hash text
  PRIMARY KEY` and **no plaintext email column** (test asserts the absence).
- Seeds three founder emails by `private.email_trial_hash(...)`.
- `public.apply_founder_pro_entitlement` applies `trial_state = 'paid_pro'`,
  `tier = 'pro'`, `pro_trial_ends_at = NULL` -- deliberately **paid, not a
  time-limited trial**.
- Trigger `users_profile_founder_pro_entitlement` `AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF
  tier, trial_state` corrects profile creation and any later downgrade attempt.
- `start_cascade` checks founder entitlement **before** the trial ledger flow
  (the test asserts the ordering by string index).
- The ledger **survives account deletion by design** (the delete RPC does not
  reference it).

## E.14 Apple App Review accounts -- INTERNAL

`supabase/migrate_128_apple_review_accounts.sql`. Two generic accounts any
reviewer can use any number of times: `appreview.pro@volyume.app`
(`tier='pro'`, `trial_state='paid_pro'`) and `appreview.free@volyume.app`
(`tier='free'`, `trial_state='free'`). `paid_pro` is deliberate: a trial would
expire mid-review. Both are created email-CONFIRMED. Onboarding state is written
to match a genuinely completed onboarding -- `first_run_complete = true`,
`health_data_consent = true` plus a real `consent_log` row written exactly as
`record_health_consent` does it (so the audit trail stays truthful), and
`users_profile.sex` because it is a required onboarding field. Not a schema
change; a data seed carried through the migration runner because that is the
sanctioned path to production. **APPLIED 2026-07-27** on the founder's "run
against production", verified after the run. Safe to re-run (every statement is
guarded on the email already existing). Only bcrypt hashes appear in the repo;
plaintexts were generated outside it and handed over in chat.

## E.15 Tier sync

- **Push**: `tier` is excluded from the profiles push payload entirely; the
  server owns it via `upgrade_tier` and the `play-billing-rtdn` webhook, and
  migrate_005's trigger rolls back any client UPDATE
  (`sync/tables/profiles.js:16-19`).
- **Pull**: `refreshTierFromCloud` (E.1) plus `restoreSessionFromCloud`, which
  carries `trial_state` and `pro_trial_ends_at` onto `userProfile` so the
  Subscription / ProUpgrade / CoachOutput screens resolve the cascade stage
  correctly (`useAppStore.js:939-944`).
- **Local caches**: `@volyume_tier`, `@volyume_trial_state`,
  `@volyume_pro_trial_ends_at`, `@volyume_paid_verified_at`.
- **Audit**: `tier_history` is a registry-synced table (`registry.js:138`).
- **Boot hygiene**: if a tier was previously saved but the user never completed
  setup, the navigator clears the stale tier so it falls back to WelcomeStack for
  a clean restart, otherwise closing the app on WelcomeScreen and reopening would
  silently re-route past Welcome (`RootNavigator.js:1072-1083`).

## E.16 Partner data-layer tier gate (`src/lib/partners/tierGate.js`)

Tier is enforced only at the UI route layer, and RLS plus the sync layer are
tier-blind, so a lapsed Pro would keep silently pushing live week signals into a
pairing they can no longer see. There is no tier column on any partner table, so
the fix lives at the app's data layer: both signal PUSH paths consult
`isLapsedPartner()` and transition the outbound state to `'resting'` so the
partner sees a calm state, never live ticks (`:1-11`). **Deliberately NOT the ED
fail-closed pattern**: an UNKNOWN tier (null during bootstrap, unset in tests)
does NOT count as lapsed, because muting a paying Pro on a transient read is the
worse failure; only an explicit `'free'` resolution mutes (`:14-18`).

## F.1 Every profile field

**Store `userProfile` blob** -- persisted to `@volyume_user_profile_<uid>`,
therefore also pushed to `user_prefs` in bulk.

| Field | Set where | Feeds | Synced column |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `firstName` | Onboarding, Settings > Profile | Greetings, share cards | `first_name` |
| `units` | forced `'kg'` | plate maths, all weight display | `units` |
| `bodyWeightUnits` | Onboarding, Settings > Workout | body weight display/entry, imperial height | tracked (`useAppStore.js:65`); see UNCERTAINTIES U2 |
| `sex` | Onboarding step 2, Settings > Profile | **BMR branch, ED calorie floor, FFM floor** | `sex` (migrate_094, optional) |
| `age` / `heightCm` / `weightKg` | Onboarding, Settings > Profile, Nutrition targets | BMR, TDEE, calorie and FFM floors | via `user_body_profile` + the prefs blob |
| `bodyFatPct`, `bodyFatSource` | Onboarding step 3, Body metrics | Katch-McArdle BMR when measured; FFM floor | `body_composition_log` (`registry.js:146`) |
| `trainingGoal` (division) | Onboarding step 5, ProGoalSetup | Plan goal overlay, weak-point scoping, protein tier | rides the blob |
| `trainingPhase` / `goalPhase` / `goal` | Onboarding step 5, ProGoalSetup | Nutrition phase, coaching phase | rides the blob |
| `phaseStartedAt`, `goalStartDate` | Onboarding step 5 | `weeklyCoach` diet-break timing (cut only) | rides the blob |
| `experience` | Onboarding step 4 | `computeLandmarks`, `baseRir`, `selectSplit`, exercise selection | `training_focus`/`training_age` adjacent |
| `recoveryRating` | Onboarding step 6 | `computeLandmarks` recovery multiplier | rides the blob |
| `daysPerWeek`, `trainingFreq(Bucket)` | Onboarding step 4 | Split selection, activity level derivation | rides the blob |
| `sessionLengthMinutes` | Onboarding step 4 | `trimToTimeBudget`, `estimateSessionMinutes` | rides the blob |
| `equipment` / `primaryEquipment` | Onboarding step 4 | `filterPool` hard equipment filter, transition-time estimate | `primary_equipment` |
| `planWeakPoints` (max 3) | Onboarding step 5 | Volume bias within the recovery envelope | rides the blob |
| `proteinApproach` | Onboarding step 5 | Protein g/kg band | rides the blob |
| `barWeight` | default 20; no UI row any more | Plate calculator | `bar_weight` |
| `dietPreference` | Onboarding, Settings > Profile | Curated meal filtering | `diet_preference` |
| `mealPlanExcludeTags` | Settings > Dietary needs | HARD allergen exclusion | `allergen_excludes` (migrate_112) |
| `mealPlanExcludeFoods` | Meal plan "never show me this" | HARD food exclusion | local only |
| `mealPlanMealsPerDay/Variety/FatConvention/PeriWorkout/PinnedMeals` | Meal plan prefs | Plan assembly | local only |
| `calorieBank` | Calorie banking (CB-1) | Diary display of the banked target | local only |
| `cardioEnabled` | Onboarding step 6, Settings > Coaching | Shows/hides cardio surfaces | local only |
| `coachTone`, `coachAutonomy`, `showScience` | Settings > Coaching (Pro) | Prose register, apply-control, science layer | **local only by design** (`SettingsCoachingScreen.js:35-47`) |
| `scoffScore` | Wellbeing check | ED-pattern detection | also `user_body_profile.scoff_score` |
| `avatarUri`, `avatarPreset` | Athlete profile | Avatar mark | file is device-local |
| `trialState`, `proTrialEndsAt` | server, via both cloud reads | Cascade stage resolution | server-owned |

**SQLite `user_body_profile`** (`database.js:360-372` plus migrations): `id`,
`user_id UNIQUE`, `sex`, `date_of_birth`, `height_cm`, `experience_level`,
`training_age_years`, `primary_goal`, `gdpr_consented`, `created_at`,
`updated_at`, plus `scoff_score` (`:562`), `deleted_at` (`:747`),
`goal_lock_advanced` and `goal_lock_set_at` (`:1066-1067`). It is the engine's
source for sex/height/DOB and is included in the wipe, backup and delete table
lists (`:4811`, `:5193`, `:8173`).

**Cloud `users_profile`** columns the client touches (`sync/tables/profiles.js`
FIELD_MAP `:31-43` plus reads at `useAppStore.js:876` and `:998`):
`first_name, units, training_focus, training_age, primary_equipment, bar_weight,
diet_preference, sex, allergen_excludes, tier, trial_state, pro_trial_ends_at,
billing_period, first_run_complete, health_data_consent(+_at),
column_updates_at`. `OPTIONAL_COLUMNS = ['allergen_excludes','sex']`: PostgREST
rejects a whole upsert for one unknown column, so the push retries with
progressively fewer optional columns rather than failing the sync
(`:45-58`) -- this is what lets the client run against a project where the
founder has not yet applied migrate_094 or migrate_112.

## F.2 Conflict resolution

Per-column write timestamps live in the store at `userProfileFieldUpdatedAt`,
stamped by `setUserProfile` (bulk, `useAppStore.js:229-245`) and by
`_stampProfileFields` (per-setter, `:254-264`), persisted to
`@volyume_user_profile_ts_<uid>` so a user who edits a field and kills the app
before the next sync still ships the per-field timestamp (`:72-87`). The
handler maps camelCase to snake_case on push and feeds the cloud's
`column_updates_at` into `conflict.resolve(merge)` on pull
(`sync/tables/profiles.js:9-14`, migration 045 ships the column and a safe-merge
trigger). `_profilesEqual` normalises defaults on both sides so a
null-versus-default mismatch does not read as a change and re-trigger churn
(`:95-120`). **The pull merge spreads local first**, which is exactly why
`coachTone`, `coachAutonomy` and `showScience` survive as local-only fields with
no cloud column (`SettingsCoachingScreen.js:35-47`).

## F.3 Profile support modules

- **`src/lib/profileFreshness.js`** -- `buildProfileFreshness({latestMetricAt,
  latestScanAt, latestWorkoutAt, keyLiftCount})` returns three blocks with
  `state ∈ {fresh, soon, due, missing}` and calm British-English copy:
  body metrics (soon at 7 days, due at 14), progress scan (soon at 6, due at 7),
  lifts (needs `keyLiftCount >= 3`, then soon at 14, due at 21). Pure, tested at
  `src/lib/__tests__/profileFreshness.test.js`. Rendered as "Profile readiness"
  rows on `AthleteProfileScreen.js:193-206`.
- **`src/lib/profileAvatar.js`** -- copies a picked image into
  `documentDirectory/profile_avatars/<safeUid>_<ts>.<ext>` and deletes the
  previous one; `deleteAvatarPhoto` is idempotent.
- **`src/lib/profileAvatarPresets.js`** -- `AVATAR_PRESETS`, `avatarPresetFor`.
  Choosing a preset clears `avatarUri` and vice versa
  (`AthleteProfileScreen.js:356-357, 370`).
- **`src/lib/athleteProfileSummary.js`** and
  **`src/lib/athleteProfileAccessibility.js`** -- the derived summary and its
  accessibility labels, both with dedicated tests.
- **`src/lib/profileAge.js`** -- `ageYearsFromDateOfBirth` /
  `dateOfBirthFromAgeYears`, the single conversion pair used by onboarding and
  Settings > Profile in both directions.
- **`src/lib/strengthStandards.js`** -- bodyweight-multiple standards.
  **Deliberately does not branch on biological sex even though the app records
  it** (`:6`). `getStrengthLevel(exerciseName, oneRm, bodyweight)` returns
  `{ratio, level, nextTarget}` and returns null on missing or non-positive
  bodyweight (`:56-58`), so it consumes bodyweight from the profile/metric log
  but no other profile field.

# G. STATE MACHINES

## G.1 Auth state

```
signed out ──(Apple | Google | email sign-in/sign-up)──▶ SIGNED_IN
    ▲                                                       │
    │                                                       ▼
    │                                          [deletion marker for this uid?]
    │                                            yes ──▶ retryPendingAuthDeletion
    │                                                    ──▶ forced sign-out + calm alert
    │                                            no  ──▶ restoreSessionFromCloud
    │                                                    + refreshTierFromCloud + pullFromCloud
    │
    └──(sign out: push-first ▸ tombstone drain ▸ wipe ▸ AsyncStorage.clear ▸ SecureStore)
    └──(delete account: Edge Fn | RPC fallback ▸ local wipe ▸ clear ▸ optional pending marker)
```
Email sign-up with confirmation on stops at "session pending", never reaching
SIGNED_IN until confirmation (`LoginScreen.js:142-147`).

## G.2 Onboarding completion state

`firstRunComplete: boolean` (default `true` "assume complete until checked" to
avoid a flash, `useAppStore.js:1073`) + `firstRunChecked: boolean`.

```
unknown ──checkFirstRun (AsyncStorage @volyume_first_run_complete)──▶ true | false
                    │
        restoreSessionFromCloud cues:
          A per-uid cache hit  ─▶ authoritative, never flipped later
          B created_at ≥ 60s   ─▶ optimistic true (flippable by the cloud read)
          C created_at < 60s   ─▶ false (wizard)
                    │
   completeFirstRun ─▶ true  (+ per-uid cache + cloud first_run_complete)
   resetFirstRun    ─▶ false (REFUSED while a workout is active)
   sign out         ─▶ false, firstRunChecked true
```
Wizard-internal state: `step ∈ 1..6`, persisted as a draft for steps 2-6, with
the sex-gate clamp described in §B.5.

## G.3 Subscription / trial states

Server `users_profile.trial_state` values seen in code:
`unstarted`, `pro_trial_active`, `paid_pro`, `free`, `cascade_expired`, plus the
legacy `complete_trial_active` and `paid_complete` retained for migration-030
compatibility.

```
unstarted
   │ start_cascade  (Article 9 consent)
   ▼
pro_trial_active ──(14 days elapse: server cron / autoDowngrade('free'))──▶ free
   │                                                                         │
   │ user_paid (payAt + confirmPurchase)                                     │ user_paid
   ▼                                                                         ▼
paid_pro ──user_cancelled | grace_lapsed | refunded | client_reconcile──▶ free
   │
   └── reconcilePaidEntitlement:
         active            ─▶ stay paid_pro, stamp @volyume_paid_verified_at
         inactive w/i 24h  ─▶ DEFER (self-healing, logInfo)
         inactive past 24h ─▶ cancel('client_reconcile')  [authoritative lapse
                              ─▶ lapseDetect opens a win-back episode]
         unverifiable past 24h ─▶ lockStalePaidEntitlement (LOCAL ONLY, no server
                              write, no win-back; self-heals on next online launch)
```

Derived UI stage (`stageOf`): `unstarted` | `pro_trial` | `paid` | `free`.
Derived entitlement (`_resolveTier`): `pro` | `free`.
Client-only overlays: `_optimisticPaidUntil` (5 minutes, `useAppStore.js:603`)
and the local trial-expiry enforcement in `checkTier`.

Win-back episode machine (`winbackState.js`):
```
no episode ──authoritative lapse──▶ open { lapseAt, reasonCaptured:false,
                                           winbackLaid:false, lapseSheetShown? }
   open ──markLapseSheetShown / markReasonCaptured / winback laid──▶ open (flags set)
   open ──confirmed active again──▶ cleared (fresh slate, scheduled winback cancelled)
   any  ── 180-day cross-episode floor blocks a second win-back
```

## G.4 Consent states

```
null  (not yet checked)
  ├─ new user (!firstRunComplete)  ─▶ Article 9 gate   [FAIL CLOSED]
  └─ returning user                ─▶ falls through (not re-prompted)
true  ─▶ app proceeds; cached @volyume_health_consent_<uid> = 'true'
false ─▶ Article 9 gate; in practice reached only via withdrawal, which
         immediately drives account deletion
```
Plus the orthogonal `healthConsentChecked` flag, which is set true in every
branch and only resets on sign-out. Plus the pending-retry queue
(`pendingHealthConsent.v1`), which is independent of the gate: it only reconciles
the server-side audit record.

# H. ACCESS-LOSS MATRIX

What happens to each Pro-gated surface the moment `tier` resolves to `'free'`
(trial end, cancellation, refund, reconciled lapse, or the manual "Switch to
Free"). **In every case the underlying data is retained**: nothing in the
downgrade path deletes anything. The Switch-to-Free copy states this plainly
(`SettingsAccountScreen.js:47-50`), as does the ProUpgrade FAQ ("Everything you
logged is saved, and will be exactly as you left it if you come back",
`ProUpgradeScreen.js:41-43`).

| Surface | On downgrade | Data retained? | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Food diary (`Diary`) | **VIEW-ONLY if the user has any food entries**, otherwise full `ProLocked` | YES | `withReadOnlyProGuard(..., hasAnyFoodEntries)`; the screen derives `readOnly = tier !== 'pro'` INSIDE itself, never from a prop, and **every write handler re-checks the LIVE store tier at execution time** via `canWrite()` so a callback created before a pro-to-free flip cannot still write (`DiaryScreen.js:127-140`). Reads kept: day pager, rings, entries, water total, macro breakdown |
| Body metrics | **VIEW-ONLY if they have logged metrics**, else locked | YES | `withReadOnlyProGuard(..., getBodyMetricLog(userId,1))`. History, trends and charts stay; the Log Weight form and the auto-seed write are hidden (`BodyMetricsScreen.js:508-513`) |
| Progress photos and Volyume Score | **VIEW-ONLY if they have photos**, else locked | YES, image files untouched on device | `withReadOnlyProGuard(..., photosViewableBy)`. Timeline and Compare stay; add, delete and the editable viewer are hidden; `canWrite()` re-checks live tier (`ProgressPhotosScreen.js:157-168`) |
| Weekly check-in | Full lock | YES, past check-ins remain in SQLite | `withProGuard 'Weekly check-in'` |
| Coaching decision / output | Full lock | YES; "past coach decisions ... remain readable" is the Switch-to-Free promise, but the ROUTE is fully guarded, so in practice they are not reachable while free (see UNCERTAINTIES U3) | `withProGuard 'Coaching decision'` |
| Your week (weekly story) | Full lock | YES | `withProGuard 'Your week'` |
| Coaching history (`CoachHeldHistory`) | **NOT guarded** -- remains reachable | YES | Registered ungated at `RootNavigator.js:568` |
| Nutrition targets | Full lock | YES, `nutrition_targets` rows keep syncing | `withProGuard 'Nutrition targets'` |
| Per-day targets | Full lock; offsets stop being applied because the diary itself is read-only | YES (`@volyume_perday_target_offsets` + cloud table) | `withProGuard 'Per-day targets'` |
| Meal plan | Full lock | YES (`meal_plans` registry table) | `withProGuard 'Meal plan'` |
| Food search / add custom food / barcode / label scan / recipes / saved meals | Full lock | YES (`custom_foods`, `saved_meals`, `recipes`, `recipe_ingredients` all keep syncing) | `withProGuard` |
| Food insights | Full lock | YES | `withProGuard 'Food insights'` |
| Cardio (log + history) | Full lock | YES (`cardio_log` registry table) | `withProGuard 'Cardio'` |
| Health "Read cardio sessions" toggle | Row hidden entirely | OS grant persists | `isPro` guard, `SettingsHealthScreen.js:206` |
| Training partner | Full lock, AND the data layer transitions outbound week signals to `'resting'` so the partner sees a calm state rather than live ticks | YES | `withProGuard 'Training partner'` + `partners/tierGate.js` |
| Coaching reminders | Full lock; the Settings row disappears | Schedules already laid persist until re-laid | `withProGuard` + `SettingsScreen.js:93` |
| Pro goal setup / Adjust training | Full lock | YES | `withProGuard` |
| Settings > Dietary needs | Row disappears from Settings | YES; allergen excludes keep syncing | `tier === 'pro'` row guard |
| Settings > Coaching Pro block (cardio, tone, autonomy, science) | Rows disappear | YES, the profile fields persist unchanged | `tier === 'pro'` (`SettingsCoachingScreen.js:162`) |
| Skip name on label scans | Row disappears | Flag persists | `tier === 'pro'` (`SettingsDataScreen.js:273`) |
| Session readiness check | **Stays available**; the ask and the stored answer stay, only the session ADJUSTMENT stops, and the Free copy is worded to promise only what Free delivers | YES | `SettingsCoachingScreen.js:143-151` |
| Calm mode, wellbeing check, goal lock, ED floors, Beat UK signposting | **Unchanged. Tier-blind by mandate** | YES | `proGate.js:22-23` |
| Everything free (logging, plans, library, PRs, progress stats, blocks, charts, backup/export, all display settings) | Unchanged | YES | not guarded |

Two structural notes on the read-only design (founder decision 2026-07-02,
"view yes, log no", E10 findings F1b/F2/F5): a free user with NO data in the
domain keeps the plain `ProLocked` gate, so the show-then-sell lock is unchanged
for never-Pro users; and the existence probe **fails closed**, so a transient DB
failure can never soften the tier posture (`ProGate.js:313-325`).

# UNCERTAINTIES

**U1 -- `@volyume_privacy_prefs` almost certainly syncs, contradicting its own
module contract.** `src/lib/privacyPrefs.js:3-6` states: "Device-local privacy
preferences. Kept local on purpose: a privacy opt-out should not itself be
transmitted, so this never goes through pref sync." `setAnalyticsOptOut`
(`useAppStore.js:1991-1996`) indeed does NOT call `pushPrefSoon`. **But** the key
starts with `@volyume_` and is not in `PREF_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS`
(`sync.js:1255-1298`), so `_pushAllUserPrefs` (`sync.js:1327-1345`) enumerates
`AsyncStorage.getAllKeys()` and will ship it in the bulk push, and
`_pullUserPrefs` will write it back cloud-wins. I could not find any test or
guard pinning it out. Either the comment is stale or the exclusion was missed.
Flagged as a finding, not asserted as intent.

**U2 -- `bodyWeightUnits` is tracked for per-field merge but is absent from the
push FIELD_MAP.** It is listed in `PROFILE_FIELDS_TRACKED`
(`useAppStore.js:65`) and `setBodyWeightUnits` stamps it and calls `pushPrefSoon`
on the whole profile blob key (`:1768-1781`), but `FIELD_MAP` in
`sync/tables/profiles.js:31-43` does not contain it, and `_profilesEqual`
(`:95-120`) does not compare it. So it reaches the cloud only as part of the
`@volyume_user_profile_<uid>` value in `user_prefs`, not as a `users_profile`
column. I did not find a `body_weight_units` column reference anywhere in `src/`.
Whether a cloud column exists is a question for the migrations lane.

**U3 -- "past coach decisions remain readable" versus the route guard.** The
Switch-to-Free alert promises "Past coach decisions, check-ins, training blocks
and PRs remain readable" (`SettingsAccountScreen.js:49`), but `CoachOutput`,
`WeeklyCheckIn` and `WeeklyStory` are all fully `withProGuard`'d, with no
read-only variant. `CoachHeldHistory` is ungated and would satisfy part of the
promise. I did not trace every alternative read path (Home cards, Analytics
inserts) far enough to say whether the promise is met in practice.

**U4 -- `mealPlanExcludeTags` in `_stampProfileFields`.** `setAllergenExcludes`
calls `_stampProfileFields(['mealPlanExcludeTags'])` (`useAppStore.js:1821`), but
`_stampProfileFields` only records fields present in `PROFILE_FIELDS_TRACKED`
(`:258`), and `mealPlanExcludeTags` is **not** in that list
(`:58-70`). If that is accurate, the allergen stamp is silently dropped, which is
precisely the failure mode the comment at `:1849-1854` says the split exists to
avoid. I have not run the code to confirm, and there may be a test that covers
it; flagged for verification.

**U5 -- `restSound.js` has no user-facing control.** The four countdown beeps
(660/770/880/1100 Hz) are synthesised and played unconditionally by the rest
timer. The only related setting found is "Rest finished alert", which governs the
OS notification, not the in-app beeps (its copy says "In-app cues are
unaffected"). I found no mute setting for the in-app sound.

**U6 -- `src/lib/travelMode.js` reachability.** It is a complete, pure travel-plan
generator (bodyweight/dumbbell/hotel-gym/band pools, 295 lines) but I found no
screen, navigation route, or Settings row that invokes it in this sweep. It looks
like PLANNED-DOCUMENTED-ONLY or LEGACY-UNREACHABLE, but I did not exhaustively
grep every call site and will not assert it.

**U7 -- Progress-scan "hide exact numbers" default.** It defaults to `true`
(`progressScanPreferences.js:34-42`) and is read by `CoachOutputScreen.js:1493`,
but `setProgressScanHideExactPreference` has no call site outside its own module.
Whether a control was removed or never built is not recoverable from the code
alone.

**U8 -- Email/password on the Pro paths.** `LoginScreen` has it;
`ProOnboardingScreen` step 1 and `ProUpgradeScreen` still carry the 2026-07-01
"OAuth only" comments and render OAuth buttons only. Whether that is intended
(Login being the single email door) or an incomplete restoration of the
2026-07-21 re-add is a founder question, not something the code answers.

# A. LOCAL PERSISTENCE

## A.0 The three stores, and what each owns

**LIVE.** Three distinct persistence layers, with a strict ownership rule.

1. **Encrypted SQLite (`volyume.db`, SQLCipher)** — the device truth.
   `src/lib/database.js` (8,217 lines) owns the schema and virtually all
   local reads/writes; the food domain has its own DAO at
   `src/lib/food/db.js` (1,838 lines) writing into tables that
   `database.js` still creates. This holds every row-shaped entity:
   training, plans, blocks, check-ins, weights, coach outputs, food,
   cardio, partners, photos metadata, scans, telemetry, retry queue.
2. **AsyncStorage (`@volyume_*` keys)** — device/app preferences,
   one-time flags, sync cursors, and a small number of genuinely
   load-bearing settings (custom volume landmarks, wellbeing mode,
   active-workout crash snapshot). It is NOT a row store: nothing with a
   primary key lives here.
3. **Zustand (`src/store/useAppStore.js`)** — in-memory session state:
   `session`, `user`, `tier`, `userProfile`, `units`, consent flags,
   sync status. Persistent values are mirrored to AsyncStorage or SQLite;
   the store never bypasses the DB for row data.

The one interesting exception to (1): **`userProfile` is NOT in SQLite.**
`src/lib/sync/tables/profiles.js:5-7` states it explicitly — "The user
profile lives in useAppStore in memory (Zustand) backed by AsyncStorage,
not in SQLite, so this handler reads/writes app state directly." The
cloud table is `users_profile`; the registry name is `profiles`. This is
the only registry table whose local side is the store, not a table.

A second exception to "`database.js` owns the schema":
`notification_preferences` is created lazily by
`src/lib/notifications/preferences.js:39-49`, outside `SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS`
and outside `PRAGMA user_version`. It IS in `WIPE_DIRECT_TABLES`
(`src/lib/database.js:4821`) and IS in `SYNC_REGISTRY`.

## A.1 SQLCipher encryption

**LIVE.** `src/lib/dbCrypto.js` (348 lines), invoked as the first act of
`_doInit` (`src/lib/database.js:144`).

- Key: 256-bit random, hex, `KEY_ID = 'volyume_db_key_v1'`, stored in
  `expo-secure-store` with `keychainAccessible: SecureStore.AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK`
  (`dbCrypto.js:25-39`). AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK is deliberate: the app must
  open the DB on a background wake before the user has unlocked the phone
  this session (`dbCrypto.js:28-38`, Sentry VOLYUME-1N).
- Never-mint-over-a-real-key rule (F-001): a SecureStore read that throws
  on all three attempts returns `status: 'unavailable'` and the open is
  ABORTED rather than generating a replacement key
  (`dbCrypto.js:77-125`, `173-200`). Locked-before-first-unlock is
  classified separately and logged at info, not error (`dbCrypto.js:71-75`,
  `197`).
- Plaintext→encrypted in-place migration: `ATTACH ... KEY` +
  `sqlcipher_export()`, verify the encrypted copy reads BEFORE touching the
  original, then a rename swap with the plaintext preserved as
  `volyume-plain-backup.db` until the encrypted DB is promoted and
  verified (`dbCrypto.js:296-337`). An interrupted swap self-recovers on
  the next launch (`dbCrypto.js:209-256`), and the recovery gates on
  `volyume.db` actually existing before probing, because
  `openDatabaseAsync` would otherwise CREATE an empty file that reads as
  "healthy" and the backup — the user's only copy — would be deleted
  (`dbCrypto.js:216-222`).
- An unreadable DB is moved aside to `volyume-unreadable.db`, never
  deleted (`dbCrypto.js:277-285`).
- **Fail-open**: any failure returns a working PLAINTEXT handle rather
  than bricking (`dbCrypto.js:288-293`, `338-347`). That state is
  surfaced, not silent: `emitPlaintextFallback()` logs
  `dbCrypto.plaintextFallback` to Sentry (`dbCrypto.js:47-57`),
  `database.js:156-159` logs `database.plaintextFallback`, and
  `isLocalDbEncrypted()` (`database.js:28-30`) lets privacy/consent
  surfaces read the real state instead of claiming encryption falsely
  (audit F-002).
- Probe hygiene: expo-sqlite hands back the SAME ref-counted native
  connection per path, so a probe whose `closeAsync` failed poisons every
  later probe; `closeQuietly` + `abortOpen` abort the launch recoverably
  rather than take a destructive branch on bad evidence
  (`dbCrypto.js:132-160`). Pinned by
  `src/lib/__tests__/dbCrypto.closeHygiene.test.js` and
  `dbCrypto.key.test.js`.

Connection pragmas after the keyed open (`database.js:160-177`):
`journal_mode = WAL`, `busy_timeout = 30000` (raised from 5s after
Sentry VOLYUME-23/-25: the food seed and the first plan build are
legitimately long transactions that collide with a session-restore pull).

## A.2 The `PRAGMA user_version` migration model

**LIVE.** `SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS` is an array of arrays at
`src/lib/database.js:395-2065`; `runMigrations(d)` at
`src/lib/database.js:2188-2238` applies every entry from the stored
`PRAGMA user_version` to `SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS.length`, bumping
`user_version` after each entry.

- **Current version: 70.** Counted mechanically over the array literal
  (70 top-level entries; entry 54 aligns exactly with the comment label
  "v54, progress-photo metadata" at `database.js:1561`, which anchors the
  count). Corroborated by `src/lib/dbSnapshot.js:27` whose filename
  example is `volyume_v70_to_v71_<ms>.db`.
- **The in-comment `vNN` labels drift by one from v56 onward.** Entries 55
  (`partner_weekly_intentions`, `database.js:1597`) and 56
  (`partner_win_cards`, `database.js:1613`) are unlabelled, so the block
  commented "v56, Progress Scan foundation" (`database.js:1630`) is
  actually entry 57, and every later label lags the true `user_version` by
  one. The final entry (block_ledger, `database.js:2062`) carries no vNN
  label at all — it is labelled "Stage 6, adaptive mesocycle build". This
  is a documentation drift only; the runner is index-driven and correct.
- Entry types: plain SQL strings, or async functions receiving the DB
  handle (used for JS-computed backfills — canonical exercise IDs
  `database.js:669-703`, UUID re-issue for `mesocycle_weeks`
  `database.js:851-869`, routine `position` backfill `database.js:1751-1764`,
  the mesocycles planned_weeks/deload_week repair `database.js:2027-2047`),
  or a computed array (`MICRO_COLUMNS.flatMap(...)` at
  `database.js:1698-1701`).
- **Append-only, never reorder.** Enforced by comment
  (`database.js:393-394`) and by the historical incident it exists for:
  the original `cardio_log` block was inserted MID-array, so installs
  already at the array's top version skipped it and every cardio insert
  failed with "no such table: cardio_log" — which also blocked sign-out,
  because sign-out's push-first sync errored on the same missing table
  (`database.js:1303-1314`). Two corrective trailing re-applications were
  appended (cardio_log at `database.js:1315`, the 9 exercise-library
  columns at `database.js:1356`). Regression-guarded by
  `src/lib/__tests__/migrations.cardioLog.test.js`.
- **Benign-error tolerance**: `isBenignMigrationError`
  (`database.js:2179-2184`) swallows only `duplicate column` /
  `already exists`. Anything else logs `database.migration` and THROWS,
  so `user_version` is not bumped and the migration retries next launch
  (`database.js:2227-2233`).
- **FTS5 is the one deliberately-skippable migration**:
  `ensureFoodSearchIndex` (`database.js:2109-2175`) swallows ONLY a
  genuinely missing FTS5 module and returns, leaving search on SQL LIKE
  for ever; any other error rethrows so a transient failure is not made
  permanently silent (E3 review note, `database.js:2117-2129`).
- **Pre-migration snapshot**: when and only when migrations are pending,
  `runMigrations` checkpoints the WAL and takes a byte-for-byte copy via
  `snapshotBeforeMigration` (`database.js:2201-2213`). Best-effort — a
  full disk must never brick an update.

### Photos / scans (device-local by constraint)
| Table | Notes |
|---|---|
| `progress_photo_meta` | PK `(user_id, name)` after the v56 user-scoping rebuild. `taken_at`, `pose`, `weight_kg`, `note`, `unscored` (quick-add fence). `database.js:1575-1583`, `:1717-1718`, `:2067-2102` |
| `progress_scan_sessions` | Scan run: status, `analysis_status`, consent version, camera facing, estimate + range + confidence + source, trend, quality, `model_version`/`estimator_version`, `signals_json`, `abstention_reasons_json`, `bias_flags_json`, `copy_summary`. `database.js:1638-1665` |
| `progress_scan_assets` | Per-pose asset: `photo_name`, `uri`, quality/landmark/segmentation/blur/lighting/framing scores, `camera_tilt_degrees`, `signals_json` (on-device TFLite mask measurements). `database.js:1666-1682`, `:1691` |
| `progress_scan_classification_history` | ENUMS ONLY: `assessment`, `status`, `created_at`. No photo, no raw score, no free text, no body-fat value. Written after the engine runs, never read by any engine module (source-guarded by `src/lib/__tests__/progressScanClassificationHistory.test.js`). `database.js:1916-1923` |

Actual image files are NOT in SQLite: `src/lib/progressPhotos.js:32`
puts them in `${documentDirectory}progress_photos/`, per-user subdirectory,
EXIF/GPS-stripped on save, iOS-backup-excluded via the native
`progress-scan-image` module.

### Notifications / infrastructure / telemetry
| Table | Notes |
|---|---|
| `notification_preferences` | PK `(user_id, category)`, `enabled`, `time_pref`, `updated_at`. Created lazily in `src/lib/notifications/preferences.js:39-49` |
| `pending_sync_ops` | The live retry queue. `op_type`, `entity_id`, `user_id`, `payload`, `retries`, `next_attempt_at`, `last_error`. `database.js:628-640` |
| `sync_meta` | `table_name`, `last_pull_at`, `last_push_at`. `database.js:782-786`. **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE**: no reader/writer found; watermarks live in AsyncStorage instead (`sync/watermark.js`) |
| `engine_telemetry` | Local mirror: `event`, `payload_json`, `occurred_at`, `pushed_at`. `database.js:1068-1077` |
| `tier_history` | Pull-only mirror of server tier events. `database.js:1055-1064` |

## A.4 `dbSnapshot` — the data-loss safety net

**LIVE.** `src/lib/dbSnapshot.js` (COMP-009). Byte-for-byte copies of
`volyume.db` into `${documentDirectory}snapshots/`, rolling-N retention
`KEEP = 3`.

- Two triggers only: `snapshotBeforeMigration(from, to)` — taken **only
  when migrations are actually pending**, so a cold start does not copy a
  multi-MB file for nothing (`database.js:2195-2213`); and
  `snapshotBeforeAccountSwitch()`.
- `copySnapshot` is the single choke point and always
  `checkpointWal()`s first, or the copy would miss commits still in
  `volyume.db-wal` (audit F-003, `dbSnapshot.js:61-78`;
  `checkpointWal` at `database.js:38-41`).
- Deliberately NOT the `dataBackup.js` JSON dump: a file copy is
  schema-faithful at the PRE-migration version, a JSON dump would be
  re-interpreted through current code (`dbSnapshot.js:1-9`).
- `restoreSnapshot(uri)` copies back and deletes the `-wal`/`-shm`
  sidecars, or the reopened DB replays pre-restore commits and silently
  undoes the restore (`dbSnapshot.js:141-151`). The caller MUST
  `closeDatabase()` first (`database.js:112-117`) and force a relaunch.
- Filenames encode kind + versions + epoch ms and parse back for the
  restore UI (`dbSnapshot.js:28-57`). Tested by
  `src/lib/__tests__/dbSnapshot.test.js`.

---

# B. CONCEPTUAL DATA MAP (Part 15)

Ownership rule, stated in code: **"SQLite is the source of truth. Supabase
is the cloud backup"** (`src/lib/sync.js:4`) and "last-write-wins with
local as device truth". Every screen reads local; nothing queries
Supabase directly for user rows. The cloud exists for cross-device restore
and for the handful of genuinely server-authoritative facts (tier, ED
flags, rollups, partnership status, trial ledger).

---

### USER
- **Purpose.** Identity anchor. Supabase `auth.users` id is the only user
  identity; there is no anonymous mode and no local-user migration path
  (`docs/IDENTITY_AND_OWNERSHIP_LOCKED.md`, enforced by
  `scripts/check-identity-invariant.sh`).
- **Important fields.** `session.user.id` (Supabase uid), `user.id` (the
  local user id threaded as `localUserId`), `tier`.
- **Written by.** `useAppStore.setUser` / `clearAuthStateForSignOut`
  (`src/store/useAppStore.js:313+`); auth flows in `RootNavigator`.
- **Read by.** Every DAO call (`userId` is the first argument almost
  everywhere), the sync runner, `proGate.js`.
- **Synced?** N/A — it IS the sync key. `tier` is server-owned
  (`upgrade_tier` / `upgrade_tier_for_user` RPCs; `migrate_005`'s trigger
  rolls back any client UPDATE — `sync/tables/profiles.js:16-19`).
- **Derived?** No.
- **Lifecycle.** Created at sign-up; local SQLite is wiped on sign-out
  (`wipeAllUserData`, `database.js:4882`) so two accounts on one device
  can never see each other's rows.
- **Constraints.** Article 9 consent gate blocks progression; sex is
  onboarding-enforced with no default.

### PROFILE
- **Purpose.** User-editable preferences that shape coaching and display.
- **Important fields** (the merge-mapped set, `sync/tables/profiles.js:30-44`):
  `firstName`, `units`, `trainingFocus`, `trainingAgeYears`,
  `primaryEquipment`, `barWeight`, `dietPreference`, `sex`,
  `mealPlanExcludeTags` (allergen excludes → cloud `allergen_excludes`).
  Local-only extras that ride along untouched: `mealPlanExcludeFoods`,
  `mealPlanMealsPerDay`, `mealPlanVariety`, `mealPlanFatConvention`,
  `mealPlanPeriWorkout` (`profiles.js:229-234`).
- **Written by.** `useAppStore.setUserProfile`, which also stamps
  `userProfileFieldUpdatedAt[field]`.
- **Read by.** `nutritionEngine`, `planEngine`, meal-plan assembly, every
  units-formatting surface.
- **Synced?** YES — registry `profiles`, cloud `users_profile`,
  strategy **`merge`** (per-column, via `column_updates_at` jsonb,
  `migrate_045`).
- **Derived?** No.
- **Lifecycle.** Created at onboarding; merged on every pull.
- **Constraints.** `tier` is excluded from the push payload entirely.
  `sex` NEVER unsets on a pull — it drives the ED calorie floor and BMR,
  so only a valid cloud value can change it (`profiles.js:244-247`).
  Allergens likewise never unset (`profiles.js:248-253`) — "an allergy
  silently wiped by a pull would be the worst failure this field has".
  Push tolerates the optional columns `sex` (094) / `allergen_excludes`
  (112) being absent by retrying with fewer columns (`profiles.js:46-59`,
  `162-178`).

### PLAN / ROUTINE
- **Purpose.** `programmes` = a plan; `routines` = a day within it;
  `routine_exercises` = the exercises in that day.
- **Important fields.** See § A.3. Notable: `routines.position` (day
  order within a plan), `routine_exercises.order_in_routine` (exercise
  order within a day), `superset_group_id`, `programmes.folder_id`.
- **Written by.** `database.js` builder/plan DAOs; `planAutoGen.js`;
  `insert*FromCloud` on pull.
- **Read by.** Plan library, builder, ActiveWorkout, `planEngine`.
- **Synced?** YES, but via the **legacy** `sync.js` path
  (`_pushProgrammes` `sync.js:773`, `_pushRoutinesAndExercises`
  `sync.js:795`; `_pullProgrammes` `sync.js:1798`,
  `_pullRoutinesAndExercises` `sync.js:1830`). Watermarked
  (`programmes`, `routines`), soft-delete aware.
- **Derived?** No. Sample/library routines are seeded.
- **Lifecycle.** Soft delete (`deleted_at`); pulls filter
  `.is('deleted_at', null)`.
- **Constraints.** `exercise_name` is denormalised onto
  `routine_exercises` precisely so a pull can recover when the cloud
  `exercise_id` does not resolve locally — the architectural bug behind
  "114 routines with zero exercises" (`database.js:718-722`).
  `cleanupOrphanRoutineExercises` runs as a self-heal.
  Deleting a folder never deletes a plan.

### EXERCISE (library + custom)
- **Purpose.** The movement catalogue.
- **Important fields.** See § A.3.
- **Written by.** `seedExercises.js` at first run (deterministic
  `canonicalExerciseId(name)` — a NAME HASH, so every device produces the
  same UUID for "Bench Press"); user creation writes `exercises` with
  `is_custom = 1`.
- **Read by.** Everything that resolves an exercise id.
- **Synced?** The **canonical library is NOT synced**: `user_id IS NULL`
  rows are seeded per device and are never pushed or pulled — stated
  explicitly at `database.js:1783-1787` and `:1815-1819`. Custom
  exercises ARE synced through the legacy path (`syncExercises`
  `sync.js:220`, `_pullExercises` `sync.js:1575`, `_pullCustomExercises`
  `sync.js:1678`). A cloud-side `foods`-style delta pull does not exist
  for exercises; instead `LIBRARY_VERSION_KEY` tops up new canonical rows
  on app update (`seedExercises.js:19`).
- **Derived?** Canonical IDs are derived from the name.
- **Lifecycle.** Canonical rows are permanent and version-topped-up.
- **Constraints.** **Contract-pinned:** the cloud restore of a custom
  exercise MUST land in local `exercises` with `is_custom: 1`, NOT in the
  orphaned local `custom_exercises` mirror, or it vanishes from the UI
  after a reinstall — grep-guarded by
  `src/lib/__tests__/customExerciseSync.contract.test.js`
  (`sync.js:1684-1699`). `_pullExercises` also does dedupe-by-name
  ID-rewriting so two installs whose canonical IDs differ get joined up
  (`sync.js:1551-1573`).

### WORKOUT SESSION
- **Purpose.** One logged training session.
- **Important fields.** See § A.3.
- **Written by.** `createWorkout` / `completeWorkout` in `database.js`;
  `insertWorkoutFromCloud` on pull.
- **Read by.** History, analytics, `weeklyCoach`, `blockLedgerRunner`,
  partner week signals.
- **Synced?** YES, legacy path, and it is the only entity with a
  dedicated on-save pusher (`syncWorkout` `sync.js:281`) AND a dedicated
  cloud DELETE path (`deleteWorkoutFromCloud` `sync.js:332`).
- **Derived?** `set_count` / `total_volume` are denormalised summaries.
- **Lifecycle.** Only `is_completed` workouts are pushed
  (`sync.js:655-656`). A completed workout is treated as IMMUTABLE, which
  is what makes the push watermark safe (`sync.js:658-666`).
- **Constraints.** In-progress workouts are held in an AsyncStorage crash
  snapshot (`@volyume_active_workout`), which is explicitly excluded from
  prefs sync (`sync.js:1276-1279`) — syncing it would ping-pong another
  device's live session onto this one.

### SET
- **Purpose.** One set inside a session.
- **Important fields.** See § A.3.
- **Written by.** ActiveWorkout logging; `insertWorkoutSetFromCloud`.
- **Read by.** Volume/PR/progression maths, `blockMetrics`, analytics.
- **Synced?** YES, legacy path, fetched by parent workout id via
  `fetchByIdsChunked` (`sync.js:1428-1430`).
- **Derived?** No, but `actual_reps` holds the LOWER side for unilateral
  sets so volume/PR/progression stay conservative with no engine change
  (`database.js:1210-1215`).
- **Lifecycle.** Deleting a set in-session enqueues a
  `workout_set_delete` tombstone op.
- **Constraints.** A 200-workout chunk can match far more than
  PostgREST's 1000-row cap; `fetchByIdsChunked` paginates WITHIN each
  chunk, pinned by `src/lib/__tests__/sync.fetchByIdsChunked.test.js`
  (production bug 2026-05-29: workouts came back missing sets).

### MESOCYCLE (block)
- **Purpose.** A training block with a planned length and a deload week.
- **Important fields.** `planned_weeks` (authoritative), `duration_weeks`,
  `deload_week`, `rir_ladder`, `block_type`, `block_ledger`.
- **Written by.** `activatePlanWithBlock`, `MesocycleBuilderScreen`,
  `storeBlockLedger` (`database.js:4290-4297`), `insertMesocycleFromCloud`.
- **Read by.** `mesocycle.js` (`getCurrentBlockWeekIndex`,
  `getBlockStatus`), `blockLedgerRunner`, `blockSeed`, `learnedRange`,
  every "Week N of M" surface.
- **Synced?** YES, legacy path (`_pushMesocycles` `sync.js:929`,
  `_pullMesocycles` `sync.js:1875`).
- **Derived?** `deload_week` is DERIVABLE (the last week is always the
  deload) and is derived rather than nulled when the cloud has none
  (`database.js:7236-7246`).
- **Lifecycle.** Rows with a null `start_date`/`end_date` are filtered
  out of the push because the cloud declares them NOT NULL
  (`sync.js:933-936`, `:979`).
- **Constraints.** `status` is deliberately NOT pushed (nothing mutates
  it today, `sync.js:951-955`). Ordering law: `deload_week` (migrate_129)
  and `block_ledger` (migrate_131) each had to be applied to production
  BEFORE the build carrying their push line shipped, or the WHOLE
  mesocycles upsert batch rejects on the unknown column
  (`sync.js:959-975`).

### MESOCYCLE WEEK
- **Purpose.** One week of a block.
- **Important fields.** `week_index`, `is_deload`, `rir_target`.
- **Written by.** `generateMesocycleWeeks`.
- **Read by.** Week-progression surfaces, `blockLedgerRunner`.
- **Synced?** YES, legacy path, fetched by parent mesocycle id.
- **Derived?** `rir_target` is re-derived from `is_deload` on pull
  (`is_deload ? 4 : 2`) because the cloud has no such column
  (`database.js:7257-7274`).
- **Lifecycle.** Cloud column is `week_number`, local is `week_index` —
  mapped both ways.
- **Constraints.** IDs must be UUIDs; legacy `mw_<meso>_<week>` composite
  keys were rejected by the cloud UUID column and re-issued by migration
  v22 (`database.js:845-869`).

### PLANNED_MUSCLE_VOLUME
- **Purpose.** The planned weekly set count per muscle per week, with the
  landmark band it was planned against.
- **Important fields.** `planned_sets`, **`mev`, `mav`, `mrv`, `source`**
  (all NOT NULL locally).
- **Written by.** `generateInitialPlannedVolume` (`database.js:4077+`,
  insert at `:4385`), `coachApply`.
- **Read by.** `coachApply.computeVolumeApply`, `blockExplain`,
  `blockLedgerGather.sumPlannedSets`, volume surfaces.
- **Synced?** **PARTIALLY, and asymmetrically.** Push reads the PRIMARY
  table via JOIN and sends only `planned_sets`
  (`sync.js:1185-1205`; reader `database.js:6871-6889`). The cloud table
  has no mev/mav/mrv/source columns
  (`supabase/migrate_012_complete_sync.sql:205-214`). Pull writes into
  the MIRROR table `planned_muscle_volume_sync`, not the primary one
  (`database.js:7583-7598`).
- **Derived?** The band is derived from `effectiveLandmarks` at plan time
  and then STORED.
- **Lifecycle.** Regenerated per block.
- **Constraints.** See § G — this is the single largest local-only /
  non-restoring surface found in this lane.

### BLOCK LEDGER (`mesocycles.block_ledger` JSON)
- **Purpose.** The per-muscle verdict on a FINISHED block — the one
  store that seeds the next block and feeds the learned working range.
- **Important fields** (`src/lib/interBlock.js:415-416`,
  `blockLedgerRunner.js`): `version` (`LEDGER_VERSION = 1`,
  `interBlock.js:51`), `algorithmVersion` (`LEDGER_ALGORITHM_VERSION`),
  per-muscle classification (`BLOCK_CLASS`: RESPONSIVE / OVERREACHED /
  STRAINED / STALE), `observed` (start, plannedPeak, achievedPeak,
  adherence, suppressed), `proposal`, `confidence`, `deferredToManual`,
  and `seedOutcome` (`blockLedgerRunner.js:383` — `{intent, recordedAt,
  perMuscle}`).
- **Written by.** `computeAndStoreBlockLedger`
  (`blockLedgerRunner.js:94+`) → `storeBlockLedger`
  (`database.js:4290-4297`).
- **Read by.** `blockSeed.resolveSeedRange`, `learnedRange.computeLearnedRange`
  (a pure REPLAY over stored ledgers — "no parallel store",
  `learnedRange.js:15-21`), Stage 8 block explanation.
- **Synced?** YES since 2026-08-09: pushed as parsed JSON into the cloud
  `jsonb` column (`sync.js:966-975`), pulled with local-preservation
  (`database.js:7215-7251`). Cloud column added by
  `supabase/migrate_131_mesocycles_block_ledger.sql`, **applied to
  EU-Dublin production 2026-08-09 and verified** (11 mesocycle rows
  untouched, 0 ledgers at apply time).
- **Derived?** Computed once from block data, then STORED. Not
  recomputable later (the source rows drift), which is exactly why the
  pull preserves a local ledger when the cloud carries none.
- **Lifecycle.** Idempotent: an already-stored ledger at the current
  `LEDGER_VERSION` is returned as-is; `{force: true}` rebuilds
  (`blockLedgerRunner.js:110-115`).
- **Constraints.** A ledger is BLOCK-END evidence — `getBlockStatus(...)
  .awaitingDecision` is a hard precondition, because the idempotency
  above would otherwise freeze a premature mid-block verdict for ever
  (`blockLedgerRunner.js:104-108`). A malformed local string pushes
  `null` rather than poisoning the batch (`sync.js:975`).

### CHECK-IN (weekly)
- **Purpose.** Weekly subjective + adherence input to the coach.
- **Important fields.** See § A.3 (`weekly_checkins`).
- **Written by.** Check-in screen; `sync/tables/weeklyCheckins.js` on pull.
- **Read by.** `weeklyCoach.runWeeklyCoach`, `edPatternDetector`,
  `blockLedgerRunner` (`getCheckinsInRange`, `database.js:4274-4287`).
- **Synced?** YES — **registry** table `weekly_checkins_v2`, LWW,
  bidirectional, no soft delete. Handler
  `src/lib/sync/tables/weeklyCheckins.js`. Cloud `updated_at` + a stale-
  refusing touch trigger from `migrate_047`.
- **Derived?** `steps_avg` is auto-averaged when ≥4 days of
  `daily_steps` exist, otherwise typed.
- **Lifecycle.** One row per local-Monday `week_start`.

### MORNING WEIGHT
- **Purpose.** Daily bodyweight trend input.
- **Important fields.** `logged_at`, `weight_kg`, `notes`.
- **Written by.** `logMorningWeight` (`database.js`), also write-through
  from the body-metrics repository (X3, `database.js:85-88`).
- **Read by.** Trend/rate-of-loss maths, `nutritionEngine`, ED rapid-loss
  gate.
- **Synced?** YES — legacy path (`_pushMorningWeights` `sync.js:1007`,
  `_pullMorningWeights` `sync.js:1906`, watermarked) PLUS a dedicated
  on-save pusher `syncMorningWeight` (`sync.js:562`) with a
  `morning_weight` queue op.
- **Derived?** No.
- **Constraints.** Rows with a null `logged_at` or `weight_kg` are
  filtered out of the push. ED-safety: weight-adjacent notifications
  suppress under an open ED flag.

### BODY METRICS
- **Purpose.** Weight + body fat + 9 circumference measures.
- **Written by.** `createBodyMetricsRepository` (`src/lib/database/bodyMetrics.js`).
- **Read by.** Progress screens, share cards (with the Article 9
  restrictions), `nutritionEngine` FFM maths.
- **Synced?** YES — **registry**, entry `body_composition_log`, LWW,
  soft delete, bidirectional; local table `body_metric_log`, cloud table
  `body_metrics` (`sync/tables/bodyComposition.js`).
- **Note.** The registry ALSO carries a `weight_log` entry for the same
  rows; its handlers are deliberate no-ops returning
  `skipped: 'aliased_to_body_composition_log'` so the per-table loop
  totals stay honest without double-pushing
  (`src/lib/sync/tables/weightLog.js:18-24`). **LEGACY-UNREACHABLE as a
  distinct entity.**

### COACH OUTPUT
- **Purpose.** The persisted result of a weekly coaching run.
- **Important fields.** `week_start`, `goal_phase`, `volume_signal`,
  `load_signal`, `recovery_flag`, `calorie_change`, `steps_target`,
  `cardio_prescription`, `why_this`, `output_json`, `applied`.
- **Written by.** `weeklyCoach` → `database.js` writers; `applied`
  flipped by `coachApply`.
- **Read by.** Coaching surfaces; `getDeloadSuggestedWeekStarts`
  (`database.js:4241-4254`) feeds the block ledger.
- **Synced?** YES, legacy path (`_pushCoachOutputs` `sync.js:1027`,
  `_pullCoachOutputs` `sync.js:1928`, watermarked).
- **Derived?** Entirely — deterministic engine output.
- **Constraints.** Pre-F5 the push carried no `updated_at`, so flipping
  `applied` never bumped the cloud row and delta pulls missed it; fixed
  at `sync.js:1036-1038`.

### NUTRITION TARGET
- **Purpose.** BMR/TDEE/calorie + macro targets.
- **Important fields.** `bmr`, `tdee`, `target_kcal`, macros, `phase`,
  `bmr_method`, `activity_level`, `confidence`, `warnings`, `goal`,
  `protein_approach`.
- **Written by.** `saveNutritionTargets` after `nutritionEngine` runs.
- **Read by.** Diary targets, MacroRings, meal-plan assembly, coach.
- **Synced?** YES — **registry**, PK `user_id`, LWW, bidirectional.
  The registry comment corrects an earlier contradiction: it was listed
  `pull_only`+`serverAuthoritative` while the shipping code always pushed
  (`sync/registry.js:153-170`). On-save shim `syncNutritionTargets`
  (`sync.js:1953-1964`) now delegates to the same transport handler.
- **Derived?** Computed locally by the deterministic engine; the cloud
  copy exists for restore, never for server-side computation.
- **Constraints.** ED floors (1,500 kcal men / 1,200 women, FFM 30 kcal/kg,
  1.5 %/wk rapid-loss gate, 0.8 % max-safe-loss) are re-enforced in
  `coachApply`, not trusted from a synced row. `goal` /
  `protein_approach` were moved onto the row (v60/migrate_111) precisely
  because they had lived only in an AsyncStorage copy and degraded to
  blanks on a new device (`database.js:1720-1734`).

### FOOD ENTRY / FOOD LIBRARY / RECIPE / MEAL PLAN
- **FOOD ENTRY** (`food_entries`). Purpose: the diary row. Written by
  `food/db.js` `logFoodEntry`/`updateFoodEntry`/`confirmPlanned*`. Read by
  rollups, MacroRings, adherence, timeline, coach. **Synced: YES —
  registry, LWW, soft delete, via the `food_sync_push`/`food_sync_pull`
  bulk RPC pair.** Derived: macros are resolved at log time and stored.
  Constraint: **`is_planned = 1` rows are LOCAL-ONLY and never synced**
  (`food/db.js:1565-1573`) — meal-plan scaffolding is excluded from the
  rollup, adherence, the FFM floor and sync until the user confirms
  (`database.js:1456-1466`). `entry_date` is re-derived from `logged_at`
  as a LOCAL day key on every apply, never trusted from the cloud
  (TZ-1, `food/db.js:1655-1661`).
- **FOOD LIBRARY** (`foods`, `custom_foods`). Purpose: the nutrient
  reference. `foods` is **reference data, not user data**: seeded from
  two bundled snapshots (`assets/seed/off_uk_snapshot.dat`,
  `cofid_uk.dat`, `food/seed.js`) and topped up by the
  `food_library_pull` RPC delta (`food/libraryDelta.js`, ≤5 pages ×
  5,000 rows, throttled to once per 6 h). Deliberately EXCLUDED from
  backup ("25k+ reseedable reference rows, not user data",
  `database.js:5202-5203`). `custom_foods` IS user data and IS synced
  (registry, LWW, soft delete).
- **RECIPE** (`recipes` + `recipe_ingredients`). Both synced.
  `recipes` rides the food bulk RPC; `recipe_ingredients` has its OWN
  handler and is ordered AFTER `recipes` in `MIGRATED_TABLES` so the
  parent lands first (`transport.js:95-97`). Cloud column is `servings`,
  local is `total_servings` (`foodDomain.js:195-197`).
- **SAVED MEAL** (`saved_meals`). `items_json` must be pushed as a PARSED
  array, not a JSON string, or the jsonb column stores a quoted scalar
  and every meal's contents silently vanish (`foodDomain.js:175-183`).
- **MEAL PLAN** (`meal_plans`). Purpose: the exact ACTIVE assembled plan
  (swaps, coach edits, training-day answers) must survive a device change
  rather than regenerate differently (`registry.js:203-216`). Synced,
  LWW, soft delete, own handler. Carries a `plan_json` with a
  `schemaVersion` (`food/mealPlanService.js:131`).

### CARDIO LOG
- **Purpose.** One row per logged cardio session (many per day).
- **Important fields.** See § A.3. `est_kcal` is session FEEDBACK only
  and is **never** added to the calorie target (`database.js:1246-1247`).
- **Written by.** Cardio logging screens; passive import (HealthKit /
  Health Connect) keyed on `ext_id`.
- **Read by.** `cardio/cardioEngine.js`, coach cardio prescription,
  recovery reads.
- **Synced?** YES — registry, PK `(user_id, id)`, LWW, soft delete.
- **Constraints.** The partial unique index on `(user_id, ext_id) WHERE
  ext_id IS NOT NULL` de-dups imports without constraining manual rows.

### PARTNER LINK
- **Purpose.** A consented, pair-scoped accountability link.
- **Important fields.** See § A.3 (six local tables).
- **Written by.** Server RPCs (`create_partner_invite`,
  `redeem_partner_invite`, `end_partnership`) and the pull;
  `weekSignalWriter` derives the local week signal.
- **Read by.** PairCard and partner surfaces.
- **Synced?** YES — one registry entry `partner_signals` drives all the
  mirrors, and it is the ONLY **pair-scoped** (not user-scoped) entry:
  "rows in my active pairs, including my partner's"
  (`sync/tables/partners.js:1-18`).
- **Constraints.** Partnership status is server-authoritative and never
  pushed; cheers go through the `partner-cheer` edge function; shared
  blocks carry a block REFERENCE and display name, never plan content.
  A partnership the cloud no longer returns as mine is PRUNED locally
  (the unpair-while-offline case). A Free/lapsed user's outbound signal
  is overridden to a calm `resting` state with milestone booleans forced
  false (`partners.js:36-53`). Direct client writes to `partnerships` and
  `partner_weekly_intentions` were revoked by `migrate_119` (BSEC-01 /
  BSEC-10).

### PROGRESS PHOTO / SCAN
- **Purpose.** Device-local physique tracking.
- **Written by.** `progressPhotos.js` (files), `progressScanStore.js`
  (rows).
- **Read by.** Progress-photos screen, Progress Scan flow, the
  before/after Pro card.
- **Synced?** **NO — deliberately absent from `SYNC_REGISTRY` and from
  `sync.js`.** Stated three times in migration headers
  (`database.js:1568-1571`, `:1630-1635`, `:1903-1909`). Photos, assets,
  scan analysis and the classification history never leave the device.
- **Constraints.** EXIF/GPS stripped on save; iOS backup excluded;
  per-user directory; the classification history stores ENUM LABELS ONLY
  and is never read by any engine module. Everything is wiped per-user by
  `wipeAllUserData` (`database.js:4846-4850`).

### NOTIFICATION PREFERENCE
- **Purpose.** Per-category enable + preferred time.
- **Important fields.** PK `(user_id, category)`, `enabled`, `time_pref`,
  `updated_at`.
- **Written by.** `notifications/preferences.js` `setPreference`.
- **Read by.** The notification scheduler, quiet hours, push budget.
- **Synced?** YES — registry, LWW on `(user_id, category)`, own handler.
  Pull applies via `applyPreferenceFromPull`, which preserves the SERVER
  `updated_at` and only writes when the cloud row is strictly newer —
  the Codex F4 fix, because `setPreference` stamps `Date.now()` and made
  pulled rows echo back as fresh local writes
  (`sync/tables/notificationPreferences.js:17-24`).
- **Constraints.** The Expo push TOKEN is device-bound and is explicitly
  NOT synced (`sync.js:1259-1264`); it lives in cloud
  `device_push_tokens` (`migrate_053`), written by
  `notifications/pushToken.js:118`. ED-safety: weight/food-adjacent
  categories suppress under an open ED flag.

# C. SYNC ARCHITECTURE

## C.1 Two tracks, and which table rides which TODAY

`syncAll` runs a four-stage cycle (`src/lib/sync/runner.js:195-285`):

1. per-table **push** for every name in `MIGRATED_TABLES`
2. legacy bulk **push** (`sync.bulkUploadLocalData`)
3. per-table **pull** for every name in `MIGRATED_TABLES`
4. legacy bulk **pull** (`sync.pullFromCloud`)

**All 22 `SYNC_REGISTRY` entries are in `MIGRATED_TABLES`.** The registry
migration is complete; the "legacy" track now carries only tables that
were never in the registry at all (the training domain + AsyncStorage
prefs). `transport.js:75-98`:

```
notification_preferences, weekly_checkins_v2, body_composition_log,
weight_log, nutrition_targets, profiles, ed_pattern_flags, tier_history,
daily_steps, cardio_log, partner_signals, meal_plans, plan_folders,
perday_target_offsets,
+ FOOD_DOMAIN_TABLES (food_entries, custom_foods, saved_meals, recipes,
  food_favourites, daily_water, daily_intake_rollups)
+ recipe_ingredients   ← ordered AFTER recipes deliberately (audit B6)
```

### The registry contract, in full (`src/lib/sync/registry.js:22-245`)

| # | table | pk | strategy | serverAuth | softDelete | direction | handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `weekly_checkins_v2` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | no | bidirectional | `tables/weeklyCheckins.js` |
| 2 | `weight_log` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | no | bidirectional | `tables/weightLog.js` (**no-op alias**) |
| 3 | `food_entries` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | **yes** | bidirectional | `tables/foodDomain.js` |
| 4 | `custom_foods` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | **yes** | bidirectional | foodDomain |
| 5 | `saved_meals` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | **yes** | bidirectional | foodDomain |
| 6 | `recipes` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | **yes** | bidirectional | foodDomain |
| 7 | `recipe_ingredients` | `id` | last_write_wins | no | **yes** | bidirectional | `tables/recipeIngredients.js` |
| 8 | `food_favourites` | `(user_id, food_ref)` | last_write_wins | no | **yes** (D1-#8, migrate_090) | bidirectional | foodDomain |

| 10 | `daily_intake_rollups` | `(user_id, entry_date)` | **server_wins** | **yes** | no | **pull_only** | foodDomain (count of locally recomputed dates) |
| 11 | `daily_steps` | `(user_id, entry_date)` | last_write_wins | no | no | bidirectional | `tables/dailySteps.js` |
